lokele: Ende Bwana Teofilo—Eoka mbo bato wike basokotaka ndotaka kasa ya njasɔ ebiakelomökö sisi yasu,
english: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

lokele: yao ina ebisoaekelanomo end’iso konda baakoelo ko l’ebɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ la ebanangokoläkä Lioi,
english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

lokele: ongoma asotutaka’mi imɔ mbo iluweke yao bitotina tunya la tunya la wɛlï konda liakoli, imi isosanga ndosɔnɛl’aɛ lokasa-lo loa njasɔ-ao tunya la tunya,
english: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

lokele: mbo oluweke la wewe, yao ina ebiaekesomökö aɛ la bɔnɔkɔ. Liotomu lia Yoane Bolufi
english: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

lokele: Ayaläkä Helodi Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda, Sekalaya ayaläkä kanga ya botükä wa Abiya, wali wande aaka ɔmɔi wa baseka ba Alona, lina liande liko Elisabeta.
english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

lokele: Iyo ambale, la wali la olome, benganäkä nda baiso ba Mungu, balitesäkä Bikela la ndola ya Ngɛnɛ Mungu angotwanelo yao.
english: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

lokele: Kongo ko bachaaka la wana eoka Elisabeta aaka ekomba, la iyo yaambale baaka sumbu tonunu.
english: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

lokele: Akeläkä Sekalaya likuwa lia kanga nda ndakɔ ya Mungu nda weto wa botükä wande, iyo la bakanga loaa lisho liɔɔtɔ kuku ya Ndakɔ ya Mungu otumba isandu sha liyɛsɛ omao,
english: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division

lokele: iyo loaa lisho ko la ngongo.
english: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

lokele: Atumbäk’inde isandu sha liyɛsɛ, etunda etoti ya bato losombola lousa.
english: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

lokele: Nde bokitomo wa Mungu lɔɛnɛnɛ ende Sekalaya, inde loemala nda fangi ya olome ya etumbelo ya isandu sha liyɛsɛ.
english: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

lokele: Ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ Sekalaya wɛnɛ bokitomo inde loilima, inde lowa bɔwa finɛ.
english: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

lokele: Nde bokitomo loonga lande mbo— Owangëke, Sekalaya, eoka lisomboli liaɛ liokomuku nde, la wali waɛ ako Elisabeta atootel’aɛ wana botolome, otot’inde lina liko Yoane.
english: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

lokele: Waɔlɔ nde loomalo la eyalaka limɛngɔ liaɛ, la bato wike beomalaka eoka ya lootomo loande.
english: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

lokele: Eoka eyalaka nde oto wa tala nda baiso ba Ngɛnɛ Mungu; Atiamweke bänä kwa tatä nde etumesomoko la Bolimo Botanu konda kuku ya nyango wande.
english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

lokele: Eoka yande bana wike ba Isalaele bekikwaka liasi ende Ngɛnɛ Mungu wau.
english: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

lokele: Inde ɛkɛndɛkɛ la oso, ani Mungu atɔɛnɛ inde, eyalaka la bolimo la bofoka wa Eliya, Mbo alɛmbɛsɛkɛ betema ya basango ende bana bau la eba litefoli ekikolak’iyo nda wɛlï wa eba liengani; La ndokomiela Ngɛnɛ Mungu tukela ya bato ebasotatonjomo.
english: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ Malachi 4:6 and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”

lokele: Limɔ Sekalaya loonga la bokitomo mbo— ¿Itoluwa nde lole wewe la moni? Eoka imi angɛnɛ yende inunu la wali wami ende sumbu la miaka wike.
english: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”

lokele: La bokitomo lomutoel’inde mbo— Imi yende Ngabaliele, itoemakala oso wa baiso ba Mungu; isotomomo mbo iongeke laɛ la mbo iluwesek’aɛ e-mboli ilau-bi.
english: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

lokele: Toka, boyala nde euma, angokɔkɔlɔ oonga imɔ konda lise elikakelomoko e-njasɔ-bi, eoka otiimele baoi bami ebelakɔchɔmɔkɔ nde nda lisho lia bao.
english: Behold, 1:20 you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”

lokele: Kongo ko bato baumbakeläkä Sekalaya la iyo lowa liena mbo asotikala yumwa nda ndakɔ ya Mungu.
english: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

lokele: Akuswäk’inde, atiakɔkɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ oonga lau imɔ, la iyo loluwa mbo aɛni nde liɛni omao nda ndakɔ ya Mungu; inde lomekoel’iyo ani atikali nde ko euma.
english: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

lokele: Asiläkä weto wa bacho ba likuwa liande nda ndakɔ ya Mungu, inde lɔkɛ olo nda ndakɔ yande.
english: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

lokele: Limɔ mbisa ya mbile sinyo wali wande ako Elisabeta loaelo lieme la inde loisama nda likula ko tengai bɔɔmwi, inde mbo—
english: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

lokele: Ngɛnɛ asokeela’mi ongoma kwa asotichaka’mi mbo asokoleke sɔni yami nda baiso ba bato. Bokitomo lɔɛnɛlɛ ende Malia
english: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”

lokele: Mbisa ya tengai liambɛ bokitomo ako Ngabaliele lotomomo la Mungu nda bokenge wa Ngalilai, boko Nasaleta,
english: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,

lokele: ende boseka oyaaka liäla lia Yosefa, boto wa bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa Dawidi; lina lia boseka liko Malia.
english: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.

lokele: Bokitomo loya end’inde, inde loonga lande mbo— Saela botema, aɛ otomali wa elame, Ngɛnɛ Mungu ale laɛ.
english: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”

lokele: Nde Malia lɔɛnɛ tale finɛ eoka ya baoi-ba la inde lofelana la botema litina lia liseeli-li.
english: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

lokele: Bokitomo loonga lande mbo— Owangëke, Malia, osɔɔlɔ elame ende Mungu.
english: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

lokele: Toka, otoyala nde la lieme, la otoota wana la aɛ kota Inde lina liko YESU.
english: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’

lokele: Inde eyalaka nde tala, etangomoko nde Wana wa Oyetami, la Ngɛnɛ Mungu efaefak’Inde kɛka ya isosha sha ngau wande ako Dawidi,
english: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

lokele: eyalaka nde Bɔkɔta wa Bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa Yakobo ko layalaya, la yakakaelo yande etilaɛilek’imɔ.
english: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

lokele: Nde Malia loonga la bokitomo mbo— ¿Monito lotoya ende’mi ongoma, eoka itiingale la otolome?
english: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”

lokele: La bokitomo lomutola lande mbo— Bolimo Botanu nd’atoya se end’aɛ la Bofoka Oyetami atoobiamel’aɛ nda liɔmbɛ liande; eokao wana imɔ oyatootomo laɛ eyalaka botanu la etangomoko Wana wa Mungu.
english: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

lokele: Toka, Elisabeta nda inunu shande oyale wa bɔkɔ̈kɔ waɛ, inde imɔ ende la lieme lia tengai liambɛ, ani atangomu ekomba.
english: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

lokele: Eoka loti la loaso ango lɔmɔi sakolo ngo ko Mungu atokɔkolɔ loao.
english: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.” 1:37

lokele: Malia loonga mbo— Tɛnɛ, yende ngo ko bɔkɔwa wa Ngɛnɛ, loyaleke ende’mi kwa asoonga aɛ. Limɔ bokitomo losekwa end’inde. Malia lɔkɛ fɛtɛti ende Elisabeta
english: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.

lokele: Nda bacho-ba Malia loila lɔkɛndɔ loa mangu okakɛ nda okenge ɔmɔi wa Yuda, nda yese ya föngo;
english: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

lokele: omao inde lɔtɔ ndakɔ ya Sekalaya, inde lolamola Elisabeta,
english: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

lokele: la ökakä Elisabeta lilamoli lia Malia, wana lotondwa nda sɔlɔ; Elisabeta angɛnɛ lotumesomo la Bolimo Botanu,
english: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

lokele: inde loamama la limiki lifi, limɔ inde mbo— Aɛ nd’atoetela batomali batotina la elame la olau, Wana wa sɔlɔ yaɛ imɔ, nd’atoetela la elame la olau.
english: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

lokele: ¿Loyi ngo ko ende’mi moni, mbo Nyango wa Ngɛnɛ wami asoya fɛtɛti ende’mi?
english: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo aɔti lioi lia lilamoli liaɛ nda batoi bami, Wana wami lotondwa nda sɔlɔ yami ko la limɛngɔ.
english: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

lokele: Limɛngɔ fuu lile la otomali oyasoimela eoka mbo, Ebiatikäkä Ngɛnɛ lisakä end’inde, yao bikɔchɔmɔkɔ nde wewe. Bɔɛlɛ wa Malia
english: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

lokele: Limɔ Malia mbo— Bolimo wami botoinakela Ngɛnɛ,
english: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.

lokele: Botema wami bosoomakala loasɔ loa Mungu, Bouwesi wami,
english: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

lokele: Eoka asowɛlɛ iuwe shami baiso, ako bɔkɔwa otomali wande. Tɛnɛ, ko louse konda fɛtɔ bitoti ebikayeke, batotanga’mi ewa elame.
english: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

lokele: Ende Bowangɔ nde Oyasokeela’mi tokesa; lina liande liende litanu.
english: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

lokele: Booto wande bofi bosowɛlɛkɛmɛ ende fɛtɔ la fɛtɔ ya ebatolitekes’Inde;
english: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.

lokele: Asokakalesa kakala ko la bosamba wande wa bofoka, Asomelekesa eba bɛmɛtɔ nda baenyeli ba betema yau.
english: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

lokele: Asosokokola eba befoka nda kɛka yau, Nde asotalia eba touwe tala;
english: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.

lokele: Asokanelesa eba tosiyɛ la bieka bilau, Nde asosaya bafoka wawa.
english: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

lokele: Asosunga Isalaele oyale bɔkɔwa wande, Eoka yoenyakela booto wande
english: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

lokele: Kwa aongäk’Inde la bangau basu, Ende Abalayama la ende bana bande laya laya.
english: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring 1:55 forever.”

lokele: Malia lotikala amamwito la Elisabeta yumwa kwa tengai isatɔ, limɔ inde loinywa nda ndakɔ yande angɛnɛ. Liotomu lia Yoane Bolufi
english: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

lokele: Enganäkä lisho lia Elisabeta lioota, inde loota otolome,
english: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.

lokele: la bayalani lande l’eba bɔkɔ̈kɔ wande looka loasɔ loa elame finɛ eyakeeläkä Mungu okeel’inde, iyo loya oyasanganaka lande nda eyombi ya limɛngɔ.
english: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.

lokele: Nda lise lia bonanɛi mbisa ya liotomu, iyo loya oyatena wana itombe, basikiof’inde lina liko Sekalaya kwa elia sango wande,
english: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

lokele: kongo ko nyango wande mbo— Mbayɔ, atotangomo mbo Yoane.
english: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”

lokele: Iyo mbo— Angwɛnɛ oto angɔɔmɔi wa bɔkɔkɔ waɛ la elina-li.
english: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

lokele: Ko la ndembe, iyo lofela sango lina elikalɛmbɛk’inde mbo bateke wana liao.
english: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

lokele: Sekelaya lofel’iyo litalɛ limɔ inde lɔsɔnɔ mbo— Lina liande liko Yoane; iyo yaatotina lomwaala.
english: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.

lokele: Limɔ bɔnɔkɔ wande loliolomo futuku la lolamɛ loande lofaikwa, inde loonga la Inde loinakela Mungu.
english: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

lokele: Bayalani lau batotina lowänga la lokuku loa bitotina-bi lookana nda yese etotina ya föngo ya Yudea.
english: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

lokele: Batotina ebokäkä, iyo loisa yao nde betema yau, iyo mbo— ¿Boni to bɔfɔɔnɔ ebotoyala la wana-yo? eoka bofoka wa Mungu boyali nde lande. Lioi lia Sekalaya eoka ya wana ako Yoane
english: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

lokele: Sango wande ako Sekalaya lotuma la Bolimo Botanu, inde lotɔndɔlɔ mbo—
english: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

lokele: Ngɛnɛ Mungu wa BaIsalaele ainakelomoko, Asoya oyaendola tukela ya bato bande;
english: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;

lokele: Asotɛmɔlɔ ɛɛla ya liuwesi liasu Nda bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa Dawidi bɔkɔwa wande,
english: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

lokele: Kwa aongäk’Inde la bɛnɔkɔ ya batɔndɔli bande E-batanu ko kwaalakwaala,
english: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

lokele: Mbo touwesomoko nda baiyani lasu la mbo touwesomoko Nda besamba ya bato ebale lasu la lisiela,
english: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;

lokele: Mbo akeeleke batata basu booto la Aenyakeleke ngɛla yande ya botanu
english: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,

lokele: La ekanɔ eyatinyäk’Inde la Abalayama ngau wasu,
english: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,

lokele: Mbo tolaendolomoko nda besamba ya ebatoiyel’iso, Mbo tokuwelek’Inde, angwɛnɛ bɔwa imɔ, ani ɛnɛnɛk’iso
english: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,

lokele: Ko la botanu la liengani bacho batotina ba liwawi liasu.
english: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

lokele: L’aɛ, wana, botangomoko Bɔtɔndɔli wa Oyalongeli, Eoka weteleke oso wa Ngɛnɛ okakomiel’Inde mboka,
english: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,

lokele: La okafaefa bato bande liekesi lia liuwesi, Ko la limɛsɛɛli lia batwanelo bau,
english: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

lokele: Eoka ya botema wa ngandi ya Mungu wasu, Bonyanya wa Use bosoyatwel’iso,
english: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,

lokele: Ndoanekesa bato ebayali nda lilima la nda bounduundu wa liwa, Ndokɛndɛkɛs’iso batindi fii nda mboka ya lilatemi.
english: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”

lokele: Ongoma wana lokonda, inde lowangema nda botema la ayaläkä nda liɔmbɛlɛ konda lise liaɛnɛlɛ̈k’inde ende Isalaele.
english: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

lokele: Yaäkä nde la bacho bana mbo Kaisala Auguseto atäkä ndola mbo bato ba wenda bototina batomoko baina nda lokasa lotanga loketi loau.
english: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

lokele: —lotango-lo loa oso loatangomökö ani Kuliniu aakä Gouverneur wa yese ya Sulia.—
english: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

lokele: Eokao bato batotina lɔkɛ okata lina nda lokasa, oto la oto nda okenge wande angɛnɛ.
english: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

lokele: La Yosefa imɔ losekwa nda yese ya Ngalilai, nda okenge wa Nasaleta okakɛ nda yese ya Yudea konda okenge wa Dawidi boko Betelehemu, —eoka aakä wa bofindi wa bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa Dawidi—
english: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,

lokele: ndokatä lina liande amamwito la Malia oyakɛ̈kɛ̈ lande liäla, la ojaakä la lieme.
english: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

lokele: Ayaläk’iyo omao mbile yande yoota loengana,
english: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

lokele: la Malia lota wana otolome wa oso la inde lolingela wana la bisinda yokandak’inde la inde loingesa wana nda bombeya, eoka batiäkä la elela nda ndakɔ ya eba kɛndɔ. Bakitomo la betingani ya bɛkɔkɔ
english: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

lokele: Nda yese ena betingani ya bɛkɔkɔ baingaläkä lousa nda elanga ndolamba liasa lia bɛkɔkɔ yau la ocho.
english: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

lokele: Limɔ bokitomo wa Ngɛnɛ Mungu lɔɛnɛlɛ end’iyo la bɔfɛkɔ wa Ngɛnɛ loangangel’iyo la iyo lowangaka la bɔwa finɛ.
english: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

lokele: Kongo ko bokitomo loonga lau mbo— Owangëke eoka, tɛnɛ, isoyaeshel’ino mboli bilau ya linɛngina lifi elitoomana la bato batotina,
english: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

lokele: mboli biko mbo— Wana asootelomo ino louse, nda bokenge wa Dawidi, wana ende Bouwesi ako Masiya Ngɛnɛ.
english: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ 2:11 the Lord.

lokele: Ndembe yosung’ino ndolembeel’Inde eko mbo booshaka wana-oli alingelomu la bisinda la aingesomu nda bombeya.
english: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

lokele: Futuku, amamwito la bokitomo ona, botükä wa bakitomo ba use ebainakeläkä Mungu, iyo mbo—
english: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

lokele: Loomalo lofi ende Mungu ɔlɔ nda Use, la ono se nda wenda, ko lilatemi sisi ya bato ebatoomales’Inde.
english: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

lokele: Asekwäkä bakitomo ende betingani ya bɛkɔkɔ okakɛ ɔlɔ eyau nda use, limɔ betingani loongana mbo— Totangweke to olo nda Betelehemu okɛnɛ lona elokokelomo ona, la eloluwesomu iso la Ngɛnɛ.
english: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

lokele: Iyo loya la mangu, iyo loyaosha Malia la Yosefa la wana aingali nda bombeya;
english: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

lokele: la ɛnɛk’iyo wana, iyo loluwesa bato lioi eliaongomökö lau loasɔ loa wana-yo;
english: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

lokele: la batotina ebokäkä, iyo lomwaakala eyaongomökö lau la betingani ya bɛkɔkɔ.
english: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

lokele: Nde Malia angɛnɛ loisaka bitotina-bi nda botema ani atoenyaka yao la wɛlï.
english: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

lokele: La betingani loinywa eyau la liineli la lisemoli ende Mungu eoka ya mboli eyokäk’iyo la njasɔ eyɛnɛ̈k’iyo kwa aongomökö lau oso.
english: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

lokele: Asiläkä becho bonanɛi, lisho liotena wana itombe loengana la Inde lotomo lina liko YESU, eliafomökö Inde la bokitomo oso ani nyango wande akaeli lieme. Liuchomu lia Yesu la Simeona
english: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

lokele: Asiläkä becho yosaesa bokili wa lioti, kwa ekela eyatäkä. Mose, iyo loeshana lande nda Yelusaleme ndüch’Inde ende Mungu
english: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

lokele: —kwa ekela eyatomökö nda lokasa loa Bikela ya Mungu mbo— Botolome la botolome oyatoliola kuko ya otomali, etangomoko wüchomo ende Mungu—
english: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”), Exodus 13:2

lokele: la mbo bakusoleke lifaefi kwa ekela ya Mungu, mbo— Boya la bangambo bambale angoko bana bambale ba bikükü.
english: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.” Leviticus 12:8

lokele: Nda Yelusaleme aäkä nde boto lina liande liko Simeona, ayaläkä la liengani la boto wolitesa Mungu, awɛlɛ̈kɛ̈ Liɔngɛsi lia BaIsalaele baiso, la Bolimo Botanu ayaläkä lande.
english: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

lokele: Aluwesomökö la Bolimo Botanu mbo atilɛnɛkɛ liwa oso ani akɛni ngo Masiya wa Ngɛnɛ.
english: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ. 2:26

lokele: Eoka ya Bolimo inde lɔɔtɔ nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu limɔ kwaani aɔtɔkɔ ebaoti wana Yesu, mbo bakeeleke wana eloengani la Bikela ya Mungu,
english: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

lokele: limɔ Simeona loila wana nda besamba yande, inde loinela Mungu ko ndoongel’Inde mbo—
english: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,

lokele: E, Ngɛnɛ wa bɔkɔwa waɛ, kwani osofaikola’mi mbo itangweke la lilatemi nda botema, kwa atikäk’Aɛ lisakä;
english: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

lokele: Eoka baiso-ba bami basɔɛnɛ liuwesi liaɛ
english: for my eyes have seen your salvation,

lokele: Elisokomya Aɛ fololo oso wa bato ba tukela bitoti;
english: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;

lokele: Elile kwa löwa loanyemela bato ba biese yasi, La tala ya lokuku loa bato baɛ bako Isalaele.
english: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

lokele: Sango la nyango wa wana lomwaala ebiongomu eoka yande.
english: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.

lokele: Lamao Simeona loongel’iyo baoi ba lifotesi la inde loonga la Malia, nyango wande mbo— Tɛnɛ ngo, Wana-yo asootomo loasɔ loa lokwesomu la liemesi lia bato wike ba Isalaele la eyalaka nde ndembe ya tofenya,
english: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.

lokele: —Eingo, likɔ̈kɔ litɔtwɛlɛ botema waɛ angɛnɛ— mbo baenyakeli ba betema wike bɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ fololo. Ana
english: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”

lokele: Botomali ayaläkä omao ako Ana oyaäka bɔtɔndɔli, la wana wa Fanuele wa tukela ya Ashela. Otomali ona ayaläkä sumbu inunu; ayaläkä nde la olome miaka osambale nda lisɔngɔni,
english: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

lokele: la mbisa ya liwa lia olome ayaläkä lotika ko miaka kama bonanɛi la inɛi, la inde angosekwaka nda ndakɔ ya Mungu, nde kosemokolaka Mungu omao la likili lia bieka la lisomboli la ocho la löwa.
english: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.

lokele: Ko la mbile-ao inde loya, inde lofa Mungu kelekëlë limɔ inde loongana la bato batotina ebaumbakeläkä liendoli lia Yelusaleme.
english: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

lokele: Akɔchäk’iyo bitotina ya ekela ya Ngɛnɛ Mungu, iyo loinywa nda Ngalilai, konda bokenge wau angɛnɛ boko Nasaleta.
english: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

lokele: La Wana lokonda la Inde lowangema la bofoka, ayaläkä la wɛli finɛ, la elame ya Mungu loyala lande. Isenge Yesu nda Yelusaleme
english: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

lokele: Ebaotäk’Inde bakɛɛkɛ mwaka la mwaka nda Yelusaleme nda mbile ya Elambɔ ya Lieti.
english: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

lokele: Ayäk’Inde miaka liu la imbale, iyo lɔkɛ nda elambɔ kwa boyaeli wau,
english: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;

lokele: la asilesäk’iyo becho ya elambɔ, iyo loinywa nde Wana ako Yesu lotikala liili nda Yelusaleme, la ebaot’Inde batialuwäkä ongoma.
english: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,

lokele: Batangäkä nde mbo ayali nda bolenga, eokao iyo lɔkɛ lɔkɛndɔ loa lise limɔi ani iyo loluk’Inde ende bato ba bokulü wau la baina lau, nde batiɛnɛ̈k’Inde;
english: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.

lokele: lamao iyo loinywa Yelusaleme liasi okaluk’Inde omao.
english: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

lokele: Mbisa ya becho isatɔ iyo lɔɛnɛ Inde nda ndakɔ ya Mungu ani ayali se sisi ya baekesi, Inde lolaila iyo la afelakäkä imɔ iyo felo.
english: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.

lokele: Batotina ebokäkä Inde, iyo lomwaala liluwani lia bamutoli bande.
english: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

lokele: Ɛnɛk’iyo wɛnɛ Inde, iyo lowa liena la nyango wande loonga lande mbo— Wana, ¿Osokeel’iso ani eoka iye to? Iso la sango waɛ lami tosolukak’Aɛ la botema wale finɛ.
english: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Monito oluki nde’mi; otiluwe nde mbo lole loami mbo iyaleke nda ndakɔ ya Sango wami?
english: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”

lokele: Nde batialuwäka litina lia lioi eliaongäk’Inde lau.
english: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.

lokele: Lamao Inde lɔkɛsɛnɛ lau, Inde loiya nda Nasaleta, Inde lolites’iyo la wɛlï; la nyango wande loisaka ebitotina-bi nda botema wande.
english: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

lokele: La Yesu lokonda nda wɛlï la liɔwa nda bindo la nda elame ya Mungu la bato lisanga.
english: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

lokele: Nda mwaka wa liu la bɔɔmwi w’isosha sha Tibelia Kaisala wa Loma, l’ani Pontio Pilato aäkä Komanda wa Yudea, la Helodi aäkä Komanda wa Ngalilai, la etungani yande ako Filipo aäkä Komanda wa Itulaya la Tulakoniti, la Lusania aäkä Komanda wa Abilene,
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

lokele: l’ani Ana la Kayafa baäkä bakanga ebaeti, limɔ lioi lia Mungu liayäkä ende Yoane, wana wa Sekalaya, nda liɔmbɛlɛ.
english: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

lokele: Limɔ Yoane lɔkɛ nda yese etotina ya Yaladene, okanangokole lolufio loa likalangani ko la lɔmɛsɛlɔmɔ loa njasɔ ibe,
english: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

lokele: kwa yatomökö nda lokasa loa baoi ba Yesaya ewa bɔtɔndɔli, mbo— Limiki litoamama nda liɔmbɛlɛ mbo— Komyaka mboka ya Ngɛnɛ, Longamesaka biëli yande,
english: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

lokele: Sɛlɛlɛ bitotina bitotumesomoko la nyɛlɛ, Föngo bitotina la bikole bitowɛlɔkɔmɔ se kwa loanyake, Mboka ebilingakami bitolongamesomo, Toloto twa twakotwako totolalyomo.
english: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

lokele: Balomboki batɔɛnɛ liuwesi lia Mungu.
english: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’” Isaiah 40:3-5

lokele: Eokao Yoane aongakäkä la bikuke ya bato ebayäkä end’inde ndoyalufiomo lande, mbo— Ino lioti lia njɔ; ¿Ndai asokambes’ino mbo bokweke otili nda efango eyekayeke?
english: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

lokele: Eokao biyaelo yanu bienganeke la likalangani lianu. Wakolëke ndoonga nda betema yanu mbo— Abalayama ende ngau wasu, eoka isoonga lanu mbo— Mungu asokɔkɔlɔ ko la batalɛ-ba kongo ndoemesela Abalayama bana.
english: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

lokele: Kwani shondo sisotomo oko nda biili ya tosandu la isandu la isandu esiitoota tuma tolau, shao kotindomo, shao koumbolomo nda bösä.
english: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”

lokele: Bato ba bikuke bafeläk’inde mbo— ¿Tokeleke to moni?
english: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”

lokele: Inde lomutoel’iyo mbo— Boto oyayali la bisinda imbale ya likolo, afek’inde oyati la esinda ɛmɔi ya likolo, la boto oyayali la bieka yola, akaeleke inde oyati la yao.
english: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”

lokele: Lamao basombesi imɔ loya oyalufiomo, iyo loonga mbo— ¿Boekesi, tokeleke moni?
english: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”

lokele: Inde loonga to lau, mbo— Wɔnɔkɔlɛ̈kɛ bieto yoetela loketi lona elosotinyomo bɔsɔmbi.
english: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”

lokele: La basilikani imɔ lofel’inde mbo— ¿La iso imɔ, tokeleke moni? Inde loonga lau mbo— Owangatalesëke oto la lisusumani, owanjakalëke oto mbo ɔsɛkɛ bieto yande, laka ko bieto ya likuwa lianu la wɛlï.
english: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”

lokele: Bato baenyakeläkä la tɔɛli la batakanäkä fee nda betema loasɔ loa Yoane, mbo eluwa atayala Masiya kwa ndai,
english: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

lokele: eokao Yoane lomutokolak’iyo mbo— Imi nd’asolufia ino la balia, kongo ko oyatoya liili liami nd’asoeta’mi la bofoka; itiengane ndofomo isosha shofaikola ikulu sha tokwaka twande; Inde elufiaka ino la Bolimo Botanu la bösä.
english: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.

lokele: Lüngu loande lole nda bosamba wande mbo afɛfɛkɛ bofonga; atɔɔmbɔ ɛfɛfyɛlɔ tanelele, atosɔnja befonga nda ekukyelo yande, kongo ko atofechaka mboso nda bösä wa loiloi ebotilatiamëkë.
english: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

lokele: Ko la tonango wike la baoi basi imɔ, inde lonangoela bato Mboli Ilau.
english: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

lokele: Kongo ko Bɔkɔta Helodi oyafomökö liengo la Yoane loasɔ loa Helodia, wali wa boloo wande, la loasɔ loa bebe bitotina ebiakelak’inde;
english: but Herod the tetrarch, 3:19 being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s 3:19 wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

lokele: atalieläkä nde eloeta loko mbo akandäkä Yoane nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ. Lolufiomo loa Yesu
english: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

lokele: Asiläkä bato batotina ndolufiomo, la alufiomökö Yesu imɔ, aäkä Inde atosombola, kwaamao use loliolomo,
english: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,

lokele: la Bolimo Botanu loaa se ende Inde la bɔfɔɔnɔ kwa ewa ekükü, la limiki lookana nda use mbo— Aɛ wende Wana bosamomu wami, Aɛ nd’atoomalesa’mi finɛ.
english: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”

lokele: Akoläkä Yesu angɛnɛ ndoekekesa bato, ayaläkä la miaka kama isatɔ, batangäk’Inde mbo wana wa Yosefa,
english: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

lokele: wa Elia, wa Matita, wa Lewi, wa Melekia, wa Yanai, wa Yosefa,
english: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

lokele: wa Matatia, wa Amosa, wa Nahuma, wa Asalia, wa Nanga,
english: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

lokele: wa Mata, wa Matatia, wa Simei, wa Yoseke,
english: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

lokele: wa Yuda, wa Yoana, wa Lesa, wa Selubabela, wa Salatiele,
english: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

lokele: wa Nelia, wa Meleka, wa Adi, wa Kosama, wa Elemodada,
english: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

lokele: wa Eli, wa Yosua, wa Elieseke, wa Yolima, wa Matata,
english: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

lokele: wa Lewi, wa Simeona, wa Yuda, wa Yosefa, wa Yoname,
english: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

lokele: wa Eliakima, wa Melea, wa Matata, wa Natana,
english: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

lokele: wa Dawidi, wa Yese, wa Obede, wa Boasa, wa Salamona,
english: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

lokele: wa Nasona, wa Aminadaba, wa Adamini, wa Alana, wa Eselone, wa Pelese,
english: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, 3:33 the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

lokele: wa Yuda, wa Yakobo, wa Yisaka, wa Abalayama, wa Tela, wa Nayolo,
english: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

lokele: wa Selungu, wa Leu, wa Pelenge, wa Ebele,
english: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

lokele: wa Sela, wa Kenana, wa Alufasada, wa Sheme, wa Noa,
english: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

lokele: wa Lemeke, wa Metusala, wa Enoka, wa Yalete, wa Mahalalele,
english: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

lokele: wa Kenana, wa Sete, wa Adamu, wa Mungu.
english: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

lokele: YESU atumesomöko la Bolimo Botanu, limɔ Inde losekwa nda Yaladene la akɛsɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ la Bolimo nda liɔmbɛlɛ
english: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

lokele: ko becho kama inɛi ani atososhelomo la Satana. Inde atialäka bieka ko la becho ena, nde asiläkä yao, limɔ Inde looka isiyɛ.
english: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

lokele: Limɔ Satana loonga la Yesu mbo— Eya to mbo wende Wana wa Mungu, ongaka to mbo e-litalɛ-li likinjweke boila.
english: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lande mbo— Losotomo nda lokasa loa Mungu mbo— Boto aitoyalaka la liwawi ko l’eoka ya beila kongo.
english: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’” Deuteronomy 8:3

lokele: Limɔ inde losulia Yesu likolo, inde lɔɛnɛs’Inde yakakaelo bitoti ya wenda ko la mbile yobebya baiso,
english: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

lokele: la Satana loonga lande mbo— Itof’Aɛ isosha la tala ya bitotina-bi eoka bifomu nde’mi la itofaefa oyakasangeke’mi;
english: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.

lokele: eokao botulamela’mi se, yao bitotina koyala eyaɛ.
english: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lande mbo— Loatomökö nda lokasa loa Mungu mbo— Tulamelaka ngo ko Ngɛnɛ Mungu waɛ se, Semolaka ko Inde kongo.
english: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’” Deuteronomy 6:13

lokele: Limɔ inde lɔkɛsɛ Yesu konda Yelusaleme, inde loemes’Inde olikolo lia losambɔ loa Ndakɔ ya Mungu, inde loonga la Yesu mbo— Eya mbo wende Wana wa Mungu, kushaka bindo yaɛ se,
english: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

lokele: eoka losotomo nda lokasa loa Mungu mbo— Atoonga la bakitomo bande mbo batinganeke laɛ
english: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’

lokele: La batotolak’Aɛ nda besamba yau mbo Otaomana litindi liaɛ nda litalɛ.
english: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’” Psalms 91:11-12

lokele: Yesu lomutola lande mbo— Loaongomökö mbo Ososhelëke Ngɛnɛ Mungu waɛ.
english: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’” Deuteronomy 6:16

lokele: Asiläkä Satana basoshela batotina, limɔ inde losokwa ende Yesu konda fofe yasi. Liakoli lia liekesi lia Yesu nda Ngalilai
english: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loinywa ko la bofoka wa Bolimo konda Ngalilai, la lokuku loande lofafana nda yese etotina etimbi;
english: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

lokele: Inde lokaekese bato nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ yau, Inde loinakelomo la bato batotina.
english: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

lokele: Inde loya nda bokenge wa Nasaleta olo akondeläk’Inde wainɛngɛ; la lise lia Yenga Inde lɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ ya ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ kwa akelakäk’Inde yenga la yenga, Inde loemala omao ndotanga Lokasa loa Mungu.
english: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

lokele: Afomökö lokasa eloatäkä Yesaya ewa Bɔtɔndɔli; Inde loliola loao, Inde loisola elela eyatomokö mbo—
english: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

lokele: Bolimo wa Ngɛnɛ bosɔɔtɛlɛ’mi, Eoka asücha’mi mbo ikambeseke eba touwe mboli ilau, Asotoma’mi mbo iteke boekï mbo ebaindomökö nda bita basotomo se la mbo Eba etuku bɛnɛkɛ liasi; Lofaikolomu imɔ ende ebakongolomökö,
english: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, 4:18 to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

lokele: La mbo iteke boekï wa mwaka wa liendoli lia Ngɛnɛ Mungu.
english: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.” Isaiah 61:1-2

lokele: Inde lolinja lokasa, Inde loinola loao ende botingani wa ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ, Inde loyala se, la baiso ba batotina ebayaläkä nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlo batinganäkä ngo ko lande.
english: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

lokele: Limɔ Inde loakola ndoonga lau, mbo— Louse-lo ino osooka ebaoi-ba basokɔchɔmɔ kɔkɛ.
english: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”

lokele: Iyo batotina loaolel’Inde, iyo lomwaala inango shande sha booto; iyo mbo— Ati to wana wa Yosefa?
english: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Eingoko; otosingwela’mi lilingo-li, liko mbo— Kanga, tuwesaka lokomba loaɛ angɛnɛ; la imɔ mbo— Bitotina ebiokik’iso mbo bikelomuku nda Kafenauma, aɛ kelaka imɔ ko yao ono nda yese yaɛ angɛnɛ.
english: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”

lokele: Inde mbo— Wewe eyetoonga’mi lanu mbo angwɛnɛ bɔtɔndɔli koimelomo la lilitesi nda yese yande angɛnɛ;
english: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

lokele: Itokambes’ino la wewe mbo batika ba batolome baäkä wike nda Isalaele nda bacho ba Eliya, nda mbile eyaliamäkä buse angwɛnɛ mbula ko miaka isatɔ la otüku l’ani löndo lofi loaäkä nda yese etotina.
english: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

lokele: Kongo ko Eliya atiatomomökö ende oto wa Isalaele, kangä ende lotika loa olome loa okenge wa Salefata nda yese ya Sidona.
english: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

lokele: Bato ba baɛndi baäkä wike nda Isalaele nda bacho ba Elisha ewa bɔtɔndɔli, nde angwɛnɛ wau angɔmɔi kotanesomo, sakolo ko Naamana boto wa Sulia.
english: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

lokele: Okäkä batotina ebayaläkä nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ baoi-ba, iyo losoma sasa,
english: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.

lokele: iyo loemakala, iyo lokusol’Inde nda okenge, iyo loiliyak’Inde nda isɔkɔ sha löngo, olo aswomökö okenge wau, mbo bakushek’Inde nda ngolongolo,
english: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

lokele: kongo ko Inde loeta sisi yau fwaa, Inde lotangwa. Yesu louwesa bato la lise lia Yenga
english: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

lokele: Inde lɔkɛ konda Kafenauma, okenge wa Ngalilai, la aekesäk’Inde oekes’iyo la lise lia Yenga,
english: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

lokele: iyo lomwaala liekesi liande finɛ eoka baoi bande baäkä la isosha.
english: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

lokele: Omao nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ aäkä nde oto wa bolimo wa Satana, inde loamama la limiki lifi mbo—
english: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,

lokele: Ao, iso laɛ moni, Aɛ Yesu wa Nasaleta, oyi nde oyasɛɛsɛlɛsɛ iso? Isoluw’Aɛ, wende oyo Botanu wa Mungu.
english: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

lokele: Nde Yesu loima inde mbo— Yalaka tau, kuswaka ende inde. Bolimo lokush’inde se atiteni yau, wao lokuswa ende inde nde atiokes’inde imɔ wale.
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

lokele: Bato batotina lomwaala la liena, iyo lofelana mbo— ¿Boni bɔfɔnɔ wa lioi-li? Eoka ko la isosha la bofoka atoima belimo ebe la yao kokuswa ende bato.
english: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”

lokele: La lokuku loande lomelana nda bilela bitotina bitimbi.
english: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

lokele: Asekwäk’Inde nda ndakɔ ya ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ, Inde lɔɔtɔ ndakɔ ya Simona. La boïli wa Simona aäkä la etao ya likama, iyo lofela Yesu loaso loande.
english: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.

lokele: Inde loemala tina lande. limɔ Inde loimaka etao, la yao lomach’inde; Lisasaya otomali loemala, inde losung’iyo nda ndakɔ.
english: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

lokele: Ilakä buse litele, batotina ebayaläkä la beoto ya ngwo ya bɔfɔnɔ la bɔfɔnɔ, iyo loeshel’Inde bato-ao, Inde lotaliaka iyo bangasa bande, Inde losäsola batotina.
english: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

lokele: Imɔ ko la belimo ya Satana bakuswäkä ende bato wike ani batoamama mbo— Aɛ wende Wana wa Mungu. La Yesu loima iyo, eoka atiamachäk’iyo ndoonga eoka baluwi mbo Inde ende Masiya.
english: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

lokele: Ayäkä bonyanya, Yesu lokuswa nda ndakɔ, Inde lɔkɛ nda liɔmbɛlɛ; limɔ bikuke ya bato lolukak’Inde, iyo loosh’Inde limɔ bakotäkä okufes’Inde mbo atasokwëke end’iyo,
english: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.

lokele: nde Inde loonga lau mbo— Lole loami mbo ikeokanangokole mboli ilau ya Bokota wa Mungu imɔ ko nda bekenge yasi, yatomomökö nde ko l’eoka-ao.
english: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde anangoläkä nda ndakɔ ya ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ nda bekenge ya Ngalilai.
english: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

lokele: Aemaläkä Yesu tina la eliya ya Ngenesaleta bato ba ekuke losɔngɔmɛl’Inde la bokamu mbo bokeke Lioi lia Mungu,
english: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

lokele: Inde lɔɛnɛ biatɔ imbale ebiswami se nda ngɔngɛ, ani baluwi bakwi se okasoola biɛngɔ.
english: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.

lokele: Inde lokwa nda watɔ ebomani la Simona la Inde lofel’inde mbo ailieke sumbu watɔ owale, limɔ Inde loyala se ina, Inde loekesa bato ba ekuke ani ayali nda watɔ.
english: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

lokele: Asiläk’Inde ndoonga lau, Inde loonga la Simona mbo— Kɛsɛkɛ watɔ nda balia ba olundu owale; taka biɛngɔ nda balia oluwa swi.
english: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”

lokele: La Simona lomutola lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, ko la ocho buse ya, kwa eyaluwelik’iso totiole yeka, kongo ko eoka ya lioi liaɛ, itota wɛngɔ nda balia.
english: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”

lokele: Akeläk’iyo ongoma, iyo losamba bolïlye ofi wa swi ebilindani la wɛngɔ, la wao loakola ndotenyatenya,
english: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

lokele: limɔ iyo lota basaɔ bau lioi ebayaläkä nda watɔ ebɔmɔi mbo bayeke oyasung’iyo. Iyo loya, iyo lotumesa biatɔ imbale la swi la yao yasiakoliya.
english: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

lokele: Kongo ko ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ Simona Petelo ongoma, inde lokwa balui se oso wa Yesu, inde mbo— Sekwaka ende’mi, Ngɛnɛ, eoka yende boto obe.
english: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”

lokele: Eoka inde la ebayalani lande, iyo lotwa liena lia losambo lofi loa swi eloasambäk’iyo,
english: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

lokele: imɔ ko la Yakobo la Yoane bana ba Sebedayo ebayalanäkä lau nda botükä, iyo lotwa liena. Yesu loonga nde la Simona mbo— Owangëke, konda louse waluwa nde bato la liwawi.
english: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”

lokele: Asuliäk’iyo biatɔ nda ngɔngɛ, iyo lomachaka bitotina, iyo lotutaka Yesu. Boto wa Baɛndi
english: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

lokele: Ayaläkä Yesu nda okenge ɔmɔi, futuku boto wa baɛndi bawau loya; la ɛnɛ̈k’inde wɛnɛ Yesu, inde lotulia bɔmbɔ se konda nyɛlɛ, inde lolɔmbɔkɔlɔ Yesu mbo— Ngɛnɛ, bɔlɛmbɛ, Aɛ kokɔkɔlɔ ndotanesa’mi.
english: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

lokele: Yesu lonanola bosamba, Inde lomat’inde, Inde mbo— Ilɛmbi nde ongoma, tanesomoko to.
english: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

lokele: Lisasaya baɛndi losokwa end’inde. Yesu loima inde mbo— Okambesëke oto angɔmɔi, nde kɛndɛkɛ okatamba bindo yaɛ ende kanga la faefaka Mungu lifaefi kwa atäkä Mose ekela eoka ya lotaneso loaɛ, kwa ndembe ende bato.
english: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

lokele: Kongo ko mboli yande lomelana yoeta eyaoso, la bikuke bifi ya bato loyasɔngɔmɔ end’Inde ndooka Inde la ndouwekesomo ngwo yau.
english: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

lokele: Nde Yesu loisamaka nda liɔmbɛlɛ, Inde losombokola omao. Boto wa Lonyango
english: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

lokele: Loaäkä nde lise limɔi, aekesäk’Inde bato, mbo BaFalusi la Baekesi ba bikela bayaläkä se tina, ebasokwäkä nda bekenge bitotina ya Ngalilai la Yudea la Yelusaleme la bofoka wa Mungu loyala la Yesu mbo uweseke bato.
english: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

lokele: Futuku, batolome bamɔi loeshel’Inde boto oyaingesomu nda tange la loo loa lonyango; iyo loluka mboka yɔɔtɛs’inde nda ndakɔ mbo basɛlɛk’inde se oso wa baiso ba Yesu.
english: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

lokele: Atiɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ bato mboka yɔtɛs’inde eoka ya bokamu, iyo lolila olikolo lia losambo, iyo losulol’inde se nda tange ko la lifola nda losambo, inde loaa se, sisi yau, oso wa baiso ba Yesu.
english: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.

lokele: Ɛnɛkɛ Yesu liimeli liau, Inde loonga lande mbo— Boto, njasɔ ibe yaɛ bisomɛsɛlɔmɔ.
english: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”

lokele: Nde Batikasa la BaFalusi loakola ndofelana la fee, mbo— ¿Ndai-yo oyasosɛɔlɔ Mungu? ¿Ndai atokɔkɔlɔ ndomɛsɛlɛ njasɔ ibe, sakolo ngo ko Mungu angɛnɛ?
english: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”

lokele: Nde aluwäkä Yesu baenyeli bau ba fee, Inde lomutoela iyo mbo—, ¿Monito osota fee nda betema yanu?
english: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

lokele: ¿Loni losoeta la bɔlɛmbu, kwa ndoonga mbo— Njasɔ ibe yaɛ bisomɛsɛlɔmɔ, kwa ndoonga mbo— Emalaka la tangwaka?
english: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?

lokele: Kongo ko, mbo boluwesomoko mbo Wana wa boto ale l’isosha shomɛsɛlɛ njasɔ ibe ono se, Inde loonga la ewa lonyango mbo— Imi mbo— Emalaka, ilaka tange yaɛ, kɛndɛkɛ nda ndakɔ yaɛ.
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”

lokele: Lisasaya inde loemala oso wau, inde loila tange eyaingaelak’inde, inde lotangwa nda ndakɔ yande, ani atoinela Mungu la limɛngɔ.
english: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

lokele: La iyo yaatotina lomwaala, iyo loinela Mungu ko la bɔwa, iyo mbo— Tosɔɛnɛ to tolombo louse. Lotomo-lioi loa Lewi
english: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”

lokele: Mbisa ya loasɔ-lo, Yesu lokuswa nda ndakɔ; limɔ Inde loɛnɛ oto ɔmɔi, bɔsɔmbɛsi ako Lewi, ani ayaläkä se nda ɛsɔnjɛlɔ ya bosombi, la Inde loonga lande mbo— Tutaka’mi.
english: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

lokele: Lewi lomacha eyande bitotina, inde loemala, inde lotuta Yesu.
english: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

lokele: La Lewi lokeela Yesu elambɔ efi nda ndakɔ yande, la ekuke efi ya bɛsombɛsi la basi imɔ loyala se ndola bieka amamwito lau.
english: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

lokele: Nde Batikasa la BaFalusi bau loimaimela baeki bande, mbo— ¿Monito botola la botomwa amamwito la bato babe?
english: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— Ebale la bosasu baitolüka bonganga, kangä eba kambo.
english: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

lokele: Itiye ndoyata eba liengani lioi, kangä bato ba njasɔ ibe mbo bakalanganeke.
english: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”

lokele: Nde iyo loonga lande mbo— Baeki ba Yoane batokilakaka bieka la batosombokolaka, la baeki ba BaFalusi ko ongoma, kongo ko baeki baɛ batolakaka la batomwakaka.
english: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga lau mbo— ¿Atoyalaka tolesani amamwito la oyatosɔngɔ, otokɔkɔlɔ nde ndokufesa iyo mbo batala bieka?
english: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

lokele: Nde bacho beyaka nde ani bɔsɔngi atɔɔnɔkɔlɔmɔ end’iyo, limɔ ko nda lise lina iyo kokila bieka.
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

lokele: Yesu lokambes’iyo imɔ ko bombila, mbo— Boto aitowamba esinda ya liɔmbɔ la yaki ya esinda eyai; ekela ongoma, ani eyeyai etosalyaka la imɔ yaki eyesekwi nda eyeyai angosangan’imɔ la eya liɔmbɔ.
english: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

lokele: Boto aitoangola bänä bayai nda biuku ebisoumwa eoka mbo bänä bataacha biuku limɔ bänä batowɛlɛkɛmɛ se la biuku imɔ kowa.
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.

lokele: Nde bänä bayai batowɛlɔmɔ nda biuku biyai. Boto oyasomwa bänä ba lilaka, angooka yɛmɛ yomwaka ebayai, eoka atoonga mbo— Eba oso bako lilaka basolonga l’olau.
english: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

lokele: Etakä Yesu la lise lia Yenga nda bilanga ya bangwindi, baeki bande lotwa bangwindi, iyo loowaka bao nda bangasa, iyo lola bao.
english: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

lokele: Nde BaFalusi bamɔi loonga lau mbo— Monito bosotefola liti lia Yenga?
english: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

lokele: Nde Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— ¿Otitange ango lona eloakeläkä Dawidi, inde l’ebaäkä lande, la lise eliayaläk’iyo la isiyɛ?
english: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

lokele: Mbo inde lɔɔtɛlɛ ndakɔ ya Mungu la inde lɔɔsɔ la inde lola lituma eliatambomokö nda mɛsa ya Mungu, la inde lofaefa ebayaläkä amamwito lande ani liti yolomo sakolo ko la kanga angɛnɛ?
english: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Wana-wa-Boto nd’ayali Ngɛnɛ wa Yenga. Boto wa bosamba bɔlɛmbɛtɛ
english: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

lokele: Lise liasi lia Yenga aɔtɔ̈kɔ̈ Inde nda ndakɔ ya ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ ndoekesa bato, boto loyala omao la aäkä nde la bosamba wa olome ewalɛmbɛtɛ̈kɛ̈.
english: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

lokele: Batikasa la BaFalusi lolamba Yesu eluwa atouwes’inde la lise lia Yenga, mbo bɛnɛkɛ fofe yowanjel’Inde.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

lokele: Nde Inde lolüwa baenyeli bau, Inde loonga la boto wa bosamba bɔlɛmbɛtɛ mbo— Emalaka, yauku eya nd’atiteni. Inde loemala, inde lɔkɛ atiteni yau.
english: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lau mbo— Isofel’ino mbo loengani nde la bikela ya Yenga, kwa ndokela olau, kwa ndokela obe? Kwa ndouwesa oto kwa ndoola oto?
english: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

lokele: Yesu lomwɛlɛ iyo yatotina, limɔ Inde loonga la boto mbo— Nanolaka bosamba waɛ; inde lokela ongoma la wao losäsa.
english: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

lokele: Kongo ko iyo lotuma la luno la iyo lofelana nda loaso elokakelek’iyo la Yesu. Yesu loaa Baeki bande liu la ambale
english: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

lokele: Nda bacho-ba Inde lɔkɛ nda löngo, lise limɔi, okasombokola Mungu, Inde loumwa bocho bototina omao nda lisomboli.
english: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

lokele: Limɔ nda mbile ya bonyanya, Inde lota baeki bande lioi, Inde loaa liu la ambale ende iyo, Inde lof’iyo lina liasi mbo Batomomu; bako
english: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

lokele: Simona (Inde lot’inde imɔ lina liko Petelo), la etungani yande ako Andelo; la Yakobo, la Yoane, la Filipo, la Balatomayo;
english: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

lokele: la Matayo la Toma, la Yakobo wana wa Alufayo, la Simona oyatangomökö Selote, la
english: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;

lokele: Yuda wana wa Yakobo, la Yuda wa Keliota oyawambäkä Yesu.
english: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

lokele: Yesu losokwa nda löngo amamwito lau, Inde loemala nda loanyake amamwito lau la ekuke efi ya bato ba Yudea la Yelusaleme l’eba ngɔngɛ ya Tuloa la Sidona ebayäkä ndoyok’Inde la ndoyuwesomo ngwo yau;
english: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,

lokele: la bato ebawäkä la belimo ya bɔwɛwɛ louwekesomo.
english: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.

lokele: Batotina lokotaka ndomata Yesu, eoka bofoka wakuswäkä ndouwekesa batotina. Inango sha Yesu nda Löngo
english: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

lokele: Inde loɛlɛlɛ baeki bande, limɔ Inde loonga mbo— Limɛngɔ lile l’eba touwe, eoka Bɔkɔta wa Mungu bole wanu,
english: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.

lokele: Limɛngɔ lile lanu ebatooka isiyɛ kwani, eoka bokaneloko. Limɛngɔ lile lanu ebatolela ndeli kwani, eoka bosɛkɛkɛ.
english: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

lokele: Limɛngɔ lile lanu ani batoiyel’ino, l’ani batosayak’ino, L’ani batomɔlɔk’ino, l’ani batosingwaka baina banu kwa bɛkɛcha, Ko l’eoka ya Wana wa Boto;
english: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

lokele: Yaimwesaka betema yanu yai la lise lina; tondwaka la limɛngɔ, Tɛnɛngɔ, bondanda wanu wende ofi nda use; eoka batata bau bakeeläkä batɔndɔli ko ongoma.
english: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

lokele: Aeko wale nde end’ino ebafoka, eoka osɔɔlɔ ndɔɔlɔ bosungi wanu;
english: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

lokele: Aeko wale lanu ebasokanelo kwani, eoka bokeke nde tosiyɛ. Aeko wale end’ino ebatosɛkɛ twɛlɔ kwani eoka bolelaka ndeli.
english: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

lokele: Aeko wale end’ino ani bato batotina batoinakel’ino, eoka batata bau bakeeläkä batɔndɔli ba bolimbake ko ongoma.
english: Woe, 6:26 when 6:26 men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

lokele: Kongo ko end’ino ebatooka’mi kwani, itoonga mbo— Samaka baiyani lanu; keelaka ebatoiyel’ino ko bolau;
english: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

lokele: fotesaka ebatomɔlɔkɔ ino, la somboelak’iyo ebatoluk’ino bɔfi.
english: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

lokele: Boto eoma aɛ nda likɛkɛ limɔi, tambak’inde elimɔi; boto oyatɔɔnɔkɔlɔkɔ aɛ kanjo, ofekelëk’inde imɔ ko esinda yaɛ.
english: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

lokele: Faefaka ebatömb’aɛ yeka; boto ɛɔnɔkɔlɔ biengo yaɛ, wömbëk’imɔ inde yao.
english: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

lokele: Ebisolɛmb’ino mbo bato bakeelek’ino, keelak’iyo ko ongoma.
english: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

lokele: ¿Bosama ebatosam’ino, wende to booto w’iye? Eoka ango bato abe batosamana l’ebatosam’imɔ ko iyo.
english: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

lokele: ¿Bokeela booto ende ebatokeela imɔ ko ino booto, bole to boni bɔfɔnɔ wa booto? Eoka bato abe batokela imɔ ko ongoma.
english: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

lokele: ¿Bofa belima ende bato ani wende l’iyɛli shoɔsɔ yao liasi, bole la booto w’iye? Ango bato abe batofaekefa bato abe belima mbo baɔlɛkɛ imɔ ko bieto-ao liasi.
english: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.

lokele: Samaka nde ebatoiyel’ino, keelak’iyo booto, fak’iyo belima, owëke esole, limɔ bondanda ebotɔɔlɔ ino boyala nde bofi la ino boyalaka bana ba Mungu Ofi, eoka Inde angɛnɛ atolelaka booto ende ebati la wao la ende bato babe imɔ.
english: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

lokele: Yalanaka to la booto kwa ayali Sango wanu imɔ la booto.
english: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

lokele: Ofëke bato baɛngɔ lifëlä; ofëke bato se lifëlä mbo ino imɔ botafomo se; mɛsɛlɛkɛ bato limɔ ino bomɛsɛlɔmɔkɔ;
english: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

lokele: faefaka bato bafi, limɔ ino bofaefomoko imɔ ko ikweelo esisotumaka fuu, esisɔɔlwa kwa bofonga ebosowamomo nda ikweelo esisoelwaka, botofomo lilya. Eoka ikweelo esitokweel’ino ende basi, ino nd’atokweelomo ngo ko la shao.
english: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. 6:38 For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

lokele: Inde lotel’iyo bombila imɔ, mbo— ¿Boto wa botuku atokɔkɔlɔ ndotola ewa botuku oso nda mboka? ¿Mbo iyo yaambale angokekelana nda liyöndo?
english: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

lokele: Boeki aitolongela Boekesi wande, kongo ko boeki la boeki oyasɔɔlɔlɔ liekesi, inde koengana Boekesi wande.
english: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

lokele: ¿Monito ototicha lofututi elole nda liso lia etungani yaɛ ani oitolembeela bokangela ebole nda liso liaɛ angɛnɛ?
english: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

lokele: ¿Monito otokɔkɔlɔ ndoonga la etungani yaɛ mbo— Machaka’mi isokoleke lofututi elole nda liso liaɛ, ani aɛ angɛnɛ otiɛnɛ bokangela ebole nda eliaɛ liso? Aɛ bolimbakeli, taɔmɔlɔkɔ bokangela ebole nda liso liaɛ angɛnɛ, limɔ aɛ otɔɛnɛ sandelele ndɔɔmɔlɔ lofututi elole nda liso lia etungani yaɛ.
english: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

lokele: Isandu silau siitota tuma tobe, la isandu esisɔɔlɔ siitota tuma tolau,
english: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

lokele: eoka isandu la isandu sisoluwana ngo ko la tuma twa shao angɛnɛ. Bato baitotwaka sau nda toilaila la baitotwaka toyayöliki nda toyangiakau.
english: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

lokele: Boto olau atokusokola ko bolau ebototumesa bondanda wa botema wande, la boto obe atokusokola ko bobe wa bondanda bobe nda botema wande, eoka bonɔkɔ nd’atoongaka ko yao ebitotumekesa botema. Besweli imbale ya ndakɔ
english: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

lokele: ¿Monito ototangaka’mi mbo Ngɛnɛ, Ngɛnɛ, ani otikele yao ebitoonga’mi?
english: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

lokele: Oyatoya ende’mi ndoyaoka baoi bami, nde kokelaka bao, Imi nd’atɔɛnɛs’ino ani ayali inde.
english: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

lokele: Ende kwa oto oyaswäkä ndakɔ, inde lofuwaka ndoko bilundu, inde loswa yao se suu nda batälɛ; limɔ ayäkä fela, botima losecha sondwäsondwä nda ndakɔ ena, angokɔkɔlɔ ndolɛlɛsɛ yao, eoka yao loswama se suu nda batälɛ.
english: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

lokele: Kongo ko oyatooka baoi bami, nde aitokela bao, ayali kwa oto oyaswäkä ndakɔ yande olikolo lia nyɛlɛ, angwɛnɛ eswelo ya batälɛ, limɔ botima losecha sondwäsondwä la yao loukwa kwuu futuku, lowɛlɔmɔ se loa likama.
english: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”

lokele: Asiläkä Yesu tonango twande tototina nda lioki lia bato, Inde lɔɔtɔ bokenge wa Kafenauma.
english: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

lokele: Bɔkɔwa wa Komanda ɔmɔi ayaläkä la loo lowaü tina lowa, la Komanda loyala lande l’itimya,
english: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

lokele: okaka to Komanda lokuku loa Yesu, inde lotoma biange ya BaYuda ende Inde ndofel’Inde mbo ayeke ndoyuwesa bɔkɔwa wande.
english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

lokele: Iyäk’iyo ende Yesu, iyo lolɔmbɔkɔl’Inde la boliliya, mbo— Aondu nde mbo Yesu akeelek’inde eloasɔ-lo,
english: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

lokele: eoka asami nde tukela yasu la inde angɛnɛ nd’asoswel’iso ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ yasu.
english: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lɔkɛsɛnɛ lau la aäkä Inde at’imɔ esika la ndakɔ, Komanda lotoma baina lande ende Yesu, iyo loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, wokëke bosoi woya eyami, eoka itiengane mbo ɔɔtɛkɛ ose ya bɔtɔndɔ wami;
english: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

lokele: eokao itifaeme mbo iondu nde ndoya imi angɛnɛ end’Aɛ, nde ongaka ngo lioi kongo, limɔ wana wami kosäsolomo;
english: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

lokele: eoka imi angɛnɛ yende boto wolitesa isosha la yende imɔ la basilikani ose yami, la yeonga la ɔmɔi mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ, limɔ atɔkɛ; la ende wasi mbo— Yauku, inde atoya; la ende bɔkɔwa wami mbo— Kelaka lona, limɔ atokela loao.
english: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

lokele: Okäkä Yesu baoi-ba Inde lomwaala, Inde lokikwela ebatutani lande, Inde mbo— Isoonga lanu mbo ikoshi kɔni liimeli lifi ongoma ango ende bato ba Isalaele angɛnɛ.
english: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

lokele: Ainwäkä ebatomomökö nda ndakɔ, iyo loosha bɔkɔwa ani asokwelo oko bosasu bolau. Louweso loa Wana wa botomali wa lotika
english: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

lokele: Mbisa ya becho bimɔi, Yesu lɔkɛ nda bokenge ewatangomökö mbo Naina la baeki bande la ekuke ya bato imɔ lɔkɛsɛnɛ lande.
english: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

lokele: Iyäkä Inde tina la bome nda liko lia bokenge, iyo lotowana la bolyo ewatolomökö nda liömbi; aäkä wana ɔmwitoto wa nyango la nyango wande aäkä lotika la ekuke efi ya bato ba okenge bɔäkä lande.
english: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born 7:12 son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

lokele: La ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ Ngɛnɛ Yesu wɛnɛ otomali, Inde loonga lande mbo— Olelëk’imɔ.
english: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

lokele: Inde losishana tina la Inde lomata shange eshatolomökö la bolyo, limɔ ebatoläkä shao losikama. Limɔ Inde loonga mbo— Isenge, itoonga laɛ mbo— Emalaka;
english: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

lokele: limɔ inde oyawäkä loemesa bɔkɔngɔ, inde loakola ndoonga la Yesu lof’inde ende nyango wande.
english: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.

lokele: Batotina lowa bɔwa finɛ, iyo loinakela Mungu, iyo mbo— Bɔtɔndɔli ofi asotɛmwa sisi yasu; la imɔ mbo— Mungu asoyela bato bande.
english: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

lokele: Mboli yande lomelana nda kenge bitotina ya Yudea la nda biese bitimbi. Wɛndi wa Yoane Bolufi
english: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.

lokele: Baeki ba Yoane lokakambes’inde ebitotina-bi,
english: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

lokele: limɔ Yoane lota baeki bande bambale lioi, inde lotom’iyo wɛndi ende Ngɛnɛ Yesu, mbo— ¿Aɛ nd’ale Inde oyakayeke, kwa mbo tolukeke wasi?
english: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

lokele: Iyaka iyo ende Yesu, iyo mbo— Yoane Bolufi asotom’iso end’Aɛ ndoonga laɛ mbo— ¿Aɛ nd’ale Inde oyakayeke kwa mbo tolukeke wasi?
english: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

lokele: Ko la mbile-ao Inde louwesa bato wike ba ngwo la biale la belimo ebe, la Inde lofaka bato b’etuku wike liɛni ndoɛnɛ liasi.
english: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lomutola lau mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ okakambesa Yoane ebisɔɛnɛ ino la ebisook’ino, mbo eba betuku basɔɛnɛ liasi, eba bikoti basokɛndɛ fii, eba baɛndi basotanesomo, eba biökö basooka, ebawi basoemesomo yai, la eba touwe basonangoelomo Mboli Ilau.
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

lokele: Limɛngɔ lile la oto ona oyaitɔɛnɛ tale eoka yami.
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

lokele: Atangwäkä eba wɛndi ba Yoane, Yesu loakola ndoonga la bikuke ya bato loasɔ loa Yoane, Inde mbo— ¿Ino waɛ̈kɛ̈ nda liɔmbɛlɛ okɛnɛ iye? ¿Mbo liangala elisolɛlɛlɛ la lofofo?
english: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

lokele: ¿Waɛ̈kɛ̈ nde okɛnɛ iye to? ¿Mbo oto oyawati bisinda ya bɔfɛkɔ? Tɛnɛ ngo, ebatowata bisinda ya bɔfɛkɔ, la bafofa yeka, iyo ana bayali nda ndakɔ ya bɛkɔta.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.

lokele: ¿Nde waɛ̈kɛ̈ okɛnɛ iye to? Okɛnɛ bɔtɔndɔli? Eingo ko, Imi mbo— Asolongela Bɔtɔndɔli finɛ.
english: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

lokele: Ende inde oyatelomökö nda lokasa mbo— Tɛnɛ, itotoma wɛndi oso waɛ, Oyatokakomya mboka yaɛ oso waɛ.
english: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’ Malachi 3:1
