lokele: Isoonga lanu mbo— Angwɛnɛ boto oyasootomo la otomali, asɔɛnɛlɛ wolongela Yoane Bolufi, kongo ko inde oyayali ewa liili nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu asolongela Yoane.
english: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

lokele: Okäkä bato batotina l’eba besombesi elioi-li, iyo lokulia likomyi lia Mungu eoka balufiomokö la Yoane,
english: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

lokele: kongo ko BaFalusi la Baekesi ba Bikela lofeka likomyi liande loaso loau, eoka batialufiomökö lande.
english: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

lokele: ¿Itokweela to efɛtɔ-ye l’iye? ¿Bende kwa bandai?
english: 7:31 “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

lokele: Bende kwa bana ebasoyalaka se nda liongo, batotakana la baina lau lioi mbo— Tosoomel’ino bofilingi, nde otiineke bisha, Tosoleel’ino etondo, nde otiomakeke yɛlɔ nda ewa.
english: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’

lokele: Nde Yoane Bolufi ayiki, atile lituma, atimwe bänä, nde ino koonga mbo— Ale la bolimo obe.
english: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

lokele: Wana wa Boto asoya, atola la atomwa, nde ino mbo— Tɛnɛ ngo afofa la bowi bänä, lisaɔ lia basɔnji ba bosombi la bato babe.
english: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’

lokele: Nde Wɛlï wa Mungu bosoluwana olau ko la bekeeli ya wao. Botomali losoola batindi ba Yesu
english: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”

lokele: Ɔmɔi wa BaFalusi lofela Yesu mbo aleke bieka lande la Inde lɔkɛ nda ndakɔ ya ewa BaFalusi; ayaläk’Inde se ndola,
english: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

lokele: kwaamao otomali wa okenge oyayali otomali obe, aluwäkä inde mbo Yesu akola bieka nda ndakɔ ya ewa BaFalusi, inde loya la isako sha litalɛ sha baningo ba liɛsɛ,
english: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

lokele: inde loemala ombisa ya batindi ba Yesu; aleläkä botomali, foo yande loakola ndotonyaka nda batindi ba Yesu; otomali lɔɔmbɔkɔlɔ batindi la swee yande bisa la inde loumba batindi la bɔnɔkɔ la inde losingɔlɔ bao la baningo.
english: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ ewa BaFalusi oyafeläk’Inde nda bieka elokeli otomali, inde loenyela nda botema mbo, eya to mbo oyo ende Bɔtɔndɔli ani aluwiki otomali-yo la boyaeli wande mbo ende botomali obe.
english: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

lokele: Nde Yesu lomutoela lienyeli liande, mbo— Simona, yende la lioi lionga laɛ. Inde mbo— Ongaka to, Boekesi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

lokele: Yesu mbo— Bato bambale baɔsɔ̈kɔ̈ bieto belima ende oto ɔmɔi oyafakäkä sɔmbya; ɔmɔi aɔsɔ̈kɔ̈ falanga pata mia bɔɔmwi, la ɔmɔi pata kama bɔɔmwi.
english: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

lokele: Kongo ko eoka batiaäkä la bieto yokamba belima, inde lɔmɛsel’iyo yaambale. ¿Ndai to wau yaambale atosamak’inde la losamɔ loeta?
english: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

lokele: Simona lomutola mbo— Itangi nde mbo oto ona oyamɛsɛlɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ bieto eyoeta. Yesu loonga lande mbo— Lioi liaɛ liengani chaa.
english: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lokikwa ende botomali ani Inde loonga la Simona mbo— Otitiche ebotomali-bo? Imi iɔtiki nda ndakɔ yaɛ, nde otife’mi balia bosoola batindi bami, kongo ko botomali asotonyaka batindi bami la foo yande la asɔɔmbɔkɔlɔ bao la swee yande.
english: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

lokele: Aɛ otiumbeke’mi bɔnɔkɔ wonyangela’mi, nde konda baɔtɛlɔ bami, botomali-yo akamachi ndumbaka batindi bami.
english: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

lokele: Aɛ otisingɔlɛ baita nde botö wami, kongo ko botomali-yo asingɔli nde batindi bami la baningo.
english: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

lokele: Eokao to itoonga laɛ mbo— Batwanelo bande kwa ayali bao wike, bimɛsɛlɔmuku nde, eoka losamɔ loande loende lofi; nde oto oyasomɛsɛlɔmɔ ko sinyo, oyo asami ko sinyo kongo.
english: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga la botomali mbo— Batwanelo babe baɛ basomɛsɛlɔmɔ.
english: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

lokele: Limɔ bato ebaäkä omao ndolaka bieka lande, iyo loongana mbo— Oyo to ende ndai oyatomɛsɛlɛ ango batwanelo babe? Limɔ Yesu loonga la botomali, mbo— Liimeli liaɛ lisouwes’aɛ, kɛndɛkɛ la lilatemi.
english: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

lokele: Mbisa ya mbile ɛmɔi, Yesu lotandekela yese, bokenge la bokenge l’ebofi l’ebɔkɛkɛ olo anangokoläka la aluwesäkä bato Mboli Ilau ya Bɔkɔta wa Mungu; la eba liu la ambale lɔkɛsɛnɛ lande amamwito
english: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,

lokele: la batomali bamɔi ebuwesäkä Yesu ouwes’iyo la belimo ebe la kambo, batomali bako— Maliya oyatangomu wa Mangandala oyasokolomökö belimo ebe bosambale,
english: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

lokele: la Yoana wali wa Chusa ako Bonyafala wa Bɔkɔta Helodi, la Susana la batomali basi wike ebasungäkä iyo ko la biengo (la bieto) yau angɛnɛ. Bombila wa Bɔlɔi
english: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them 8:3 from their possessions.

lokele: Bokamu wa bato lolingelaka Yesu amamwito l’ebaɛ̈kɛ̈ ende Inde ba bekenge bitotina la Inde loekes’iyo ko la bombila-bo, mbo—
english: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:

lokele: Bɔlɔi lɔkɛ okalɔɔ koto, alɔɔ̈kɔ̈ inde ongoma, koto bimɔi lokwa nda mboka la yao yamatelomökö limɔ nɔli lola yao.
english: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

lokele: Bimɔi lokwa nda batalɛ la kwa ɔtɔkɔ yao, lisasaya yao lobɛɛkɛlɛ fɛɛ eoka angwɛnɛ ɛfɔfya.
english: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

lokele: Bimɔi lokwa nda kɛ̈kɛ̈, la kɛ̈kɛ̈ lɔɔ̈tɔ̈ amamwito la yao, la kɛ̈kɛ̈ lɔnyɛlɛ koto.
english: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.

lokele: Nde bimɔi lokwa nda nyɛlɛ ilau, yao lɔɔ̈tɔ̈, yao lota tuma, bimɔi kama liu. Aongäk’Inde wa, Inde loamama mbo— Oyale la batoi booka, okeke.
english: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

lokele: La baeki lofel’Inde litina lia bombila-bo.
english: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”

lokele: Inde mbo— End’ino kongo njasɔ ebisoisomo ya Bɔkɔta wa Mungu, yao koisolomo; kongo ende bato basi ambo bembila kongo, eoka mbo batɔɛnɛ liɛnɛ̈lɛ̈ la batoka ko liokɛ̈lä; angoluwa litina.
english: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’ Isaiah 6:9

lokele: Kongo ko litina lia bombila lile mbo— Koto bile lioi lia Mungu.
english: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

lokele: Ebakwäkä nda mboka, bende ebokaka lioi, limɔ Satana koya oyaɔnɔkɔlɔ lioi nda betema yau mbo bataimela la mbo batauwesomo.
english: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

lokele: Ebakwäkä nda batälɛ bende iyo ebokäkä lioi, iyo loaola liao la limɛngɔ, kongo ko bati la biili limɔ batoimela ko mbile bimɔi, nde atoya lisoshela limɔ batokwa se.
english: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

lokele: Ebakwäkä nda kɛ̈kɛ̈ bende iyo ebokäkä lioi nde atɔkɛ iyo eyau, batonyɛɛkɛlɔmɔ la bifembi la bieto la bamɛngɔ ya wenda-bo limɔ koto angota tuma tooku.
english: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.

lokele: Nde ebakwäkä nda nyɛlɛ ilau, bende iyo ebokäkä lioi la botema ɔmwito wa bolau, la batotingana la liao la batota tuma ko la likɔkɔmɛlɛ.
english: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.

lokele: Atoanesa oto paka, aitolinja yao la ɛɛngɔ; aitoisa yao ose ya tange, nde inde kosɛlɛ yao nda yɛnɛsɛlɔ mbo ebatɔɔtɔ ndakɔ bɛnɛkɛ liameli lia paka.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

lokele: Angɔɛnɛ loasɔ loisami sakolo ko loao kɔɛnɛlɛ swa, angɔɛnɛ loasɔ loa wisakumbo, sakolo ko loao koisolomo mbo loluwaneke fololo.
english: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.

lokele: Eokao tinganaka ani atook’ino, eoka end’inde oyale la yeka, efomoko nde yasi; nde oyati la yeka, yao eyetangi inde mbo asɔsɛlɛ, yao ina kɔɔnɔkɔlɔmɔ end’inde.
english: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”

lokele: Limɔ nyango wande la bitungani yande loya end’Inde nde batiakɔkɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ oyatowana lande eoka ya ekuke ya bato.
english: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

lokele: Nde bakambesäk’Inde mbo— Nyango waɛ la bitungani yaɛ baemakali lousa la balɛmbi ndɔɛnɛ Aɛ.
english: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

lokele: La inde lomutoel’iyo mbo— Nyango wami la bitungani yami bende ko iyo ebatooka lioi lia Mungu la ebatolitesa liao. Yesu lɔɔngɛsɛ lomba nda Eliya
english: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

lokele: Lise limɔi Inde lokwa nda watɔ amamwito la baeki bande, la Inde loonga lau mbo— Tolekeke nda boili wasi wa eliya. Iyo loilia owale,
english: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.

lokele: nde aɛk’iyo, Yesu lokwa ilɔ, lomba lofi lokwaka nda eliya la watɔ loakola otuma la balia la basiäkä oliya.
english: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

lokele: Iyo loyasisɔl’Inde, iyo mbo— Bokota, Bokota, tososɛɛsɛlɛ. Limɔ Inde loemala, Inde loimaka lomba loa lofofo la batutu ba balia la bao lotemba tembelele, lomba lolatema late.
english: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm. See Psalms 107:29

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Liimeli lianu anima? Iyo lowänga finɛ, iyo lomwaala ani iyo loongana mbo— ¿Ende to ndai-yo, eoka atoima ngomba la balia, la bao kolites’Inde? Boto wa Bolimo Bobe
english: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”

lokele: Baiyäkä nda yese ya BaKelasene eyele owale wa eliya ya Ngalilai.
english: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

lokele: Asaowäkä Yesu nda boili, oto ɔmɔi wa bokenge ona oyaɔtɛlɔmɔ̈kɔ la belimo ebe loyatowana lande; ko mbile yumwa atiawatäkä bisinda la inde angoyalaka nda ndakɔ, kangä nda fowa biko sai.
english: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ inde wɛnɛ Yesu, inde loamama, inde lokwa se oso wande, inde loonga la limiki lifi mbo— ¿Iso laɛ twende la loni loaso, Aɛ Yesu wana wa Mungu Oyalongeli? Itoomb’Aɛ mbo wokesëke’mi bïale.
english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”

lokele: Eokao Yesu loonga la bolimo obe mbo akusweke ende boto, eoka bolimo obe loundes’inde baunda wike kwa atingakanomoko inde la bato ebakandakäk’inde la bɛnyɔlɔlɔ la bakala, nde inde lounyaka bakala, inde lokɛsɔmɔkɔ la bolimo konda liɔmbɛlɛ.
english: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

lokele: Yesu lofel’inde mbo— ¿Lina liaɛ liko ndai? Inde mbo— Mbo Legione, litina mbo— Botükä, eoka botükä wa belimo bosɔɔtɛl’inde;
english: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.

lokele: la yao losombola Yesu finɛ mbo atatel’iyo ekela yokɛ nda liyondo eliti la tungä.
english: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

lokele: Liyasa lifi lia ndei liaäkä nda löngo, bialäkä bieka ina la belimo losombol’Inde mbo akuliek’iyo mbo baɔtɛlɛkɛ ndei ina.
english: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.

lokele: Inde lokuliel’iyo, la belimo ibe lokuswela boto, yao lɔɔtɛlɛ ndei la liyasa lia ndei lokwa mangu kola löngo konda eliya, yao lowaka nda balia.
english: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛkɛ betingani ya ndei lona elokelomu, iyo lokwa otili, iyo lɔkɛ okakambesa mboli nda bikenge la nda bilanga,
english: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.

lokele: la bato ana loya oyɛnɛ eloakelomökö; ayäk’iyo ende Yesu, iyo loosha boto oyasokolomökö belimo ani ayali se nda bakolo ba Yesu, awati bisinda, l’ani ati’mɔ la loseka; iyo lowänga finɛ.
english: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

lokele: La bato ebɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ imɔ loaso, lokambesa bato ani auwesomökö boto oyaɔtɛlɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ la belimo.
english: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

lokele: Lamao bato batotina ba yese ya BaKelasene lofel’Inde mbo asokweke ende iyo, eoka bakuwanelomökö la bɔwa finɛ. Limɔ akwäkä Yesu nda watɔ, Inde loinywa liasi.
english: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.

lokele: Kongo ko boto oyakusolomökö belimo, inde losombola Yesu mbo ayaleke lande, kongo ko Yesu loinol’inde, Inde mbo—
english: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

lokele: Inwaka nda ndakɔ yaɛ, kambesaka bato ebifi ebisokeela Mungu okeel’aɛ. Inde lɔkɛ, inde lokanangokole nda bokenge bototina loasɔ lofi eloakeeläkä Yesu okeel’inde. Wana otomali wa Yailo
english: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

lokele: Ainwäkä Yesu, ekuke ya bato lonyangel’Inde la limɛngɔ eoka batotina loumbakel’Inde.
english: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

lokele: Lamao boto ɔmɔi loya ako Yailo, inde ayaläkä bokumi wa ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ, inde loswa balui se oso wa Yesu, inde losombola Inde mbo aɛkɛ nda ndakɔ yande,
english: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,

lokele: eoka mbo aäkä la wana ɔmwitoto otomali oyale tina lowa. Aäkä Yesu atɔkɛ la mboka, bikuke ya bato lowamakana lande,
english: for he had an only born 8:42 daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

lokele: la botomali ɔmɔi oyayaläkä la lokambo loa likila ko miaka liu la imbale la oyasilesäkä bieto yande bitotina ndofaefa eba kanga nde angokɔkɔlɔ ndouwesomo lau;
english: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,

lokele: inde loya ombisa, inde lomata lisɛmbɛlɛ lia esinda ya Yesu, lisasaya likila loöma tau.
english: came behind him and touched the fringe 8:44 of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

lokele: Yesu mbo— ¿Ndai nd’amati Imi? Anganyäk’iyo yaatotina, Petelo mbo— Bɔkɔta, bikuke ya bato bisolingel’Aɛ la basowamak’Aɛ.
english: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’

lokele: Kongo ko Yesu mbo— Boto nd’amatiki’mi eoka iluwi nde mbo bofoka bokuswiki nde ende’mi.
english: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”

lokele: Nde ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ botamali mbo asoisolomo, inde loya, inde lonyangaka finɛ, inde lokwa se oso wa Yesu, inde lokambesa bato batotina fololo, litina eliamatäk’inde omata Yesu, l’ani asäsesomökö inde lisasaya.
english: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lande mbo— Wana otomali, liimeli liaɛ lisouwes’aɛ, kɛndɛkɛ la lilatemi.
english: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

lokele: Atitaɛiläk’Inde ndoonga, boto loya oyasokwäkä nde nda ndakɔ ya bokumi wa ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ, inde mbo— Wana otomali waɛ asowa, ookesëke Boekesi imɔ likati.
english: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

lokele: Kongo ko okäkä Yesu ongoma, Inde mbo— Owangëke, imelaka kongo limɔ euwesomoko nde.
english: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

lokele: Iyäk’Inde nda ndakɔ, atiakuliäkä oto angɔmwito mbo aɔtɛkɛ amamwito lande, sakolo ko Petelo la Yoane, la Yakobo, la sango wa wana la nyango wande.
english: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

lokele: Batotina baleeläk’inde, iyo loomakaka bekükü nda etondo, kongo ko Yesu loonga mbo— Okelëke etondo ani, atikwele se, aingali ilɔ.
english: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo losɛkɛlɛ Inde finɛ, baluwi nde mbo akweli nde se.
english: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

lokele: Nde Inde lounda wana la bosamba, Inde loamama mbo— Wana, emalaka.
english: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

lokele: Bolimo wande loinwa end’inde, inde loemala lisasaya, la Yesu loonga lau mbo bafek’inde yeka yola.
english: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

lokele: La ebaoti wana otomali losisimwa, nde Yesu lotel’iyo ekela mbo batakambesa oto angɔmwito lona elokelomuku.
english: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

lokele: Asɔnjäkä Inde eba liu la ambale, Yesu lofaef’iyo bofoka la isosha shokakalesa belimo ebe bitotina la ndosäsesa ngwo;
english: He called the twelve 9:1 together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

lokele: la mbo bateke boekï wa loyo loa Bɔkɔta wa Mungu la ndokasäsesa eba kambo;
english: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Wilëke yeka ya lɔkɛndɔ ndɔkɛ la yao, inga itumbe, inga litanga, inga lituma, inga bieto, angosɛlɛ kanju imbale.
english: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.

lokele: La ndakɔ eyekaɔtɛk’ino, yalakaka kw’amao kond’akasekwek’ino.
english: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

lokele: Nde olo atofeka bato ndonyangel’ino, akasokweke ino omao, fufolaka liunge elisowatema la batindi banu kwa ndembe end’iyo.
english: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”

lokele: Baeki lɔkɛ lɔkɛndɔ nda bekenge bitimbi, iyo lokanangokole Mboli Ilau la iyo losäsekesa eba ngwo lolo lolo aɛk’iyo.
english: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.

lokele: Bɔkɔta Helodi Antipas looka mboli ya bitotina-bi eyakelomökö la inde lowa tolöi nda botema, eoka mbo bato bamɔi loonga mbo Yoane Bolufi asokuswa nda liwa,
english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

lokele: bamɔi mbo Eliya asɔɛnɛlɛ liasi, la basi mbo ɔmɔi wa batɔndɔli ba kwalakwala asokuswa liasi.
english: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

lokele: Nde Helodi mbo— Imi nd’atenäkä Yoane kingo; ¿Oyo to ndai oyasookaka’mi njasɔ-bi? La inde lolukä fofe yɔɛnɛ Yesu.
english: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

lokele: Ainwäkä batomomu, iyo loluwesa Yesu bitotina ebiakeläk’iyo. Inde lɔɔs’iyo okakɛ lau wisakumbo konda bokenge boko Betesaida.
english: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of 9:10 a city called Bethsaida.

lokele: Nde aluwäkä bato ongoma, iyo lotut’Inde, la Yesu lonyangel’iyo, Inde loonga lau loasɔ loa Bɔkɔta wa Mungu, la Inde losäsekesa ebaenökö bosäsu. Lilesi lia bato bilɛfu bɔɔmwi
english: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

lokele: Aɔngɔ̈kɔ̈ buse litele, eba liu la ambale loyaonga lande mbo— Tamachaka ekuke ya bato baɛkɛ nda bekenge ya yese bitimbi okaingala la okala bieka ina, eoka tole onomono nda liɔmbɛlɛ.
english: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

lokele: Kongo ko Inde loonga lau mbo— Ino fak’iyo bieka yola. Iyo mbo— Toti la yeka, ko beila bɔɔmwi la swi imbale, sakolo ngo ko iso kɔkɛ okasombaka bieka eoka ya ebato-ba batotina; baäkä nde bato kwa bilɛfu bɔɔmwi.
english: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

lokele: Yesu loonga la baeki bande mbo— Yalesak’iyo se nda betükä ya bato kama bɔɔmwi, kama bɔɔmwi;
english: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

lokele: iyo lokelaka ongoma, iyo loyales’iyo yaatotina se.
english: They did so, and made them all sit down.

lokele: Inde lɔɔsɔ beila bɔɔmwi la swi imbale, Inde loila baiso likolo, Inde losombola eoka ya yao, Inde loataka bao, limɔ Inde lofaekefa baeki mbo baokasɛlɛ yao oso wa ekuke ya bato.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

lokele: Iyo lola la batotina lokanelo; la iyo loina twinyo twa yeka ebitikali lau, yao lotumesa bisaka liu la bimbale. Yesu akuliomökö mbo Masiya
english: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

lokele: Lise limɔi aäkä Yesu atosombola Mungu, Inde angɛnɛ la baeki bande amamwito, Inde lofel’iyo mbo— ¿Bato batoonga mbo Imi yende ndai?
english: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

lokele: Iyo lomutoel’Inde mbo— Yoane Bolufi, nde bamɔi mbo Eliya, la basi mbo ɔmɔi wa batɔndɔli ba kwalakwala asokuswa liasi.
english: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Nde ino nd’atoonga mbo Imi yende ndai? Petelo lomutola mbo— Masiya wa Mungu.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

lokele: Nde Yesu loimak’iyo la Inde loonga lau mbo batakambesa boto angɔmwito loasɔ lona.
english: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,

lokele: Inde mbo— Lole loa Wana wa Boto ndooka biale wike la ndofekelomo la biange la kanga la batikasa, la ndoolomo imɔ, la nda lise lia asatɔ ɛtɛmwɛsɔmɔkɔ liasi.
english: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lau batotina mbo— Boto ɛlɛmbɛ mbo atuteke’mi, atafekelak’inde angɛnɛ, atatolaka lieka liande lise la lise la atuteke’mi.
english: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, 9:23 and follow me.

lokele: Eoka oyatosanga ndoikesa liwawi liande angɛnɛ, atolefesa nde liao, kongo ko oyatolefesa liwawi liande eoka yami, inde nd’atoikesa liao.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

lokele: Boto ɛɔlɔ bitotina ya wenda-bo nde kolefesa liwawi liande angɛnɛ, ambo kosɛɛsɛlɛ, asɔɔlɔ to iye?
english: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

lokele: Boto oyatofekaka’mi la baoi bami ko l’eoka ya sɔni, ambo Wana wa Boto imɔ, efekak’inde imɔ la sɔni eyekayek’Inde nda tala yande la eya Sango wande amamwito la bakitomo batanu.
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

lokele: Nde isoonga lanu wewe mbo— Bato bamɔi ebemali eyamaya, batiawëkë konda akɛnɛk’iyo Bɔkɔta wa Mungu. Eliya la Mɔsɛ loyaongana la Yesu
english: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

lokele: Loäkä nde mbisa ya becho ango ko bonanɛi mbo Yesu lɔɔsɔ Petelo la Yoane la Yakobo, Inde lokɛsɛnɛ lau nda löngo, okasombola omao.
english: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

lokele: La asomboläk’Inde, boyaeli wa bɔmbɔ wande lokinjwa bɔfɔnɔ wasi, la bisinda yande lofufwa kwa ibalibali.
english: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

lokele: Kwaamao bato bambale loongana lande, bako Mɔsɛ la Eliya,
english: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

lokele: ebɛnɛlɛ̈kɛ̈ la tala, iyo loonga loaso loa losokwo elokasokwek’Inde nda Yelusaleme.
english: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, 9:31 which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

lokele: Nde Petelo la ebaäkä lande lowa bolengelenge la asiswak’iyo, iyo loɛnɛ tala yande la bato bambale ebemali lande.
english: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

lokele: Asɛnyanäkä ebambale osenyana la Yesu, Petelo loonga la Yesu mbo— Bokota, bolau end’iso oyala eyamaya, tosweke kumbo isato, emɔi yaɛ, ɛmɔi ya Mɔsɛ, la ɛmɔi ya Eliya, atialuwäkä baoi ebaongäk’inde.
english: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.

lokele: Aongäk’inde ongoma, lifita lolinjak’iyo la aɔtɔ̈k’iyo nda lifita, iyo lowänga;
english: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

lokele: limɔ limiki lookana nda lifita mbo— Oyo ende Wana wami wa losamɔ, okak’Inde.
english: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”

lokele: Asiläkä limiki oonga, Yesu lɔɛnɛlɛ ko Inde angɛnɛ. La baeki loyala tau, batiakambesäkä boto angɔmɔi nda bacho bana njasɔ eyɛnɛ̈k’iyo. Louweso loa wana oyaaka la Olimo Obe
english: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ, asulwäk’iyo se nda löngo, ekuke ya bato wike loyatowana la Yesu.
english: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

lokele: Futuku, boto ɔmɔi wa ekuke loamama mbo— Boekesi, itosombol’Aɛ mbo oticheke wana otolome wami eoka ale wana wami ɔmwitoto,
english: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born 9:38 child.

lokele: la tɛnɛ, atoundaka bolimo eund’inde, atoamama futuku, atowanj’inde la atokusola fulofulo nda bɔnɔkɔ, angomach’inde sakolo ko asotulung’inde finɛ.
english: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

lokele: Imi losombola baeki baɛ mbo bakusoleke boimo, nde batikɔkɔlɛ.
english: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— E-fɛtɔ-ye eti la liimeli, esofenyakana nde; ¿Itoumwaka lanu ko mbile yanga, itokɔkɔmɛl’ino konda eni mbile? Eshaka wana waɛ l’ono.
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

lokele: Kwa ayäk’inde ende Yesu, bolimo obe lokwes’inde se, lowanj’inde finɛ. Nde Yesu loimaka bolimo obe, Inde losäsesa wana, Inde loinola inde ende sango.
english: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

lokele: La batotina lotwa liena eoka ya bofoka l’isosha sha Mungu.
english: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

lokele: Nde amwaaläk’iyo yaatotina ebiakeläk’Inde, Yesu loonga la baeki bande mbo— Ɔtɛsɛkɛ nda batoi banu ko ebaoi-ba, mbo Wana wa Boto ewambomoko nda besamba ya bato.
english: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

lokele: Kongo ko batialüwäkä litina lia lioi-li, liao loisamel’iyo mbo baluwëke litina la iyo lowänga ndofel’Inde loasɔ loa lioi-li.
english: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

lokele: Limɔ baeki loakola ndofenyakana baoi mbo ndai wau kolongela baina.
english: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

lokele: Nde aluwäkä Yesu tofenya nda betema yau, Inde lounda wana ɔkɛkɛ, Inde loemes’inde nda fangi yande,
english: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Oyatonyangela ambo e-wana-yo ko l’eoka ya lina liami, atonyangela nde Imi la oyatonangela’mi, ambo atonyangela nde Inde oyatomäkä Imi; eoka inde wanu yaatoti oyaɔndwi se, ambo ona ale ofi.
english: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

lokele: Limɔ Yoane loonga lande mbo— Bɔkɔta, twɛniki oto ɔmɔi oyatokusola belimo ebe nda lina liaɛ, la twaimäk’inde eoka aitotutana lasu.
english: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Oimëk’inde, eoka oyaitoiyel’ino, oyo ale wanu.
english: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

lokele: Aäkä bacho ebakainweke lande nda Use basoya tina, Yesu lokɔkɔmɔ kɔkɛ oila lɔkɛndɔ nda Yelusaleme,
english: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

lokele: la Inde lotoma batomomu bamɔi oso wande; la iyo lɔkɛ, iyo lɔɔtɔ nda bokenge wa BaSamalia okakomiel’Inde eingaelo omao.
english: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

lokele: Kongo ko batianyangeläk’Inde omao eoka Yesu losanga okakɛ nda Yelusaleme.
english: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ baeki bande bako Yakobo la Yoane ongoma, iyo mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, otisange mbo toteke bösä lioi, bokweke se nda use oyasɛɛsɛlɛs’iyo, kwa akeläk’imɔ ko Eliya?
english: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

lokele: Kongo ko Yesu lokikwel’iyo, Inde loim’iyo.
english: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

lokele: Limɔ iyo lokakɛ okenge wa boyaeli wasi. Lioi lia Yesu ende basangiotut’Inde
english: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

lokele: Aɛk’iyo la mboka, boto ɔmɔi loonga la Yesu mbo— Itutek’Aɛ l’olo atɔkɛ laɛ.
english: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Bɛlɛndɛ bile la baonda, la nɔli bile la bikalingo, nde Wana wa Boto ati ango la elela yoingesa botö se.
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

lokele: Yesu loonga la boto wasi mbo— Tütaka’mi; nde inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ, tamachaka’mi mbo ikɛkɛ okaomba sango wami.
english: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Machaka ebasowa baombakeke ebawi lau, nde aɛ angɛnɛ kɛndɛkɛ okamelekesa mboli ya Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

lokele: La wasi imɔ loonga mbo— Itotüt’Aɛ, Ngɛnɛ, nde tamachaka’mi mbo ikɛokasɛnyana la bofindi wami eyasu.
english: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga lande mbo— Boto eunda wɛmbɛ nda osamba, nde kota iyɛɛ, angoengana nda Bokota wa Mungu.
english: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”

lokele: Mbisa lamao Yesu loaa bato basi kama bosambale, Inde lotoma iyo, bambale bambale, baɛkɛ oso wande nda bekenge la bilela bitotina ebikakɛndɛlɛk’Inde angɛnɛ.
english: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him 10:1 into every city and place where he was about to come.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Eula yende efi, nde ebatotwaka yao bende bamyo; eokao sombolaka Ngɛnɛ wa eula mbo atomeke batwi nda eula yande.
english: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

lokele: Kɛndɛkɛ lɔkɛndɔ; tɛnɛ, isotom’ino kwa bifembeli ya bɛkɔkɔ nd’atiteni ya ngɔi.
english: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

lokele: Otolëke litanga lia yeto, ango buku, ango tokwaka, oseelëke boto nda mboka.
english: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

lokele: Nde nda ndakɔ eyekaɔtɛk’ino, taongaka mbo— Lilatemi liyaleke nda ndakɔ-ye; eya wana wa lilatemi eyala omao, lilatemi lianu liyalaka nde lande,
english: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

lokele: nde eti ongoma, ambo lilatemi lianu liinwaka end’ino liasi.
english: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

lokele: Olo atɔɔt’ino ndakɔ, tikalaka ngo ko omao, mwaka la laka bieka ebitofomo ino, eoka bosali boengani ndofomo posho yande; wetetëke ndakɔ la ndakɔ.
english: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

lokele: Nda ona bokenge ebokaɔtɛk’ino la batonyangel’ino olau, laka bieka ebitotamb’iyo ino.
english: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

lokele: Säsekesaka eba ngwo ebale omao, ongäka lau mbo— Bokota wa Mungu bosoya tina lanu.
english: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

lokele: Kongo ko bokenge ebotɔɔt’ino, eyambo batinyangel’ino, umaka lousa nda lɔ̈mbɔ, ongaka mbo—
english: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

lokele: Tosofufoelak’ino ango liunge lia bokenge elisowatema la batindi basu, kongo ko luwaka wewe mbo Bokota wa Mungu bosoya tina lanu.
english: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

lokele: Itoonga lanu mbo, nda lise lia likomyi lina, bokenge wa Sodomo angooka likuchi lifi elikokeke bokenge ona.
english: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

lokele: Aeko Kolasini! Aeko Betesaida! Eya to mbo bisisho eyakelomökö eyanu, kokelomo nda Tulo la Sidona, ani bakalanganäkä ko kwalakwala la baala nda lokomba, l’ani bayali nda nyɛlɛ la bisinda ya bakonia.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

lokele: Nde nda likomyi, elianu likuchi litoeta elia Tulo la Sidona.
english: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

lokele: ¿L’aɛ moni, Kafenauma; mbo aɛ kotaliomo konda use? Mba, otoumbolomo nda liyöndo lia liwa.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades. 10:15

lokele: Oyatooka ino, atooka nde Imi; la oyatofekel’ino, atofekela nde Imi; la oyatofekela Imi, atofekela nde Inde oyatomäkä’mi. Liinwi lia ebatomomu lɔkɛndɔ
english: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”

lokele: Eba kama bosambale loinwa la limɛngɔ, iyo loonga lande mbo— Belimo ebe angɛnɛ bitolitesa iso ko l’eoka ya lina liaɛ.
english: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Yɛniki Satana ani asokwa se nda use kwa ibalibali.
english: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

lokele: Tokai Isof’ino isosha shomatela njɔ la tokwakwa la isosha sholongela bofoka bototina wa Wiyani, angwɛnɛ ango ɛmɔi kookes’ino wäle.
english: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

lokele: Kongo ko oomalëke nda betema ko l’eoka mbo belimo ebe bisolites’ino, nde okaka limɛngɔ eoka mbo baina banu basotomo nda lokasa nda Use.
english: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

lokele: Nda mbile-ao Yesu loyaimwesa botema ko la Bolimo Botanu, Inde mbo— Isoinel’Aɛ Sango, Ngɛnɛ wa Use la se, ko la kelekëlë, eoka mbo osoisa njasɔ-bi ende eba wɛlï la eba liluwani, nde osoisola yao ende bana’oli; eingo ko Sango eoka loao lɔɛnɛlɛ lolau nda lisangi liaɛ.
english: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

lokele: Bitotina bisofomo’mi ko la Sango wami; angwɛnɛ ango ɔmwito oyatolüwa Wana sakolo ngo ko Sango la angwɛnɛ oyatolüwa Sango, sakolo ngo ko Wana, la inde imɔ oyatosanga Wana ndoɛnɛsɛ inde Sango.
english: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde lokikwa ende baeki bande, Inde loonga lau wisakumbo, mbo— Baiso banu basofota la limɛngɔ eoka basɔɛnɛ njasɔ-bi,
english: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

lokele: eoka isoonga lanu mbo batɔndɔli wike la bɛkɔta imɔ balɛmbɛkɛ finɛ ndɔɛnɛ ebisɔɛnɛ ino, nde batiɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ yao; la ndooka ebisook’ino, nde batiokäkä yao. Yesu loekesa Bokumi Bikela Biyai
english: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

lokele: Lise limɔi, Bokumi ako Bosanokoli wa Bikela loemala ndokotela Yesu la lofelo, inde mbo— Boekesi, itokela nde moni ndosɛɛlɛ loiko loa layalaya?
english: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— ¿Bini bitomu nda lokasa loa Bikela? ¿Otangi nde moni omao?
english: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

lokele: Bokumi lomutola mbo— Samaka Ngɛnɛ Mungu waɛ la botema bototina, la bolimo waɛ bototina, la bofoka waɛ bototina, la baenyeli baɛ batotina, la Samaka boyalani laɛ kwa ani atosama aɛ angɛnɛ.
english: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; Deuteronomy 6:5 and your neighbor as yourself.” Leviticus 19:18

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Limutoli liaɛ liengani chaa; kelaka ongoma, nde wayala la loiko.
english: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

lokele: Kongo ko Bokumi, eoka alɛmbɛ̈kɛ̈ ndoengana, inde loonga la Yesu mbo— ¿Ndai to ale boyalani lami?
english: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— Boto ɔmɔi asokweläkä Yelusaleme okakɛ konda Yeliko, la mboka inde losungamelomo l’eba beoni, iyo losokola bisinda yande, iyo lokuchak’inde, iyo lotangwaka, iyo lomach’inde oko tina lowa.
english: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

lokele: Loäkä nde mbo kanga loeta imɔ ko la mboka ena, limɔ ɛnɛ̈k’inde boto, inde loengwa mboka yasi.
english: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

lokele: Limɔ ɔmɔi wa BaLewi imɔ loiyela elela ena, nde ɛnɛ̈k’inde boto, inde loengwa fangi yasi.
english: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

lokele: Nde ɔmɔi wa Samalia oyaɛ̈kɛ̈ lɔkɛndɔ loosh’oto nda elela ena, ɛnɛ̈k’inde boto, inde lookel’inde ngandi fuu,
english: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

lokele: inde lɔkɛ end’inde, inde lokandaka bafwa, inde lowɛlɛ baita la bänä nda bao, limɔ inde lotalia boto nda funda yande angɛnɛ, inde lokɛs’inde ani konda ndakɔ y’eba kɛndɔ, inde lokukya boto omao.
english: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

lokele: Lanɔngɔ inde lokusola falanga imbale, inde lofa botingani wa ndakɔ yao, mbo— Tinganelaka’mi lande la wɛlï, ango bosilesa falanga yasi, akainweke’mi, itokamb’aɛ yao.
english: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

lokele: ¿Otoenyela mbo ndai wa bato-ba basatɔ ende boyalani wa boto ona oyasungamelomökö l’eba beoni?
english: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

lokele: Bokumi lomutola mbo— Inde oyakeelaka boto booto. Limɔ Yesu loonga lande mbo— Aɛ imɔ, kɛndɛkɛ okakela ongoma. Malia la Maleta
english: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

lokele: Akɛndɛ̈k’iyo lɔkɛndɔ, Yesu loiyela bokenge bɔkɛkɛ, la omao botomali ɔmɔi ako Maleta lonyangel’Inde nda ndakɔ yande.
english: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

lokele: Maleta aäkä la etungani ako Malia, inde loyala se nda bakolo ba Yesu ndooka liekesi liande;
english: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.

lokele: nde Maleta loeyaeya eoka ya bakuwa wike; inde loyaemala oso wande, inde loonga mbo— Ngɛnɛ, otiɛnɛ finɛ mbo etungani yami amachi’mi angɛnɛ ndokomya bieka? Ongaka to lande mbo asungeke’mi.
english: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

lokele: Yesu loonga mbo— Maleta, Maleta, ototakela njasɔ wike bolenda la loeyaeyo lofi,
english: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

lokele: kongo ko lɔmɔi loenu nde, la Malia asoaa lona lolau elotiaɔnɔkɔlɔmɔkɔ end’inde.
english: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

lokele: Yesu ayaläkä nda elela ɛmɔi nda lisomboli; asiläk’Inde, ɔmɔi wa baeki bande loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, ekesaka iso ndosombola, kwa aekesäkä imɔ ko Yoane baeki bande.
english: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Akasombokolek’ino, waongaka mbo— Sango; lina liaɛ lilitesomoko, Bɔkɔta waɛ boyeke.
english: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

lokele: Fak’iso louse bieka ya lise la lise,
english: Give us day by day our daily bread.

lokele: Mɛsɛlɛk’iso batwanelo basu, Eoka iso angɛnɛ tosomɛsɛlɛ batotina njasɔ ibe yau. Okɛsɛ̈k’iso nda lisoshela.
english: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Ndai wanu, eyala la wina, kɔkɛ end’inde la ɛsɔkɔ ya ocho okaonga lande mbo,
english: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

lokele: Wina, faka’mi sumbu beila bisatɔ sɔmbya, eoka wina wami asoya nda lɔkɛndɔ loingala la iti la yeka yof’inde?
english: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

lokele: Limɔ wina oyale nda ndakɔ koonga mbo— Ofëke’mi likati, bome bosokandomo yumwa la iso la bana bami toingali nde nda tange, itikɔkɔlɛ imɔ ndoemala la ndofaef’aɛ yeka.
english: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

lokele: Imi mbo— Ango aitoemala ndof’inde bieka ko eoka mbo ayali wina lande, nde ko l’eoka ya bolïlïya wande, atoemala ndokaf’inde bitotina ebitoeno inde.
english: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

lokele: Imi nd’atoonga lanu mbo— Felaka, limɔ bitofomo ino; lukaka limɔ ino koosha eyetoluk’ino; titaka limɔ bome kolioelomo ino.
english: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

lokele: Eoka boto la boto oyatofela, inde kɔɔlɔ; oyatoluka, inde koosha; ende inde oyatotita, wao koliolomo.
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

lokele: ¿Boni boto wanu, wana wande efel’inde boila, atof’inde litalɛ?
english: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

lokele: Kwa efel’inde swi, inde kof’inde njɔ?
english: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?

lokele: Eokao, eyambo ino, bato abe oluwi ndofaefa bana banu bafi balau, nde simbi to Sango wanu oyayali nda Use, efaka Bolimo Botanu ende ebatofel’Inde. Lioi lia Yesu eoka ya Satana
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

lokele: Lise limɔi Yesu akusoläkä bolimo wa euma la akuswäkä bolimo, limɔ boto wa euma loonga.
english: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

lokele: Lamao bato lomwaala nde bamɔi loonga mbo— Atokusola belimo ebe ko la lisungi lia Balasebula, ako Bɔkɔta wa belimo ebe.
english: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

lokele: Bato basi lokotel’Inde, iyo lofel’Inde mbo ɛnɛsɛk’iyo ndembe yosekwa nda Use.
english: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

lokele: Yesu alembeeläkä baenyeli bau; Inde loonga lau mbo— Bato ba yese ɛmɔi ebatonana iyo angɛnɛ, bato ana batosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ yese; ko ongoma bokulü kokwesa bokulü angɛnɛ.
english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

lokele: ¿Eya to mbo Satana imɔ kowesana l’ebande angɛnɛ, bɔkɔta wande kokɔkɔmɔ moni? Iongi nde ani eoka ino mbo isokusola belimo ebe ko l’isosha sha Balasebula.
english: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

lokele: Eya mbo Imi nd’atokusola belimo ebe ko la Balasebula, bana banu nd’atokusola yao ko la ndai? Eokao, iyo batoyala nde bakomyi banu.
english: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

lokele: Nde, eyambo Imi nd’asokusola belimo ebe la isangakala sha Mungu, aambo Bɔkɔta wa Mungu bosoya tina lanu.
english: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

lokele: Atolamba Bowangä wa engä mbo akukyeke likula liande la biɛla yande ya bita, limɔ bieto la biengo yande bisotekama teka;
english: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

lokele: Kongo ko atoya wasi wolongel’inde la bofoka, atokwesak’inde, atɔɔnɔkɔlɔk’inde biɛla la nguwa ebilendeluk’inde, inde kokaelaka findaka eyind’inde.
english: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

lokele: Oyatikɛndɛnɛ lami, inde ende wiyani lami; oyatisɔnjɛ lami, inde nd’atomelesa.
english: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

lokele: Bolimo wa lilo bosekwa to ende boto, wao atotandela bilela ebiti la balia okaluke fofe yolengela omao, kongo ko angotɛnɛ yao; inde koonga mbo— Itoinwa nda ndakɔ yami olo asekweliki’mi.
english: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

lokele: Akayek’inde omao, atoosha yao wase, esoombomo la esokomyomo.
english: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

lokele: Limɔ atɔkɛ okɔsɔ belimo osambale ebisoet’inde la obe, la iyo yaatotina kɔɔtɔkɔ ndakɔ okayalaka ina; limɔ boyaeli wa mbisa ya boto ona bosoetela ewa oso la bobe.
english: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

lokele: Aongäk’Inde baoi-ba, otomali oyayali nda ekuke loila limiki liande mbo— Limɛngɔ lifi liyala nde la sɔlɔ eyaotäk’Aɛ, la baɛlɛ ebamwesäk’Aɛ.
english: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga mbo— Eingo nde bende la limɛngɔ lioeta ebatooka Lioi lia Mungu la ebatokɔkɔmɛlɛ liao.
english: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

lokele: Asɔngɔkɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ bikuke yasi ya bato, Inde loakola ndoonga mbo— E-fɛtɔ-ye ende fɛtɔ ya obe, basokaluke ndembe ya ikesa, angwɛnɛ ango ɛmɔi kofomo iyo, sakolo ngo ko ndembe ya Yona.
english: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

lokele: Kwani ayaläkä Yona ndembe ende bato ba Ninewe, ko ongoma Wana wa Boto eyalaka ndembe ende bato ba e-fɛtɔ-ye.
english: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

lokele: Bɔkɔta otomali wa yese ya Sheba atoemesana la e-fɛtɔ-ye nda lise lia Likomyi, la atof’iyo se, eoka asokwäkä olo nda liko lia wenda ndoyoka wɛlï wa Solomo, nde tɛnɛngɔ elolongeli Solomo ngo ko eyamaya.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

lokele: Bato ba Ninewe batoemesana la bato ba e-fɛtɔ-ye yanu nda lise lia Likomyi, la iyo batof’ino se, eoka iyo nd’akalanganäkä eoka ya inangö sha Yona, nde tɛnɛngɔ elolongeli Yona ngo ko eyamaya.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

lokele: Atoanesa boto täla, aitokasɛlɛ yao nda liöndo, kwa ose ya ɛɛngɔ kangä nda esolo, mbo ebatɔtɔ ndakɔ bɛnɛkɛ liamela lia yao.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

lokele: Täla ya bindo ende liso, eokao liso liaɛ liyala fololo, bindo yaɛ bitotina bitoana swaa; nde ango liso liaɛ liyala libe, bindo yaɛ imɔ bitosɔlɔnɔ sɔlɛ̈ la lilima.
english: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

lokele: Tichaka to mbo liamela elile laɛ litayala ko lilima.
english: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

lokele: Eya ngo mbo bindo yaɛ bitotina bisoana swa, angwɛnɛ imɔ lilima ango sinyo, aambo yao bitoana kwani atoana täla eyoanes’aɛ la liamela lia twangakeli. Baɛngɔ bawau ende BaFalusi
english: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

lokele: Aongäkä Yesu baoi-ba, BoFalusi ɔmɔi lofel’Inde mbo aleke bieka olo eyande; Inde lɔɔtɔ lande, Inde loyala se nda bieka.
english: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ BoFalusi mbo Yesu atitasoole bindo oso wa bieka, inde lomwaala.
english: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

lokele: Nde Ngɛnɛ loonga lande mbo— Kwani ino BaFalusi otosoolaka lousa loa kɔpɔ la lɔfɛfɛ, kongo ko atiteni yanu etumi nde la bolole la lisiela.
english: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

lokele: Ino bibebe, ¿Oyakeläkä lousa, atikele imɔ ko atiteni lisanga?
english: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

lokele: Takaelaka to ebile atiteni, limɔ wɛnɛkɛ mbo bitotina bit’imɔ la bokili end’ino.
english: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

lokele: Aeko wale end’ino BaFalusi, eoka ino otofaefa likaɔ lia botüku wa liu nda kasakasa ya lɔɛtɛ, kongo ko osounga ndola yoeta ya liengani la losamɔ loa Mungu; lole loanu ndokɔcha yao, ani ebimɔi imɔ biti yoomelomoko.
english: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

lokele: Aeko wale end’ino BaFalusi, eoka otolola kangala ya oso nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ la ndolamokolomoko nda baöngo.
english: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

lokele: Aeko wale end’ino, eoka wende kwa kito ebitiɛnɛlɛ ebitomatakelomo la bato ebatilembeele yao.
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

lokele: Bosanokoli ɔmɔi wa Bikela lomutola la Yesu mbo— Boekesi, atoonga Aɛ ongoma, osochambola imɔ ko iso.
english: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

lokele: Yesu mbo— Aeko wäle end’ino Basanokoli ba Bikela imɔ, eoka ototolesa bato bekuku ebitookes’iyo bolito wäle, nde ino angɛnɛ angosung’iyo ango la isangakala simɔi shanu.
english: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

lokele: Aeko wäle end’ino, eoka otoswa tɔsɛɛlɛ toenyekela batɔndɔli, ani bangau banu nd’aoläk’iyo.
english: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

lokele: Nde ino osokulya eyakeläkä bangau banu la osoaolel’iyo; bangau baoläkä nd’iyo; ino ososwaka kito yau.
english: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

lokele: Eokao, Wɛlï wa Mungu loonga mbo— Itotomela bato la Batɔndɔli la Batomomu; beolaka nde bamɔi, bekongolaka nde bamɔi;
english: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

lokele: mbo bakila ba batɔndɔli batotina ebasondo-lomökö, konda baakoelo ba wenda, bakungameke ende eba fɛtɔ-ye;
english: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

lokele: bako ko bakila ba Abela, ko bakila ba Sekalaya oyaseɛsɛlɛ̈kɛ̈ atiteni ya etambelo ya lifaefi la Ndakɔ ya Mungu; eingo ko, Imi mbo bafelomoko ende eba fɛtɔ-ye.
english: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

lokele: Aeko wäle end’ino Basanokoli ba Bikela, eoka osɔɔnɔkɔlɔkɔ lofungola loa liluwani; ino angɛnɛ otiaɔtɛ, la osokufesa imɔ ebakɔɔtɔ ina.
english: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

lokele: Asokwäk’Inde omao, Batikasa ka BaFalusi loakola ndosungamel’Inde la bofoka, iyo lofɔɔl’Inde mbo aongeke baoi wike,
english: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,

lokele: ani iyo lolamba bao mbo baundeke lioi lia bɔnɔkɔ wande.
english: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

lokele: Nda mbile-ao, bilɛfu ya bato losɔngɔkɔmɔkɔ end’Inde, iyo lomatakelanaka, la Yesu loakola ndoonga la baeki bande oso, Inde mbo— Ɛnɛkɛ la wɛlï ndoengwa lisoo lia lituma lia BaFalusi, liko liisi lia wewe;
english: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

lokele: eoka angwɛnɛ angɔmɔi eyisami sakolo ko yoisolomo mbisa; angwɛnɛ eloisomu, ko mbo lolüwomoko mbisa.
english: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.

lokele: Eokao ebisoong’ino nda lilima, yao yokanaka nde nda löwa; la bitotina ebiong’ino iyoiyoi nda kuku ya ndakɔ, yao bitakomoko boeki nda bɛtɔndɔ ya ndakɔ.
english: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

lokele: Itoonga lanu ako baina lami, Imi mbo— Owängëke ebatoola bindo, nde batikɔkɔlɛ okel’imɔ loasɔ loasi.
english: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

lokele: Nde itotaim’ino loasɔ loa oyengani ndowängomo; wängaka nde Inde oyale la isosha, mbisa ya liwa, ndoumbola nda Ngehena, eingo, Imi nd’asoonga lanu mbo— Wängaka nd’Inde.
english: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. 12:5 Yes, I tell you, fear him.

lokele: ¿Mbo bɛnjwɛɛ bɔɔmwi biitoungesomo la bakute bambale? Nde ango ɔmɔi wa yao angoungomo la Mungu.
english: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins 12:6 ? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

lokele: Aambo eyanu swee ya betö bisoluwana loketi; eokao owangëke eoka ino nd’asolongela bɛnjwɛɛ wike.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

lokele: Itoonga imɔ lanu mbo— Boto eaolela’mi nda baiso ba bato, ambo Wana wa Boto aolaka nde inde nda baiso ba bakitomo ba Mungu.
english: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

lokele: Nde boto eanganya Imi nda baiso ba bato, inde eanganyomoko nda baiso ba bakitomo ba Mungu.
english: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.

lokele: Boto esingwa lioi lia litɔ̈ngi lia Wana wa Boto, atomɛsɛlɔmɔ, kongo ko oyatosɛɔlɔ Bolimo Botanu aitomɛsɛlɔmɔ.
english: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

lokele: Atokɛsɛ iyo okɛs’ino oso wa bekumi nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ, kwa oso wa eba isosha, otakelëke bolenda ani atomutol’ino, kwa atoong’ino,
english: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;

lokele: eoka Bolimo Botanu atoekes’ino ko la mbile-ao yao ebikaongek’ino. Loasɔ loa oyati Lifoka nda baiso ba Mungu
english: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

lokele: Limɔ boto ɔmɔi nda ekuke loonga la Yesu mbo— Boekesi, ongaka la boloo wami mbo akaeke botiko lami.
english: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

lokele: Nde Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— ¿Boto, ndai ati nde Imi wateli la bokaeli wanu?
english: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”

lokele: Inde loonga la bato mbo— Lambaka la tinganaka la wɛlï loasɔ loa bolole bototina, eoka liwawi lia boto liitolendelo ko shetesele sha yao ebisɛlɛ inde.
english: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde lotel’iyo bombila, Inde mbo— Elanga ya lifoka lotaka tuma la bieka wike wike;
english: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.

lokele: la inde loenyela nda botema wande mbo, Ikeleke to iye eoka iti’mɔ la biiselo yoengana yoisa tuma twa elanga yami?
english: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

lokele: Inde mbo— Itokel’ani, itoukola bikukelo ebile lami la itoswa yasi yolonga bifi, limɔ itoisa la befonga la biengo yami ina.
english: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

lokele: La itoonga la liwawi lia botema wami mbo— Liwawio, ososɛlɛ bieka la bieto likama ebisois’aɛ yoengana miaka wike; ɛumaka, laka, mwaka, kelaka limɛngɔ!
english: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’

lokele: Kongo ko Mungu loonga lande mbo— Ebebe, ako aɛ; la ocho-bo, liwawi liaɛ litɔɔsɔmɔ end’aɛ; limɔ ebisokukya aɛ nda yiselo, ndai atɔɔlɔ yao?
english: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’

lokele: Lole ko ongoma la oto oyatosɔnja bieto end’inde angɛnɛ; nde atifote l’eya Mungu.
english: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”

lokele: Lamao Yesu loonga la baeki bande mbo— Eokao, itoonga lanu Imi mbo— Otakelëke bolenda loasɔ loa liwawi lianu mbo ¿Totola to nd’iye?; la eoka ya bindo yanu mbo ¿Totowata nd’iye?
english: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

lokele: Liwawi lisoeta yeka yola la bindo bisoeta bisinda yowata.
english: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

lokele: Tichaka la enyelaka nɔli biko bengate, biitolɔɔ koto, biitotwaka eula, biti la biiselo kwa kumbo, nde Mungu nd’atoles’iyo bieka; ino oisolongela nɔli la loketi?
english: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

lokele: ¿Ndai wanu kokɔkɔlɔ ko l’iyeli kongo, ndotalia ango sinyo kwa linganjo nda liwawi liande?
english: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit 12:25 to his height?

lokele: ¿Eokao, otikɔkɔlɛ ndokela loasɔ-lo lɔkɛkɛ, monito ototakela bolenda nda yasi?
english: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

lokele: Tichaka la enyelaka fototo, ani atokonda yao; biitokuwa, biitotita elamba; nde itoonga lanu mbo, ango Solomo angɛnɛ la bɔfɛkɔ wande wa likama, atiawatäkä bɔfɛkɔ woengana bɔfɛkɔ wa lɔfɔtɔtɔ lɔmɔi.
english: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

lokele: ¿Ango Mungu asowatesa ko chwingi etosoyala louse nda elanga nde lɛlɛngɔ totoumbolomo nda litumbo, nde simbi to Inde aitowates’ino, bato ba lilendelu likɛkɛ?
english: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

lokele: Otalukëke mbo bini ebitolak’iso la bini bitomwak’iso ko la toloi nda betema, eoka bato ba wende batokalukake bieka-bi,
english: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

lokele: Nde Sango wanu nd’aluwi mbo otoeno bieka-bi.
english: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

lokele: Talükaka Bɔkɔta wa Mungu, limɔ ebi-bitotina kofomoko imɔ ino.
english: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

lokele: Ino ba itutunda, owangëke, eoka lisangi lia Sango wanu lile ko ndofaef’ino Bɔkɔta.
english: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

lokele: Ungesaka yao ebisɛl’ino la kaaka yao likaela (eoka ya ngandi); kelaka batanga boisa bieto ebatiweke liyele, ango bondanda olo nda Use eboitoomelo, olo wiya angoiyela, olo sambola angobebesa wao;
english: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

lokele: eoka olo ayali bondanda waɛ, botema waɛ ngo ko omao. Bofiili la Likɔkɔmɛlɛ
english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

lokele: Wanjaka bɛkɔli ngau nda tɛta yanu la undaka täla yanu bianesomu,
english: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

lokele: ani oyali ngo ko kwa bato ebakoumbakela liinwi lia ngɛnɛ wau nda elambɔ ya lisɔngɔni, mbo akayeke inde la akatiteke inde, limɔ iyo kolioel’inde bome lisasaya.
english: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

lokele: Bɛkɔwa ana bende la limɛngɔ, eoka akayeke ngɛnɛ wau, inde koosh’iyo ani bakolamb’inde. Itoonga lanu wewe, mbo ngɛnɛ ona kokanda bɔkɔli, atoyales’iyo se, limɔ atoya okael’iyo bieka.
english: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.

lokele: Eya ngo ko nda ɛsɔkɔ, ambo ko la yömbe kongo, nde inde koosh’iyo ongoma, bɛkɔwa ana bende la limɛngɔ fuu.
english: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.

lokele: Olüwi nde ndolüwa mbo eya ngo mbo ngɛnɛ wa ndakɔ alüwäkä oso ko mbile eyekayeke ewa wiya, ani alambäkä la botengu l’ani atiamachäkä mbo ndakɔ yande efindolomoko la wiya.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.

lokele: Eokao enganaka yose, eoka Wana wa Boto eyaka nda mbile eyeitoenyela lanu.
english: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”

lokele: Petelo loonga mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, osotela nd’iso ebombila-bo kwa eoka ya bato batotina?
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”

lokele: Limɔ Ngɛnɛ mbo— ¿Ndai to atoyala bonyafala wa likɔchi la wa wɛlï oyasotalia inde bonyafala wa bato bande mbo akaelek’iyo bieka yau la lisho lioengana?
english: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

lokele: Bɔkɔwa ona ende la olau la limɛngɔ ani ngɛnɛ wande atoyaosh’inde nda likuwa lia bɔfɔnɔ-bo.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

lokele: Isoonga lanu wewe mbo atotalia boto ona bonyafala wa yeka yande bitotina.
english: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

lokele: Nde eyambo bɔkɔwa ona obe, eonga nda botema wande mbo— Ngɛnɛ wami asoumwaka oya; lamao inde koakola oomaka bɛkɔwa batolome la batomali, la ndolaka la ndomwaka, la ndowaka bänä,
english: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,

lokele: limɔ ngɛnɛ wa bɔkɔwa ona eyaka nde nda bocho ebotïlüwe inde la ebotiwɛlɛ inde ngɛnɛ baiso, atomomol’inde la fimbo la atosɛl’inde amamwito la ebatilendelomo.
english: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

lokele: Nde bɔkɔwa ona oyalüwäkä lisangi lia ngɛnɛ wande nde angokomyel’inde, angolitesa lisangi liande, inde ekuchomoko la tɔnyɔlɛ wike;
english: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

lokele: kongo ko oyatialüwäkä, nde kokelaka njasɔ yoengana likuchi, inde ekuchomoko la tɔnyɔlɛ tɔmyo kongo. Eingo, ebafomu nde wike, ambo befelomoko imɔ ko wike; la oyasotaliomo, ona efelomoko botalia imɔ. Tokange etwaokäkä Yesu
english: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

lokele: Isoya oyata bösä nda wenda-bo. ¿Iye eyelɛmbi nde’mi eyambo wao bokongana?
english: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

lokele: Yende la lilufi elikalufimoko’mi, aina tokange etokanjomu Imi konda akakɔchɔmɔkɔ liao!
english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

lokele: ¿Otangi nde mbo isoyasɛlɛ lilatemi nda wenda-bo? Mbayɔ, Imi mbo, kangä liwesani.
english: Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

lokele: Ko anyo bato bɔɔmwi nda ndakɔ ɛmɔi batokaakana, basatɔ kowesana la bambale, bambale la basatɔ.
english: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

lokele: Batowesakana, sango la wana wande; wana otolome la sango; nyango la wana otomali; la wana la nyango wande; boïlana la wali wa wana; la wali wa wana la boïlana.
english: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.” Micah 7:6

lokele: Limɔ Inde loonga imɔ la bikuke ya bato mbo— Wɛnɛ bafita la mbole, ino koonga lisasaya mbo— Mbula y’efalala etotɔnɔ, la etotɔnɔ ongoma.
english: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.

lokele: Wɛnɛ lofofo lotosokwa fangi ya liɔmbɛlɛ, ino koonga mbo— Buse botoya l’etao; la botoya nde l’etao ongoma.
english: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

lokele: Ino balimbakeli, bolüwi nde ndolembeela wɛnɛli wa buse la se; ¿Monito otilüwe ndoleembela wɛnɛli wa mbile-ye?
english: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?

lokele: ¿Monito boitoleembela, ko ino angɛnɛ, yao ebiengani ndokela.
english: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

lokele: Atɔkɛ aɛ la wiyani okakomyelomo loasɔ oso wa bokumi, kotaka ndosilesa loao nda mboka mbo atakɛs’aɛ ende juge, la mbo juge atakɛs’aɛ ende Botingani wa bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, mbo bonyafala atakand’aɛ bɔnyɔlɔlɔ.
english: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

lokele: Isoonga laɛ mbo otiasekwe omao ko nd’akakambeke aɛ bitotina fɛɛ, angotikala ango sɛngi.
english: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny. 12:59

lokele: Nda mbile-ao bamɔi loyakambes’Inde loasɔ loa BaNgalilai bamɔi, mbo Pilato asobiäkä bakila bau amamwito la nyama eyoläk’iyo ndotamba Mungu, nda lifaefi.
english: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— ¿Otangi nde mbo BaNgalilai bana bayaläkä bato babe boeta BaNgalilai batotina basi ko eoka mbo baokesakomökö bifembi ani?
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

lokele: Isoonga lanu mbo— Mbayo, la sakolo ko ino bokalangana, ani ino bosɛɛsɛlɛkɛ imɔ ko ongoma.
english: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

lokele: ¿Kwa eba liu la bonanɛi ebawäkä la loukwo loa ndakɔ ya botalemu bofi nda Siloa; otangi nde mbo bayaläkä bato ba batwanelo boeta batotina basi nda Yelusaleme?
english: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

lokele: Isoonga lanu mbo— Mbayo, la sakolo ko ino bokalangana, ani ino bosɛɛsɛlɛkɛ imɔ ko ongoma.
english: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

lokele: Yesu lota imɔ ko bombila-bo:— Boto ɔmɔi alɔɔ̈kɔ̈ bosau nda elanga yande, limɔ ayäk’inde oyalukä sau, angwɛnɛ tuma.
english: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.

lokele: Inde loonga la bosali oyatinganäkä l’elanga mbo— Tɛnɛngo, miaka isato kw’eyayeliki’mi oyaluka tuma nda bosau-bo, kongo ko ikɔsi; tindaka wao, ¿Bosoemakala nda nyɛlɛ wawa litina moni?
english: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’

lokele: Botingani lomutola mbo— Tamachaka wao imɔ ko emwaka-bo, kond’atofuwaka’mi nyɛlɛ, limɔ itota toi,
english: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

lokele: lamao eyambo bota tuma nda mwaka boyai, ambo olau; nde eyambo botiɔtɛ, aɛ kotinda wao. Botomali losäsesomo nda lise lia Yenga
english: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

lokele: Nda lise lia Yenga, aekesäkä Yesu nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ,
english: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

lokele: botomali lɔɛnɛlɛ omao oyayaläkä la bolimo wa lokambo ko miaka liu la bonanɛi la ainamäkä angokɔkɔlɔ ndoemesa bindo yande ango sinyo.
english: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.

lokele: La ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ Yesu wɛnɛ inde, Inde lota otomali lioi, Inde mbo— Botomali, ososɔmbɔlɔmɔ lokambo elole laɛ.
english: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

lokele: Inde lota besamba yande nda lokomba loande, lisasaya otomali loninwa, inde loinela Mungu.
