english: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

lokele: Lamao Bokumi wa ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ losoma finɛ eoka mbo Yesu louwesa boto nda lise lia Yenga; inde loonga la bato mbo— Bacho ba likuwa bende liambɛ, yauku to la bacho ana mbo bosäsesomoko, inga nda lise lia Yenga,
english: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

lokele: Nde Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— Ino balimbakeli! ¿Oto la oto wanu, aitosɔmbɔlɔ mbolo kwa funda yande, okakɛse yao mbo bimweke balia ango la lise lia Yenga?
english: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?

lokele: Tɛnɛ ebotomali-bo, wana wa Abalayama, oyasokandomo la Satana ko miaka liu la bonanɛi, lotiengane mbo asɔmbɔlɔmɔkɔ likala-li la lise lia Yenga?
english: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

lokele: Aongäk’Inde baoi-ba, ebaiyel’Inde lofomo sɔni la batotina loomalaka eoka ya bikeli ya tala ebiakelomökö lande. Bembila yasi yokweekela Bɔkɔta wa Use
english: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

lokele: Eokao Inde loonga mbo— ¿Bɔkɔta wa Mungu bole kwa iye? Itokwela wao l’iye?
english: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

lokele: Bole kwa lokoto loa mbasɛ, boto lɔɔsɔ loao, inde lolɔɔ loao nda elanga yande, loao lɔtɔ, loao lokonda isandu angɛnɛ limɔ nɔli bitoya oyakela bikalingo yau nda beta ya shao.
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

lokele: Inde loonga imɔ liasi mbo— ¿Itokwela Bɔkɔta wa Mungu l’iye?
english: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

lokele: Bole kwa fulofulo eyundi otomali ndokaisa la ndosoya nda kilo isatɔ ya lɔkɛ̈kɛ̈ (eoka yokela lituma) mbo bitotina biulweke la fulofulo. Bandai batouwesomo
english: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures 13:21 of flour, until it was all leavened.”

lokele: Atandeläkä Yesu bekenge la tokekenge, Inde loekekesa bato olo aetäk’Inde la mboka yɔkɛ fangi ya Yelusaleme.
english: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

lokele: Boto ɔmɔi lofel’Inde mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, bende to bamyɔ ebauwesomu? Yesu loonga mbo—
english: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

lokele: Fumbanesaka ndɔɔtɔ nda bome ewamwanu, eoka Imi mbo, bende bato wike ebakoluka ndɔɔtɔ omao, nde baitokɔkɔlɔ;
english: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

lokele: eoka akaemaleke ngɛnɛ wa ndakɔ, la akalieke inde bome, ino koakola ndoemakala lousa la ndotitaka bome la ndoonga mbo— Ngɛnɛ, lioelak’iso bome, nde Inde atomutola lanu mbo— Itilüwe ino; ¿Wende yandai?
english: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

lokele: Limɔ boakola ndoonga mbo— Iso toliki bieka, tomwiki nde amamwito laɛ, waekesak’iso nda lɔ̈mbɔ loasu.
english: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

lokele: Nde Inde eongaka lanu mbo— Isokambes’ino mbo Itilüwe ino; ¿wende yandai? Sokwa ende’mi, ino bakeli ba njasɔ bibe.
english: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

lokele: Omao eyalaka bileli la ngɛlɛtɛ ya bainyo ani akɛnɛk’ino wɛnɛ Abalayama la Yisaka, la Yakobo la Batɔndɔli batotina amamwito nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu l’ani ino angɛnɛ bolaumbolomoko lousa.
english: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

lokele: Bato basi besokwaka fangi ya batɛmwɛlɔ ba bonyanya la fangi ya litele, la fangi ya nord la fangi ya sud ndoyayalaka se nda bieka nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo, bende mbisa bako eba oso, l’eba oso beyalaka ko mbisa.
english: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

lokele: Nda mbile-ao BaFalusi bamɔi loya ende Yesu, iyo mbo— Kɛndɛ, okasokwa nda yese-ye, eoka Helodi asangi ndool’Aɛ.
english: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

lokele: Inde lomutola lau mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ okaonga la faa ena ako Bolimbo mbo— Tɛnɛ! louse la lɛlɛngɔ itokusola belimo ebe la itosäsesa eba kambo ndɔɔlɔlɔ limɔ la bocho wa isatɔ, yetungesa likuwa liami.
english: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

lokele: Kongo ko loengani nde lami mbo itangweke la louse la lɛlɛngɔ la yöse imɔ eoka lotienganeke mbo Bɔtɔndɔli aolomoko nda bokenge wasi, kangä nda Yelusaleme!
english: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

lokele: Aeko Yelusaleme, Yelusaleme oyatoolaka batɔndɔli, oyatökushaka batälɛ boola ebatomomuku end’aɛ; aina mbile eyokiki Imi yɛmɛ yosonjaka bana baɛ, kwa atokukya kɔkɔ bana bande ose ya bafafu bande, kongo ko ino angolɛmbɛ.
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

lokele: Tɛnɛ, bokenge wanu bosomachana lanu ko isimo, kongo ko isoonga lanu mbo— Otiangoɛnɛ’mi imɔ konda eyekaongek’ino mbo— Limɛngɔ liyeke lande oyatoya nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ.
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’” Psalms 118:26

lokele: Nda lise limɔi lia Yenga, ayaläkä Yesu nda ndakɔ ya Bokumi ɔmɔi oyäkä BoFalusi, iyo lolamb’Inde la shɔngɔlɔ;
english: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

lokele: boto ɔmɔi oyaäkä la lokambo loa eila lɔɛnɛlɛ oso wande.
english: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

lokele: Kwaamao Yesu lofela Bekumi la BaFalusi mbo— ¿Engani nde la Bikela ndosäsesa boto la lise lia Yenga kwa angoengana?
english: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

lokele: Kongo ko iyo loyala tau. Limɔ Yesu lounda boto, Inde losäses’inde, Inde lomach’inde akɛkɛ.
english: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

lokele: Limɔ Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Ndai wanu, eya mbo funda yande angoko mbolo yande ekwa nda liulu nda lise lia Yenga, oitosaola yao lisasaya?
english: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son 14:5 or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”

lokele: Batiakɔkɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ ndomutoel’Inde nda loasɔ-lo.
english: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lotela bato ebatomökö lioi nda elambɔ bombila ani ɛnɛ̈k’Inde mbo iyo lokalukake kangala ebieti olau, Inde mbo—
english: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

lokele: Botomo lioi nda elambɔ ya lisɔngɔni, oyalëke se nda kangala eyeteli, eoka eluwa boto wa lokuku eloeteli eloaɛ, atatomo imɔ,
english: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

lokele: limɔ ngɛnɛ wa elambɔ oyati l’aɛ lande lioi, ataoyaonga laɛ mbo— Faefaka boto-yo kangala-ye; limɔ aɛ angɛnɛ otoemala la sɔni okayala se nda kangala eyetikali liili.
english: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

lokele: Nde botomo lioi nda elambɔ, kɛndɛkɛ okayala nda kangala ya liili mbo akayek’inde oyati aɛ lioi, inde koonga laɛ mbo— Wina, yauku l’ono nda kangala eyeti. Ongoma ototɛmyɔmɔ nda baiso ba batotina ebatoyalana laɛ nda elambɔ.
english: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.

lokele: Eoka boto oyatotaliak’inde angɛnɛ, ɛɔndwɛsɔmɔkɔ se hɔndwa, la oyatoɔndwa se inde angɛnɛ, etaliomoko tala.
english: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

lokele: Lamao Inde loonga la boto oyatäk’Inde lioi nda elambɔ mbo— Bokela elambɔ, kwa la löwa, kwa la ocho, otëke baina laɛ, kwa bitungani yaɛ, kwa beoto yaɛ, kwa bafoka ebayalani laɛ, eoka mbo batata imɔ ko aɛ lioi eyau, l’ano batosakanesa loasɔ.
english: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

lokele: Kongo ko, bokela elambɔ, taka eba touwe, la ebitukulu, la eba bikoti, la eba betuku,
english: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

lokele: limɔ otoyalaka la limɛngɔ fuu eoka bati ango la yeka yoinel’aɛ; nde otoinolomo yao nda bakuswelo nda liwa ba eba liengani.
english: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

lokele: Okäkä boto ɔmɔi w’ebayalanäkä lande nda bieka ebaoi-ba, inde mbo— Boto oyatola bieka nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu eyalaka nde la limɛngɔ fuu.
english: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Boto ɔmɔi akeläka elambɔ efi la atäkä bato wike lioi;
english: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

lokele: enganäkä mbile yola inde lotoma bɔkɔwa wande okaongake l’ebatomökö lioi, mbo— Yauku, eoka bitotina bisoela.
english: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’

lokele: Nde iyo yaatotina lisanga loakola ndolukä litina liofeka ndoya. Oyo wa oso mbo— Isombiki nde elanga, isɔkɛ okaticha yao, isosombol’aɛ mbo imɛsɛlɔmɔkɔ.
english: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’

lokele: Wasi mbo— Isombiki mbolo bɔɔmwi ya likuwa, isɔkɛ okakotesa yao, isosombol’aɛ mbo imɛsɛlɔmɔkɔ.
english: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

lokele: Wasi mbo— Isosɔngɔ wali, eokao itikɔkɔlɛ ndoya.
english: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’

lokele: Ongoma bɔkɔwa loinwa, inde lokambesa ngɛnɛ wande njasɔ-bi. Limɔ ngɛnɛ wa ndakɔ loonga la bɔkɔwa wande mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ mangu nda mboka la toloto, eshaka l’ono eba touwe, la e’bitukulu, la eba bikoti, la eba bituku.
english: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’

lokele: Limɔ bɔkɔwa loonga mbo— Ngɛnɛ, losokelomo kwa akambesi aɛ’mi, nde elela ekosandelu se.
english: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’

lokele: Ngɛnɛ loonga la bɔkɔwa mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ nda balabala la biëli okatinjak’iyo mbo baɔtɛkɛ, litina mbo ndakɔ yami etumeke
english: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

lokele: eoka isoonga lanu mbo, Angwɛnɛ angɔɔmɔi w’ebatomökö lioi nde kooka elala ya elambɔ yami. Baoi ba Yesu nda lɔkɛndɔ
english: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen. 14:24 ’”

lokele: Bikuke ya bato wike bakɛsɛnɛkɛ lande; Inde lokikwa end’iyo la Inde loonga lau mbo—
english: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

lokele: Boto eya ende’mi, nde angoiyela sango wande la nyango, la wali, la bana, la bitungani, la baelo, imɔ ko la liwawi liande angɛnɛ, ambo atikɔkɔlɛ oyala boeki wami.
english: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard 14:26 his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.

lokele: Boto oyaitotolaka lieka liande angɛnɛ oyatuta’mi, ambo atikɔkɔlɛ oyala boeki wami.
english: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

lokele: Tɛnɛ, ɔmɔi wanu esanga ndoswaka ndakɔ ya botalemu efi; ¿aitotayalaka se ndotangaka loketi loa bieto mbo atayala la yao yoengana ndosilesa liswi lia ndakɔ?
english: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

lokele: Aenaka ongoma, ani atoakol’inde ndoswa batalɛ nda nyɛlɛ, lamao angokɔkɔlɔ ndɔɔlɔlɛsɛ ndakɔ, limɔ akɛnɛkɛ bato ongoma, iyo komuchamucha la twɛlɔ, iyo koonga mbo—
english: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

lokele: Boto-yo aakoläkä ndoswa ndakɔ efi nde atikɔkɔlɛ ndosilesa yao.
english: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

lokele: Loasi imɔ; bokota oyatɔkɛ okanana bita la bokota wasi; ¿Aitotayala se ndoenyakela kwa mbo atokɔkɔlɔ ko la bato bilɛfu liu okanana la bokota wasi oyatoyatowana lande la bato bilɛfu kama imbale?
english: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

lokele: Nde eyambo atienyele ongoma, limɔ, akoyali oyɔmɔi esika, atotoma ikomya sha wange okafela likomyi liotinya lokele.
english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

lokele: Ko ongoma, boto wanu oyaitosɛnyana la eyande bitoti, aitokɔkɔlɔ ndoyala boeki wami.
english: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

lokele: Bokwa bole to olau; ¿Nde eya to mbo bokwa botemba shokana, botokana shokana liasi l’iye?
english: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

lokele: Botiengan’imɔ yeka, kwa ndota nda nyɛlɛ, kwa nda liɔlɔ; bato batokusha wao tungi. Oyale la batoi booka, aokeke!
english: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

lokele: Limɔ bɛsɔnji ya bɛsɔmbi la bato ba njasɔ ibe, iyo yaatotina loya tina lande ndoyalaila Yesu;
english: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

lokele: la BaFalusi la Batikasa imɔ loimaima mbo— Boto-yo atonyangela ebabe la atolana lau bieka.
english: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”

lokele: Eokao, Yesu lokambes’iyo ebombila-bo, Inde mbo—
english: He told them this parable:

lokele: ¿Oni boto wanu oyayali la bɛkɔkɔ kama liu, elefesa ango ɔmɔi wau, aitomacha yao kama libwa la libwa nda isimo, ani inde atɔkɛ okaluke bona ebosolefana, ko nd’akoshek’inde wao?
english: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

lokele: Akoshek’inde wao, inde kota wao nda kɔndɛ yande la limɛngɔ;
english: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

lokele: limɔ akayek’inde nda ndakɔ yande, inde kota baina lande la bayalani lande lioi, inde koonga lau mbo— Okaka limɛngɔ amamwito lami, eoka isoosha bɔkɔkɔ ewalefäkä.
english: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’

lokele: Imi nd’atoonga lanu-mbo— Ko ongoma limɛngɔ liokanaka nda Use loasɔ loa boto ɔmwito wa obe oyatokalangana, elitoeta limɛngɔ loasɔ loa bato kama libwa la libwa ba liengani, ebati la boeno wa likalangani. Bieto ebilefani
english: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

lokele: Botomali to oyale la falanga liu; ¿elefesa lɔmɔi, mbo aitoanesa täla, aitɔɔmbɔkɔ ndakɔ okaluke la bofiili kond’akoshek’inde loao?
english: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma 15:8 coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

lokele: Limɔ akoshek’inde loao, inde kota baina la bayalani lande lioi, mbo— Okaka limɛngɔ amamwito lami, eoka isoosha lofalanga elolefesiki’mi.
english: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’

lokele: Itoonga lanu mbo— Ko ongoma limɛngɔ liokanaka nda baiso ba Bakitomo ba Mungu loasɔ loa boto ɔmwito wa obe oyatokalangana. Wana oyalefani
english: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

lokele: Yesu loonga mbo— Boto ɔmɔi aaka la bana batolome ambale,
english: He said, “A certain man had two sons.

lokele: la etungani loonga la sango wande mbo— Fafa, faka’mi likaɔ lia botiko elikaɔlɛkɛ’mi. La sango lokaana lau bitotina yande.
english: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.

lokele: Mbisa ya becho bimɔi itungangɔlɔ losɔnjaka eyande bitoti, inde lomacha bokenge wande okakɛ yese y’esika; omao inde lomelekesa bieto yande ko la yeka wawa.
english: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

lokele: La asilesäk’inde bieto yande bitotina, limɔ löndo lofi lokwa nda yese ena, inde loakola ndoyala la boeno ofi.
english: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

lokele: Inde lɔkɛ okawatema la boto ɔmɔi wa yese ena la boto ona lotom’inde nda bilanga yande mbo afeke ndei yande bieka.
english: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

lokele: Inde lookaka yɛmɛ yookanelo la mboso ya kunde eyaläkä ndei, nde angwɛnɛ boto wof’inde yeka.
english: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

lokele: Aenyäk’inde loasɔ loande, inde mbo— Aina basali ba sango wami bende la bieka yoengana la yosandelo se ani imi nd’asowa eyamaya l’isiyɛ.
english: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!

lokele: Itoemala ikɛkɛ ende sango wami, yeongaka lande mbo— Fafa, isotwanelo oso wa Use la nda baiso baɛ imɔ,
english: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.

lokele: itiengane ndotangomo imɔ wana waɛ; sɛlɛkɛ’mi kwani ayali basali baɛ.
english: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’

lokele: Inde loemala, inde lɔkɛ ende sango wande. Nde akoyal’inde esika, sango wande lɔɛnɛ wana, inde lookel’inde ngandi, inde lokwa mangu okakusamel’inde kingo, inde lofa wana ichɔu;
english: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.

lokele: Wana loonga la sango mbo— Fafa, isotwanelo oso wa Use la nda baiso baɛ, itiengane ndotangomo imɔ wana waɛ; sɛlɛkɛ’mi kwani ayali basali baɛ.
english: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

lokele: Kongo ko sango loonga la bɛkɔwa yande mbo— Mangumangu; eshaka kanju eyelau finɛ, watesak’inde, fak’inde iketi shota nda isangakala shande la tokwaka twa batindi bande,
english: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.

lokele: eshaka efembeli ya ngɔmbɛ bonuku, olaka yao, toleke elambɔ la limɛngɔ;
english: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate;

lokele: eoka mbo wana-yo wami awäkä la akoyali; alefäkä, nde asɔɛnɛlɛ oko liasi; la iyo loakola ndoficha limɛngɔ.
english: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.

lokele: Kongo ko wana wange loyala nda elanga. Ainwäk’inde la ayaläk’inde tina la ndakɔ inde looka bakwengu la bɛɛlɛ ya bisha.
english: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

lokele: Inde lota wana ɔmɔi lioi, inde lofel’inde litina lia loasɔ-lo.
english: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.

lokele: Inde lomutola mbo— Etungani yaɛ asoya la sango waɛ asoola efembeli ya ngɔmbɛ bonuku, eoka asoosh’inde la bosasu la wɛlï.
english: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’

lokele: Nde boloo lotwa bolengi, la atilɛmbɛkɛ ndɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ. Nde sango wande lokuswa ndokalɔmbɔkɔl’inde,
english: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.

lokele: limɔ inde lomutola la sango mbo— Toka! Isokuwel’aɛ kwa bɔkɔwa emiaka-bi wike, ikatefoli ndola yaɛ ango ɛmɔi, nde otifeke’mi ango efembeli ya mbuli mbo ificheke limɛngɔ amamwito la baina lami;
english: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.

lokele: kongo ko asoya ewana-yo waɛ, oyasolaka bieto yaɛ amamwito la batomali ba bolëfë, oisoolel’inde efembeli ya ngɔmbɛ bonuku.
english: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’

lokele: Sango loonga lande mbo— Wana, wende lami becho betotina, la bitotina yami yende imɔ ko eyaɛ.
english: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.

lokele: Loondu nde mbo tokeleke elambɔ la limɛngɔ, eoka etungani yaɛ’yo, awäkä nde akoyali la liwawi; alefäkä, nde asɔɛnɛlɛ oko liasi.
english: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”

lokele: Yesu loonga imɔ la baeki bande mbo— Boto wa lifoka ayaläkä la Bonyafala wotinganaka la ndakɔ la bilanga yande la bato lowanjela Bonyafala ende ngɛnɛ wande mbo asomelesa yeka yande.
english: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

lokele: Ngɛnɛ lot’inde lioi, inde loonga lande mbo— ¿Loni-lo elosoka’mi loasɔ loaɛ? Faka lokasa loa likuwa liaɛ eoka otikɔkɔlɛ imɔ ndoyala Bonyafala.
english: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

lokele: Limɔ Bonyafala loenyela, inde mbo— ¿Itokel’iye, eoka mbo ngɛnɛ wami atosokoela’mi isosha sha bonyafala? Iti la botatulu wosha nyɛlɛ; yende la sɔni ndömba bieka.
english: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

lokele: Iluwi nde elotokela’mi mbo akafangolomoko’mi nda bonyafala, limɔ batonyangela’mi nda ndakɔ yau angɛnɛ.
english: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

lokele: Inde lota batotina ebaäkä la ngɛnɛ wande belima, ɔmɔi la ɔmɔi; inde loonga l’ewa oso mbo— ¿Wende la ngɛnɛ wami bolima wa loni loketi?
english: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

lokele: Inde mbo— Biangola ya baita kama liu. Bonyafala loonga lande mbo— Ɔsɔkɔ lokasa loa bolima, yalaka se mangu la sɔnɔkɔ mbo kama bɔɔmwi.
english: He said, ‘A hundred batos 16:6 of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

lokele: Limɔ inde loonga la wasi mbo— ¿Aɛ imɔ, ole la bolima wa loni loketi? Inde mbo— Batanga ba bofonga kama liu. Inde loonga lande mbo— Ɔsɔkɔ lokasa loa bolima, sɔnɔkɔ mbo kama bonanɛi.
english: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors 16:7 of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

lokele: Ngɛnɛ loinela Bonyafala wande oyatienganaka eoka akeliki nde la eläläka; eoka nda fɛtɔ yau, bana ba wenda-bo balongeli nde bana ba löwa la eläläka.
english: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

lokele: Imi nd’atoonga lanu mbo— Sɛlɛkɛ ebanu baina ko la bieto ya eba bolimbakeli, litina mbo akasileke yao, limɔ batonyangel’ino nda kumbo ya loiko.
english: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

lokele: Boto wolendelomo la loasɔ lɔkɛkɛ, nda loasɔ lofi ale imɔ wolendelomo; boto oyati la liengani nda loasɔ lɔkɛkɛ, nda loasɔ lofi imɔ ati la liengani.
english: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

lokele: ¿Ango ino oti bolendelomo nda loasɔ loa bieto y’ebatiengane, ndai to atolendelo ino nda njasɔ ya wewe?
english: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

lokele: ¿Ango botiyaleke bato bolendelomo la eya boto wasi, ndai to atof’ino eyanu angɛnɛ?
english: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?

lokele: Angwɛnɛ bosali wokɔkɔlɔ oyala bɔkɔwa wa bangɛnɛ bambale, eoka ataiyela ɔmɔi, nde kosamaka oy’ɔmɔi, angoko mbo atawatemaka la ɔmɔi, nde koolya oy’ɔmɔi. Botikɔkɔlɛ ndoyala bɔkɔwa wa Mungu la bieto lisanga.
english: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.” 16:13

lokele: BaFalusi baäkä ebasami bieto finɛ, iyo looka baoi-ba batotina, iyo lomuchamuchela Yesu.
english: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Ino wende ebatangi nde mbo wengani nda baiso ba bato, nde Mungu nd’aluwi betema yanu, eoka ebitoinelomo finɛ la bato, yao Mungu kɔɛnɛ efu.
english: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

lokele: Bikela ya Mungu la Batɔndɔli yaäkä konda mbile ya Yoane, limɔ mbisa yande ko kwani, mboli ya Bɔkɔta wa Mungu bisotomo boekï la boto la boto atɔɔtɔ nda wao ko la botatulu.
english: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

lokele: Kongo ko ndofanjaka lioi limwitoto lia Bikela ya Mungu lole lowau lolongela elosokola Use la se.
english: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

lokele: Eokao boto oyasosokola wali wande, kosɔngɔ wasi, ambo asotwa nyongo, la boto oyatosɔngɔ wali oyasokolomu ende bolome, ambo inde imɔ asotwa ko nyongo. Ewa lifoka l’ewa shomba
english: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

lokele: Aäkä nde boto ɔmɔi wa lifoka lifi oyawatäkä bisinda ya bofɛkɔ la loketi lofi. Inde lolengela lise la lise ko ndolaka bieka ya bonuku.
english: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

lokele: La oto wasi wa shomba, lina liande liko Lasalo, loingakala tina la bome wa ewa lifoka, la bindo yande lotuma la bakülü.
english: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,

lokele: Inde looka yɛmɛ finɛ yolaka bakɔmbɔ ebakwäkä ose ya mɛsa y’ewa lifoka, la ngwa loya oyalɛtɛkɛ bakülü bande.
english: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

lokele: Mbisa yamao, ewa shomba lowa, la bakitomo lotol’inde konda bokuku wa Abalayama; la ewa lifoka lowa imɔ kowa, inde loömbomo nda losai.
english: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.

lokele: Ayaläk’inde nda ewelo la okäk’inde bemusi finɛ, inde loila baiso likolo inde loɛnɛ Abalayama ko esika la Lasalo ani aingaläkä nda bokuku wandë.
english: In Hades, 16:23 he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

lokele: Inde loamama mbo— Fafa Abalayamao, okelaka’mi ngandi, tomaka Lasalo mbo alufieke bɔmbɔ wa isangakala shande nda balia ndɔɔngɛsɛ lolamɛ loami, eoka isooka lobaba nda wambe-bo.
english: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

lokele: Nde Abalayama loonga mbo— Wana, enyelaka mbo ayaläk’aɛ nda wenda waɔlɔkɔ eyaɛ bieka bilau, la Lasalo imɔ ko eyande bieka bibe nde kwani inde asɔɔnjɔnjɔmɔ l’ono, nde aɛ wende la lobaba.
english: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.

lokele: Loaso loasi imɔ, lofundukwela lofi losokɔkɔmɛsɔmɔ atiteni yasu lanu mbo ebale la yɛmɛ yoakala end’ino angokɔkɔlɔ la angwɛnɛ oto wanu wotenana ono end’iso.
english: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’

lokele: Limɔ inde mbo— Eokao, itosombol’aɛ, Fafa, mbo otomek’inde omolo nda ndakɔ ya sango wami, eoka
english: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—

lokele: yende la bitungani bɔɔmwi, mbo aluwesek’iyo wewe mbo bataya imɔ koya nd’elela-ye ya bomusi.
english: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’

lokele: Nde Abalayama loonga mbo— Bende la kasa ya Mɔsɛ la eya Batɔndɔli, bokek’iyo.
english: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’

lokele: Kongo ko inde mbo— Mbayo, Fafa Abalayama, nde eyambo ɔmɔi ekuswa nda liwa okakɛ end’iyo, limɔ bekalangana.
english: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’

lokele: Nde Abalayama loonga mbo— Eya ngo mbo batioke Mɔsɛ la Batɔndɔli, ambo ɔmɔi ekuswa nda liwa, iyo batiangoimela.
english: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”

lokele: Yesu loonga la baeki bande mbo— Angokɔkɔlɔ ndokufa mbo tolonga totakwesa bato nda obe, kongo ko aeko wale end’inde oyatotake twao.
english: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

lokele: Loeti nde l’olau mbo litalɛ lifi likandomoko nda kingo yande, la mbo aumbolomoko nda balia ba eliya, eoka liwa lia oyatokwesa ɔmwito wa ebana-ba bakɛkɛ litolonga liwa lina.
english: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

lokele: Tatichaka bekeeli yanu angɛnɛ. Eyambo etungani yaɛ ekela obe, imaka inde; ekalangana, mɛsɛlɛkɛ inde.
english: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

lokele: Ango ekeel’aɛ obe bakela bosambale nda lise limɔi, nde einwaka end’aɛ bainwa bosambale oyaonga mbo— Isokalangana; otomɛsɛl’inde.
english: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

lokele: Batomomu loonga la Ngɛnɛ mbo— Ulwesaka liimeli liasu.
english: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde loonga mbo— Boyala la liimeli kwa lokoto lɔkɛkɛ loa mbasɛ, ani ino koonga la isandu sina mbo— Aɛ angɛnɛ uwolomo, lɔɔmɔ nda balia ba eliya; ongoma shao kolitesa lioi lianu.
english: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.

lokele: ¿Ndai wanu eyala la bɔkɔwa oyatokuwa elanga, angoko oyatotingana la bɛkɔkɔ, akasokwek’inde nda elanga oyaya okenge, koonga lande mbo— Yauku, yalaka se lisasaya nda bieka?
english: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?

lokele: Mba, aitotaonga lande mbo— Takomyielaka’mi yeka yola, wataka esinda ya mɛsa, telaka’mi bieka nda mɛsa; akaleke la akainweke’mi, limɔ mbisa aɛ kola, aɛ komwa.
english: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?

lokele: ¿Atofaka bɔkɔwa kelekëlë ko eoka asokeel’inde ko yao ebisokambesomo inde?
english: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

lokele: Ino imɔ ko ongoma; akasilek’ino lotimbana lototina elokambesomuku ino, ongaka mbo— Tole bɛkɔwa ya bikwɛlɛ, tosokela ngo ko lotimbana eloengani nde lasu okela. Bato liu ba baɛndi
english: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”

lokele: Akɛndɛk’Inde nda mboka ya Yelusaleme, Inde loetaka atiteni ya yese ya Samalia l’eya Ngalilai.
english: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

lokele: Ɔtɔ̈kɔ̈ Yesu nda bokenge ɔmɔi, bato liu ba baɛndi loyatowana lande, iyo losikama ko esika,
english: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

lokele: iyo loamama mbo— Yesu, Bɔkɔta, okelaka iso ngandi.
english: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ Inde wɛn’iyo, Inde loonga lau mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ okɛnɛsɛ BaKanga komba yanu.
english: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

lokele: Loyaka nde mbo aɛk’iyo, iyo lotanesomo. Ɔmɔi wau, ɛnɛk’inde mbo asosäsesomo, inde loinwa ani inde loinela Mungu la limiki lifi,
english: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

lokele: inde lotulia bɔmbɔ se nda batindi ba Yesu, inde lof’inde kelekëlë; boto ona aäkä wa Samalia.
english: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— ¿Bato liu batitanesomuku; ebamɔi libwa anima to?
english: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

lokele: ¿Angwɛnɛ boto wasi woinwa oinela Mungu, sakolo ko oy’ati wa BaYuda?
english: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Emalaka, kɛndɛkɛ eyaɛ; liimeli liaɛ lisouwes’aɛ. Mbile eyetoya la Bɔkɔta wa Mungu
english: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

lokele: Afelomökö Yesu ko la BaFalusi mbo— ¿Eni mbile eyekayeke la Bokota wa Mungu? Inde lomutoel’iyo mbo— Bokota wa Mungu botiye ko la botichakëlä,
english: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

lokele: baitoonga mbo— Tɛnɛ bole eya, kwa anamana; Tɛnɛ ngo Bokota wa Mungu bole atiteni yanu!
english: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde loonga la baeki bande mbo— Becho belayaka ebilokeke ino yɛmɛ yɔɛnɛ lise limwito lia Wana wa Boto, kongo ko botilɛnɛkɛ ngo wao.
english: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

lokele: La beongaka lanu mbo— Tɛnɛ anamana; Tɛnɛ onomono! Ɔkɛ̈kɛ, otutëk’iyo!
english: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

lokele: Eoka kwa atobalikima ibalibali fangi ɛmɔi ya use okaamela imɔ konda fangi eyɛmɔi ya use, kwa akayaleke imɔ ko Wana wa Boto nda lise liande.
english: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

lokele: Kongo ko loengani nde lande mbo ataokesomoko biale wike la afekelomoko la efɛtɔ-ye.
english: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

lokele: Kwa ayaläkä wenda nda mbile ya Noa, ko ongoma nda bacho ba Wana wa Boto;
english: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

lokele: balakäkä bieka, bamwäkä, basɔngɔ̈kɔ̈ bali, basɔngɛsɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ konda bochoao ewaɔtɔ̈kɔ̈ Noa nda ndakɔ ya watɔ, limɔ fela efi loya oyaombes’iyo yaatotina hombe.
english: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

lokele: Ongoma imɔ, kwa ayaläkä bato nda mbile ya Loti, baläkä, bamwäkä, basombäkä la baungesäkä liöngo, balɔɔ̈kɔ̈ bilanga, baswäkä ndakɔ
english: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

lokele: kongo ko nda bocho ewasokwäkä la Loti nda bokenge wa Sodoma, bösä la kibiliti yatɔnɔ̈kɔ̈ nda use, la wao loombes’iyo yaatotina hombe.
english: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

lokele: Loyalaka ongoma la lise likɛnɛlɛkɛ Wana wa Boto.
english: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

lokele: Nda bocho ona boto eyala olikolo lia ndakɔ ani biengo yande bitikali nda tindo, asulwëke se ndɔɔsɔ yao; boto eyala nda elanga, ainwëk’imɔ bokenge.
english: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

lokele: Enyelaka loaso loa wali wa Loti.
english: Remember Lot’s wife!

lokele: Boto oyatolukä mboka yotekamesa liwawi liande, atolefesa nde liao; la oyatolefesa liao, inde nd’atoikesa liao.
english: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

lokele: Itoonga lanu mbo— Nda bocho ona, bambale beingala nda tange ɛmɔi; ɔmɔi kosokolomo, oyɔmɔi komachana.
english: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

lokele: Batomali bambale betwanga befonga amamwito nda lokulu ko lɔmɔi, ɔmɔi kosokolomo, oyɔmɔi komachana.
english: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

lokele: Iyo lofel’Inde mbo— Anima to, Ngɛnɛ? Inde loonga lau mbo-Olo akayaleke bolyo, ambo toyoiyoli kosɔngɔkɔmɔ ngo ko omao.
english: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”

lokele: Inde lotel’iyo bombila litina mbo basombokoleke mbile la mbile angolewa.
english: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

lokele: Inde mbo— Aäkä nda bokenge ɔmɔi Bokomyi wa njasɔ oyatiawangäkä Mungu la oyatialitesäkä bato,
english: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

lokele: la aäka’imɔ nda bokenge ona lotika loa olome, inde lɔkɛkɛ bakɛ wike ende Bokomyi, inde mbo— Longesaka’mi end’inde oyatolukela’mi loasɔ.
english: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

lokele: Ko mbile bimɔi Bokomyi angolɛmbɛ, nde mbisa inde loenyela nda botema mbo— Itiwange Mungu la itilitese bato,
english: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

lokele: kongo ko eoka elotika-lo atookekesa’mi likati, itolongesa nde inde mbo atatɛkwɛsɛ’mi la baya bande wike.
english: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

lokele: Ngɛnɛ loonga mbo— Okaka to lioi eliaongäkä Bokomyi ebotienganeke.
english: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

lokele: ¿Mbo Mungu aitolongesa ebande ebasoaa Inde ebatoleel’Inde la löwa la ocho, aitolombakel’iyo?
english: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

lokele: Isoonga lanu mbo Atolonges’iyo la mangu. Kongo ko akayeke Wana wa Boto, atoosha nde liimeli nda wenda-bo? BoFalusi la Bɔsɔnji wa Bɔsɔmbi
english: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

lokele: Inde loonga imɔ bombila-bo eoka ya bamɔi ebatangi nde mbo bengani, nde basɛɔkɔli bato basi.
english: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

lokele: Yesu mbo— Bato ambale lɔkɛ nda ndakɔ ya Mungu okasombola, ɔmɔi WaFalusi, oyɔmɔi Bɔsɔnji wa bɔsɔmbi.
english: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

lokele: WaFalusi loemesana fii ndosombola ko inde angɛnɛ, inde mbo— E Mungu, isof’Aɛ kelekëlë mbo im’iti kwa bato basi, kwa eba biya, l’ebatiengane, l’eba nyongo, ango kwa ebɔsɔnji-bo wa bɔsɔmbi.
english: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

lokele: Itokilaka bieka ko becho imbale nda yenga, itofaekefa lifaefi lia likao lia liu lia bitotina ebitɔɔlɔ’mi.
english: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

lokele: Nde Bɔsɔnji loemala ko esika, atilɛmbɛ ango oila baiso likolo, nde inde loomaka bokükü wande; inde mbo— E Mungu, mɛsɛlɛkɛ’mi oyatokelaka obe.
english: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

lokele: Yesu mbo— Isoonga lanu mbo oyo bɔsɔnji ainywäkä eyande ani aenganesomu nda baiso ba Mungu, inga boto ona ako BoFalusi; eoka boto oyatotaliak’inde angɛnɛ, ɛɔndwɛsɔmɔkɔ se; nde oyatɔɔndwa se, inde angɛnɛ etaliomoko tala. Yesu la Bainɛngɛ
english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

lokele: Bato loeshel’Inde ko bana baoli mbo amatek’iyo, nde ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ baeki ongoma, iyo loim’iyo.
english: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

lokele: Nde Yesu lota bana lioi mbo bayeke tina lande limɔ Inde mbo— Machaka bana baoli bayeke ende’mi; okufesëk’iyo, eoka Bokota wa Mungu wende ende ebofɔnɔ-bo.
english: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

lokele: Wewe, itoonga lanu mbo— Boto oyaitoaela Bokota wa Mungu kwa atokela wainɛngɛ, ani inde angɔɔtɔ omao. Boto wa Lifoka
english: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

lokele: Bokumi ɔmɔi lofel’Inde mbo— ¿Boekesi Bolau, ikeleke moni mbo yɔ̈lɛkɛ loiko loa layalaya?
english: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— ¿Monito ototanga’mi bolau? Angwɛnɛ ango ɔmɔi olau sakolo ko Mungu angɛnɛ.
english: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

lokele: Oluwi nde Bikela; Ochwëke nyongo, Wolëke oto, Wiyëke, Otëke nanga, Litesaka sango la nyango waɛ.
english: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’” Exodus 20:12-16

lokele: Bokumi loonga mbo— Isolitesa e-bikela-bi bitotina konda isenge shami konda eweuse.
english: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

lokele: Okäkä Yesu ongoma, Inde loonga lande mbo— Osoomelo ko lɔmɔi kongo, tambesaka bitotina ebile laɛ, kaelaka ebatouwe, ongoma otɔɔlɔ bondanda nda use; limɔ yauku, tutaka’mi.
english: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

lokele: Okäk’inde ebaoi-ba inde lowa ikɛnɛnɛ finɛ eoka aäkä la bieto ya likama.
english: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

lokele: Enɛ̈kɛ̈ Yesu ongoma, Inde mbo— Aina bowaü ende bafoka ndɔɔtɔ nda Bokota wa Mungu.
english: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

lokele: Bowaü wa ngamela woeta nda lifola lia iolo, botiengane la bowaü wa oto wa lifoka ndɔɔtɔ nda Bokota wa Mungu.
english: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

lokele: Bato ebokäkä ongoma, loonga mbo— ¿Ndai to atokɔkɔlɔ ouwesomo?
english: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

lokele: Inde loonga mbo— Ebitikɔkɔlɛ bato, ko yao Mungu nd’atokɔkɔlɔ.
english: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

lokele: Petelo loonga mbo— Tɛnɛ, iso nd’asomacha eyasu angɛnɛ la tosotuta Aɛ.
english: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Wewe, itoonga lanu mbo boto oyamachi ndakɔ, angoko wali, angoko bitungani, angoko ebaot’inde, angoko bana ko l’eoka ya Bɔkɔta wa Mungu,
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

lokele: ɛɔlɔkɔ nde yao ko baɔlɔ wike kwani nda mbile-ye, la nda mbile eyekayeke, ɛɔlɔkɔ loiko loa layalaya.
english: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

lokele: Yesu loesha eba liu la ambale lande elela ɛmɔi, Inde loonga lau mbo— Tɛnɛ ngo, tɔsɔkɛ Yelusaleme, omao bitotina eyatäkä batɔndɔli nda kasa yau eoka ya Wana wa Boto, ambo yao bitokɔchɔmɔ kɔkɛ.
english: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

lokele: Atokɛsɔmɔ ende bato ba yese yasi, batot’Inde kungutu, atotwɛlɔmɔ sɔi,
english: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

lokele: batoom’Inde fimbo, la batool’Inde la nda lise lia asatɔ atouwa liasi.
english: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

lokele: Nde batiaoshäkä litina lia e njasɔ-bi; baoi-ba baisameläk’iyo, batialuwak’imɔ baoi ebaongäk’Inde lau. Boto wa Botuku nda Yeliko
english: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

lokele: Iyäkä Inde tina la bokenge wa Yeliko boto wa botuku loyalaka se nda ɔngɔ wa mboka ani atömba yeka.
english: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

lokele: Okäk’inde bilundi ya ekuke ya bato ebatoeta, inde lofela litina moni.
english: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

lokele: Iyo lokambes’inde mbo ende Yesu wa Nasaleta oyatoeta.
english: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

lokele: Lamao inde loamama mbo— Yesu Wana wa Dawidi, okelaka’mi ngandi!
english: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

lokele: La bato ebetaka oso loimak’inde mbo ayaleke tau; kongo ko inde loamama liamami lioeta, mbo— Yesu Wana wa Dawidi, okelaka’mi ngandi!
english: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu losikama, Inde loonga lau mbo baeshek’inde; iyak’inde tina, Yesu lofel’inde mbo—
english: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

lokele: ¿Olɛmbi nde mbo ikeelek’aɛ iye? Inde loonga mbo— Ngɛnɛ, mbo yɛnɛkɛ liasi.
english: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Ɛnɛkɛ to liasi; liimeli liaɛ lisouwes’aɛ. Kwaamao, inde lɔɛnɛ liasi, inde lotuta Yesu, inde loinakela Mungu. Ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ bato batotina ongoma, iyo loinakela Mungu la bɛɛlɛ.
english: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”

lokele: Yesu lɔɔtɔ nda Yeliko la Inde lotandela bokenge, la
english: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

lokele: aäkä omao boto, lina liande liko Sakayo, inde ayaläkä Bokumi wa basɔnjaki ba bɔsɔmbi la aäkä lifoka.
english: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

lokele: Sakayo loluka fofe yɔɛnɛ ani ayali Yesu, kongo ko atiakɔkɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ eoka ya ekuke ya bato, litina mbo aäkä buwe.
english: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.

lokele: Nde inde lokwa mangu oso w’ato, inde lolila isandu sha liönjï mbo ɛnɛkɛ Yesu eoka loäkä nde mbo Yesu eteke bokenge la mboka ena.
english: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.

lokele: Ayäkä Yesu nda elela ena, Inde loila baiso likolo, Inde loonga lande mbo— Wendesa, Sakayo, sulwaka se, eoka louse lole loami ndoyala nda ndakɔ yaɛ.
english: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

lokele: Limɔ Sakayao loumama osulwa se, inde lonyangela Yesu la limɛngɔ.
english: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

lokele: Ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ bato ongoma, iyo yaatotina loimaima, iyo mbo— Asɔkɛ okaingala nda ndakɔ ya boto obe.
english: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”

lokele: Kongo ko Sakayo loemala fii, inde loonga la Ngɛnɛ mbo— Tɛnɛ ngo, Ngɛnɛ, itofaefa eba touwe botüku wa biengo la bieto yami; yaambo yɔnɔkɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ yeka ende boto la wiya, itoinola yao binɛi binɛi nda lɔmɔi lɔmɔi.
english: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Louse liuwesi lisoya nda e-ndakɔ-ye, eoka inde nd’ale imɔ wana wa Abalayama.
english: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

lokele: Wana wa Boto asoya nde ko ndoluka la ndoyuwesa oyasolefa. Bɔkɔwa wa lotimbana la ewa booshaosha
english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

lokele: Okäka’iyo ebaoi-ba, Yesu loonga imɔ ko liasi, Inde lotel’iyo bombila eoka asoya oko tina la Yelusaleme la eoka mbo batangäkä nde mbo Bɔkɔta wa Mungu bosamboya kwaamao nda mbil’ao.
english: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.

lokele: Eokao Inde loonga mbo— Boto ɔmɔi wa bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa bɔkɔta, lɔkɛ lɔkɛndɔ nda yese y’esika ndokafomo isosha sha bɔkɔta, limɔ ndoinwa liasi.
english: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

lokele: Nde inde lota bɛkɔwa yande liu lioi, inde lofaef’iyo mia liu ya falanga, oto la oto mia ɛmɔi, inde loonga lau mbo— Timbesaka bokalala la yao, konda akainweke’mi.
english: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, 19:13 and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

lokele: Nde bato ba bokenge wande angɛnɛ loiyel’inde, iyo lotoma ikomya sha wange ombisa yande okaonga lande mbo— Totilɛmbɛ mbo oyo ayaleke bɔkɔta wasu.
english: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’

lokele: Loaaka mbo, ainwäk’inde ani asosila ndɔɔlɔ isosha sha bɔkɔta, inde loonga mbo bɛkɔwa ena ebifak’inde of’iyo mia ya falanga bayeke oso wande, mbo aluweke botalia ebosɔɔl’iyo nda bokalala wau.
english: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

lokele: Ewa oso loya, inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ, mia yaɛ ɛmɔi esokondela mia liu.
english: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

lokele: Ngɛnɛ loonga lande mbo— Eingo ko, bɔkɔwa olau ako aɛ, eoka osokɔcha loasɔ lona lɔkɛkɛ, ɔlɔkɔ isosha shokomya bekenge liu.
english: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

lokele: Ewa ambale loya la inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ, mia yaɛ ɛmɔi esokondela mia bɔɔmwi.
english: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

lokele: Ngɛnɛ loonga imɔ lande mbo— Aɛ imɔ, ɔlɔkɔ isosha sha bekenge bɔɔmwi.
english: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

lokele: Limɔ wasi loya, inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ, tɛnɛ mia yaɛ ena, eyüchiki’mi nda itambala;
english: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

lokele: eoka yawangäk’aɛ eoka wende boto owaü, la otoilaka yeka ebititek’aɛ se, la ototwaka bina ebitilɔɛk’aɛ.
english: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

lokele: Ngɛnɛ loonga lande mbo— Ko la lioi lia bɔnɔkɔ waɛ angɛnɛ, isotenel’aɛ loasɔ-lo, aɛ bɔkɔwa obe, oluwiki nde mbo yende boto owaü, la mbo itoilaka yeka ebititeke’mi se, la mbo itotwaka bina ebitilɔɛkɛ’mi;
english: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

lokele: eokao monito otiafäkä bieto yami ende bato ebatoisaka yao la bɔsɛɛli, mbo akainyweke’mi, yaɔlɔ eyami bieto la bɔsɛɛli lisanga?
english: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

lokele: Ngɛnɛ loonga la ebande ebemaläkä omao mbo— Ɔnɔkɔɛlɛk’inde mia ena, faka inde oyayali la mia liu.
english: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

lokele: Nde bamɔi loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ ale to la mia liu.
english: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

lokele: Ngɛnɛ lomutola mbo— Itoonga lanu mbo inde oyasɛli yeka, efomoko yasi; nde oyatisɛlɛ yeka, atɔɔnɔkɔɛlɔmɔ ko yao eyesɛl’inde.
english: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

lokele: Nde loasɔ loa ebaiyeläkä’mi, ebatialɛmbɛkɛ mbo iyaleke Bɔkɔta wau, eshaka iyo eyamaya, singesa iyo oso wami! Yesu loiya nda Yelusaleme
english: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

lokele: Asiläkä Yesu ndoonga, Inde loetel’iyo oso okakɛ likolo nda Yelusaleme.
english: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

lokele: Iyak’Inde tina la Betefange I la Betania nda löngo eloatangomökö Löngo loa Elaya, Inde lotoma baeki bambale bande lotomo,
english: When he came near to Bethsphage 19:29 and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,

lokele: Inde mbo— Takɛndɛkɛ nda bokenge ebole oso wanu, la akaɔtɛk’ino ina, otoosha efembeli ya punda ekandomu, boto ayayali kɔni nda bɔkɔngɔ wa yao, faikolaka yao, eshaka yao lono.
english: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.

lokele: Boto efel’ino mbo— ¿Monito otofaikola yao? ongoma ino koonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ asoeno yao
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”

lokele: Baeki ebatomomökö, lɔkɛ, iyo loosha loasɔ chaa kwa aongi Yesu lau.
english: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.

lokele: Afaikoläkä’iyo efembeli ya punda, bangɛnɛ ba yao loonga lau mbo— ¿Otofaikola efembeli ya punda monito?
english: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

lokele: Iyo loonga mbo— Ngɛnɛ asoeno yao.
english: They said, “The Lord needs it.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo loesha yao ende Yesu; iyo lotalia bisinda yau nda bɔkɔngɔ wa yao la iyo loyalesa Yesu olikolo.
english: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.

lokele: Aɛk’Inde ongoma, iyo lofalola bisinda yau se nda mboka.
english: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.

lokele: Asishanäk’Inde tina la bokenge, olo asulwi mboka se nda löngo loa Elaya, ekuke etotina ya baeki loakola ndoficha limɛngɔ la ndoinakela Mungu la limiki lifi eoka ya bisisho ebiɛnɛ̈k’iyo,
english: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

lokele: iyo mbo— Limɛngɔ la Bolau ende Bɔkɔta oyasoya nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ; Lilatemi olo nda Use la loomalo lofi anamana nda isɔkɔ sha Use.
english: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Psalms 118:26 Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

lokele: BaFalusi bamɔi ebayaläkä nda ekuke loonga lande mbo— Boekesi, imaka baeki baɛ.
english: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

lokele: Inde lomutola lau mbo— Isoonga lanu mbo ango beyala ngo tau, ambo batalɛ nde koanjanja.
english: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

lokele: Iyäkä Yesu tina, Inde lotangela bokenge, Inde loleela wao,
english: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

lokele: Inde mbo— Aɛ Yelusaleme, Eya mbo boluwa ambo louse-lo, ko yao ebisikioeshel’aɛ lilatemi! Kongo ko bisoisomo mbo otɛnɛ yao.
english: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

lokele: Kongo ko mbile eyaka nde ani biyani laɛ beswelaka likula lia bita liolingel’aɛ; bekufesak’aɛ la ndokuswaka la ndɔɔtɔkɔ;
english: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

lokele: betulunga bokenge la bana baɛ, angomacha litalɛ olikolo lia litalɛ ango limɔi, eoka otilembeeleke yose ya lotichako loaɛ. Lotaneso loa balɛlɛ ba Tempelo
english: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

lokele: Lamao Inde lɔɔtɔ nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, Inde loakola ndokusola bato ebatoungesa yeka omao.
english: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

lokele: Inde mbo— Losɔnɔmu nda lokasa mbo Ndakɔ yami etotangomo ndakɔ ya lisomboli, nde ino nd’asokela la yao, ko lisɛkɔ lia eba biya.
english: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ Isaiah 56:7 but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!” Jeremiah 7:11

lokele: Yesu loekekesäkä bato lise la lise omao nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu. Kongo ko kanga ebieti la baekesi ba Bikela amamwito la betoli oso ya bato imɔ, iyo loluka fofe yool’Inde,
english: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

lokele: kongo ko batiɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ yao eoka bato batotina lowɛlɛ Inde bonono wookamela lioi liande.
english: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

lokele: Lise limɔi aekesäk’Inde bato nda ndakɔ ya Mungu, la anangoeläk’iyo Mboli Ilau, kanga ebieti la baekesi ba Bikela la biange loosh’Inde,
english: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the 20:1 priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

lokele: iyo loonga lande mbo— Kambesak’iso, ¿Otokelaka njasɔ-bi la sini isosha? ¿Ale to ndai oyasof’Aɛ isosha-si?
english: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

lokele: Inde lomutola lau mbo— Imi imɔ nd’atofel’ino lofelo; kambesaka’mi to; ¿Lilufi lia Yoane moni, liaäkä lia Use, kwa lia bato?
english: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

lokele: Iyo angɛnɛ lotafelakana, mbo— Eya mbo toonga mbo liaka elia Use, limɔ Inde koonga lasu mbo— ?Eokao, monito otiaimelak’inde?
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

lokele: Nde toonga mbo— Elia bato, limɔ batotina batokushel’iso batalɛ, eoka basoimela mbo Yoane aaka Bɔtɔndɔli.
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

lokele: Iyo lomutoela Yesu mbo batiluwe olo asokwi la liao.
english: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— La Imi imɔ angokambes’ino isosha esitokela’mi la njasɔ-bi. Bombila wa Balɔi babe
english: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde loakola ndotela bato ebombila-bo. Oto ɔmɔi alɔɔ̈kɔ̈ elanga ya tuma inde lomachela balɔi elanga, limɔ inde lɔkɛ yese yasi okaumwa omao.
english: He began to tell the people this parable: “A 20:9 man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

lokele: Ayäkä mbile ya eula ya tuma, inde lotoma bɔkɔwa ende balɔi mbo bafaefek’inde tuma twa elanga yande, kongo ko balɔi lokuchak’inde, iyo losaya bɔkɔwa besamba wawa.
english: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

lokele: Limɔ Inde lotomel’iyo bɔkɔwa wasi, iyo lokuchak’imɔ ko inde, iyo lokeel’inde sɔni, iyo losay’inde besamba wawa.
english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

lokele: Liasi imɔ, inde lotoma ewa asatɔ, iyo loswel’Inde bafwa, iyo loilya inde lousa loa elanga.
english: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

lokele: Limɔ ngɛnɛ wa elanga loonga mbo— Yekelaka nd’iye? Yetomaka wana wami ebosamomu, eluwa batolites’inde.
english: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

lokele: Kongo ko ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ balɔi wɛnɛ wana iyo loongana mbo— Oyo ende bosangesi wa botiko, toolek’inde mbo botiko boyaleke ewasu.
english: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

lokele: Ongoma iyo loumbol’inde lousa loa elanga, iyo lool’inde. ¿Ngɛnɛ wa elanga ekeelaka balɔi moni?
english: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

lokele: Eyaka nde la atosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ balɔi ana la efaka bato basi elanga yande. Okäkä bato ongoma, iyo loonga mbo— Loyalëke ongoma!
english: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

lokele: Nde Yesu lowɛlɛ iyo bonono, Inde mbo— Ongoma to, litina moni lia lioi-li eliatomökö nda Lokasa (loa Mungu) mbo— Litalɛ lina elisofeka baswi, Liao lisoswomo nda botö wa ndakɔ?
english: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’? Psalms 118:22

lokele: Boto oyatokwa likulya nda litalɛ-li, inde kounya; liao likwa likolo lia boto, liao komiak’inde kwa fututi.
english: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

lokele: Kanga ebieti la baekesi ba Bikela lokotaka ndoundes’Inde ko nda mbile-ao kongo ko iyo lowänga bato eoka iyo lolüwa mbo Yesu asotombol’iyo nda bombila-bo. Bosɔmbi wa Kaisala
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

lokele: Iyo lowɛlɛ Yesu baiso lamao iyo lotoma tɔtɔmbi ebakwekeläkä bato ba momongo ebatoyalaila baoi bande mbo ko l’eoka ya lioi, iyo kowamb’Inde ende oyo w’isosha la likomyi ako Komanda.
english: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

lokele: Eba lofel’Inde mbo— Boekesi, tosolüwa mbo otoongaka la mbo otoekekesa ko yao ebiengani chaa la oitokwelakwela bɔmbɔ wa boto nde otoekekesa mboka ya Mungu la wewe;
english: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

lokele: ¿Losoengana lasu ofaefa Kaisala bɔsɔmbi, kwa angofa?
english: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

lokele: Kongo ko Yesu loleembela bɔlɔwäne wau, Inde loonga lau mbo— Tambaka’mi lofalanga.
english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?

lokele: ¿Lole la bolendela wa ndai la lisɔni lia ndai? Iyo mbo— Eya Kaisala.
english: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

lokele: Yesu loonga to lau mbo— Eokao, inolaka to ende Kaisala ko eya Kaisala, inolaka ende Mungu ko eya Mungu.
english: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

lokele: Batiakɔkɔlɔk’imɔ ndound’Inde nda lioi lina oso wa bato nde iyo lomwaala limutoli liande, iyo loyalaka tau. Litɛmwi nda Liwa
english: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.

lokele: Limɔ bamɔi ba BaSadoke loya end’Inde ebaitoimela litɛmwi nda liwa; iyo lofela Yesu mbo—
english: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

lokele: Boekesi, Mɔsɛ nd’atelak’iso lokasa mbo, boloo ewa la wali ani atiote wana, limɔ etungani atosangola lotika loa boloo mbo aoteleke boloo wana.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

lokele: Baäkä nde batolome bosambale, bana ba sango ɔmɔi; boloo wau losɔngɔ wali la inde lowa, angwɛnɛ wana,
english: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

lokele: limɔ ewa ambale losangola lotika,
english: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

lokele: la ewa asatɔ ko ongoma, iyo bosambale ko ongoma nde batiote wana;
english: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

lokele: limɔ otomali lowa liili.
english: Afterward the woman also died.

lokele: ¿Eokao, nda litɛmwi nda liwa, otomali atoyala wali wa ndai, eoka iyo batotina bosambale basɔngɔ̈kɔ̈ ko inde?
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Bana ba wenda-bo batosɔngɔ la batosɔngɔmɔ,
english: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

lokele: kongo ko ebaondu nde ndoiyela wenda ona la litɛmwi nda liwa, iyo ana baitosɔngɔ la baitosɔngɔmɔ;
english: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

lokele: la batikɔkɔlɛ imɔ ndowa liasi, eoka bengani bakitomo; bende bana ba Mungu eoka mbo bende bana ba litɛmwi nda liwa.
english: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

lokele: Ko Mɔsɛ angɛnɛ nd’aluwesäk’iso nda lokasa loande loaso loa Isasandu mbo ebasowa batotɛmwa nda liwa; omao inde loonga mbo Ngɛnɛ Mungu wa Abalayama, Mungu wa Isaka, Mungu wa Yakobo.
english: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Exodus 3:6

lokele: Ati to Mungu wa ebawi, kangä wa ebale la liwawi, eoka end’Inde batotina bale la liwawi.
english: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

lokele: Limɔ bamɔi ba baekesi ba Bikela lomutoel’Inde mbo— Boekesi, oongi nde lioi lilau finɛ,
english: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

lokele: eoka batiatendeläkä imɔ ofel’Inde lofelo ango lɔmɔi.
english: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lau mbo— ¿Monito batoonga mbo Masiya ende wana wa Dawidi?
english: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

lokele: eoka Dawidi angɛnɛ nda Lokasa loa Bɛɛlɛ loonga mbo— Ngɛnɛ loonga la Ngɛnɛ wami mbo— Yalaka se nda bosamba wami wa olome,
english: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

lokele: Kond’atosɛlɛ’mi baiyani baɛ ose ya batindi baɛ kwa esolo.
english: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’ Psalms 110:1

lokele: Ongoma Dawidi lotang’Inde mbo Ngɛnɛ; ¿Ale to wana wande imɔ la moni?
english: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

lokele: Nda batoi ba bato batotina Inde loonga la baeki bande mbo—
english: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

lokele: Lambaka batikasa ebalɛmbi okɛndɛkɛndɛ la bisinda bisa la mbo balamolomoko nda baongo la mbo bafomoko kangala ya betoli oso nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ la bilela ya oso nda bilambɔ.
english: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

lokele: Batɔɔsɔkɔ ndakɔ ya ebawelu olome; la batosombolaka basomboli ba yumwa ko la bolimbake wau. Nde belafomoko se la likuchi lioeta.
english: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

lokele: Iläk’Inde baiso likolo, Inde lɔɛnɛ bato ani batotaka lifaefi liau nda sanduku ya lifaefi, bamɔi bafoka,
english: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

lokele: nde Inde lɔɛnɛ imɔ ko otomali oyawelu olome iuwe ani atota bakute ambale ina.
english: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins. 21:2

lokele: Yesu mbo— Wewe itoonga lanu mbo lotika-lo ende iuwe nde asota yao yoeta eya batotina;
english: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

lokele: eoka iyo ana batotina, basokusola sinyo sha lilya liau nda lifaefi, kongo ko inde oyale la iuwe asokusola bitotina, ango yao imɔ ebilendeluku inde. Lambaka la wɛlï-Boimo wa Yesu
english: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”

lokele: Aongäkä bamɔi loasɔ loa ndakɔ ya Mungu mbo eswomu nde la batalɛ bafi ba bɔfɛkɔ la biengo ebikusolomu nda lifaefi, Yesu mbo—
english: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

lokele: Yao ina ebisomwaal’ino, ambo mbile elayaka olo angwɛnɛ litalɛ ango limɔi lilamachomoko likolo lia liasi, batotina belaukolomoko.
english: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

lokele: Iyo lofelak’Inde mbo— ¿Boekesi, eni to mbile eyekayeke njasɔ-bi la eni ndembe yolembeela mbo bisamboya?
english: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

lokele: Inde loonga to mbo— Lambaka la wɛlï mbo botalimbomo, eoka bato wike batoya nda lina liami, ani batoonga mbo— Imi yende Inde; la mbo— Mbile esamboya. Otutëke to iyo!
english: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he 21:8 ,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

lokele: Nde atook’ino mboli ya bita la liyɛyɛ lifi, owëke la iwaesa eoka yao bilayaka nde, kongo ko losilo loitoya lisasaya.
english: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde loonga lau mbo— Yese la yese bitowesana, la bɔkɔta la bɔkɔta batowesana;
english: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

lokele: lotukeso loa nyɛlɛ lofi la elela la elela, fondo la tɔtɔ̈kɔ twa loo la towaesa la tokesa twa use toyaka.
english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

lokele: Nde oso wa ebitotina-bi batotel’ino njala yau, batokongolak’ino, batokɛs’ino nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ la nda bɛnyɔlɔlɔ, batosulyak’ino oso wa bɛkɔta la bakomanda eoka ya lina liami.
english: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

lokele: Yao nd’atoya la fofe yanu yoongela’mi oso wau.
english: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

lokele: Enyelaka to, otakelëke to olenda eoka ya baoi bomutoel’iyo,
english: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

lokele: eoka Imi nd’atofaef’ino liasala la wɛlï ebitialonge biyani bitoti lanu ofenyakana ango ofekela.
english: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

lokele: Kongo ko otowambomo ko l’ebaot’ino la bitungani yanu l’eba bɛkɔ̈kɔ yanu la baina lanu la bamɔi banu batoolomo lau;
english: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

lokele: batotina batoiyana lanu eoka ya lina liami.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

lokele: Nde angwɛnɛ loswee ango lɔmɔi loa betö yanu kosɛɛsɛlɛ.
english: And not a hair of your head will perish.

lokele: Ko la boliliya wanu ino bolakɔkɔmɛsɛ balimo banu la liwawi.
english: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

lokele: Akɛnɛk’ino wɛnɛ Yelusaleme bolingelomu la bikuke ya bita, limɔ waluwa mbo bɔlɛlɔ wa liömä bosamboya.
english: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

lokele: Lamao eba Yudea bakweke mangu konda föngo la ebatoyalaka atiteni ya okenge bakuswakusweke la ebatoyalaka nda lousa nda bilanga bainwëk’imɔ okenge.
english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

lokele: Eoka ebacho-ba bende bacho ba likundeli la likuchi, nda bao bitotina eyatomökö nda Lokasa loa Mungu bilakɔchɔmɔkɔ.
english: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

lokele: Aeko wale ende batomali ba lieme la ebatomwesa bana baɛlɛ nda bacho ana! Bifembi bifi nde bilayalaka nda yese etotina-ye la luno lolayalaka ende bato-ba.
english: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

lokele: Bato-ao belatindomoko la chaka, belaindomoko kala ndokɛsɔmɔ bɛkɔwa nda biese yasi bitotina; bokengɛ wa Yelusaleme bolamatekelomoko la batindi ba ebati BaYuda kond’akasileke mbile ya ebati BaYuda.
english: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

lokele: Bisisho bilɛnɛlɛkɛ nda liso lia use, nda tengai, la nda tolonge la nda wenda-bo toloi la loeyaeyo bilakwaka ende bato ba yese bitotina, eoka ya balundi ba balia la batutu ba eliya eyefi.
english: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

lokele: Bato belalɛkwaka la bɔwa woenyelaka njasɔ ebikayeke nda wenda-bo, eoka befoka ya use belatukatuka.
english: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

lokele: Limɔ bɛlɛnɛkɛ Wana wa Boto atoya nda bafita la bofoka la bɔfɛkɔ finɛ.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

lokele: Nde akaakoleke ebitotina-bi ndoya, limɔ yaimwaka yai la ilaka betö yanu likolo, eoka loendolomo loanu losamboya.
english: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lotel’iyo bombila, Inde mbo— Tichaka bosau, ango ko isandu shasi imɔ;
english: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

lokele: atofɛtɛ wao la kasa, osɔɛnɛ la ino angɛnɛ otolüwa mbo mbile ya eula esamboya.
english: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

lokele: Ko ongoma akɛnɛk’ino wɛnɛ enjasɔ-bi bisoya, lüwaka mbo Bɔkɔta wa Mungu bosoya tina.
english: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

lokele: Itoonga lanu wewe mbo— E-fɛtɔ-ye eitosila oso ani ebitotina-bi bikayi;
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

lokele: use la se bilawanjwaka bao, kongo ko baoi bami batilawanjwek’imɔ.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

lokele: Lambaka la wɛli mbo betema yanu bitawa kwa afofa yeka la liwa änä la bifembi ya liwawi-li la bocho ona botaundes’ino futuku kwa lisɔngɔ lia ilonga,
english: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

lokele: botoosha nde batotina ebatoyala fangi la fangi nda wenda-bo.
english: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

lokele: Eokao yalaka la botengu la sombolaka mbile bitotina, mbo bolongeke ndosokwaka bitotina-bi ebisamboya la ndoemesana oso wa Wana wa Boto.
english: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”
