lokele: Lise la lise Yesu loekekesa bato nda ndakɔ ya Mungu, nde la ocho Inde lokuswaka okaingala nda Löngo loa Elaya.
english: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

lokele: Bato batotina lokɛsɛnɛ end’Inde la nɔngɔnɔngɔ nda ndakɔ ya Mungu ndokok’Inde.
english: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

lokele: Elambɔ ya lituma yayäkä tina, yao lotangomo Elambɔ ya Lieti.
english: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

lokele: La kanga ebieti la batikasa loluka fofe yool’Inde; nde iyo lowanga to bato.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

lokele: Limɔ Satana lɔɔtɛlɛ botema wa Yudasi wa Keliote oyatangomökö ɔmɔi wa eba liu la ambale.
english: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

lokele: Inde lɔkɛ okaongane la kanga ebieti la betoli oso ya basilikani litina mbo awambeke Yesu end’iyo.
english: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

lokele: Iyo loomala finɛ, la iyo lotikel’inde lisakä liofaef’inde bieto.
english: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

lokele: Yudasi lokulia loasɔ la inde lolukä fofe yowamba Yesu ani ekuke ya bato etiyale lau. Elambɔ ya BaYuda
english: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

lokele: Limɔ lise lia elambɔ ya lituma loya, eloaakä lau ndoola bɔkɔkɔ wa Lieti.
english: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

lokele: Yesu lotoma Petelo la Yoane, Inde mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ okakomyel’iso Lieti mbo toleke liao.
english: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

lokele: Iyo lofel’Inde mbo— Olɛmbi mbo tokomyeke liao anima?
english: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Toka, akaɔtɛk’ino nda okenge, lamao ototowana la botolome oyatoli tɛi ya balia, tutak’inde nda ndakɔ eyekaɔtɛk’inde.
english: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

lokele: Limɔ ino koonga la ngɛnɛ wa ndakɔ-ao mbo— Boekesi asoonga laɛ mbo ¿Kuku ya ndakɔ eyetola’mi Elambɔ ya Lieti amamwito la baeki bami, anima to?
english: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

lokele: Limɔ boto-ao atotamb’ino kuku efi ya likolo eyesotonjomo la baonga, komyielak’iso omao.
english: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

lokele: Iyo lɔkɛ, iyo lɔɛnɛ kwa aongiki Yesu lau, iyo lokomya Elambɔ ya Lieti. Elambɔ ya Bɔkɔta
english: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

lokele: Ayäkä mbile ya bieka, Inde loyala se amamwito la batomomu liu la ambale,
english: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Ko la yɛmɛ efi, ilɛmbi nde ndola Elambɔ-ye ya Lieti oso wa tokange etokokeke’mi;
english: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

lokele: isoonga nde lanu mbo— Itialek’imɔ liao kond’akakɔchɔmɔkɔ litina lia liao nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde loaela kɔpɔ, Inde lofa Mungu kelekëlë, Inde mbo— Ɔsɔkɔ yao, kaelanaka yao, ino angɛnɛ;
english: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,

lokele: eoka itoonga lanu mbo— Itiamwe imɔ liamɔ lia boliki kond’akayeke Bokota wa Mungu.
english: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

lokele: Lamao Inde lɔɔsɔ lituma, Inde lofa Mungu kelekëlë, Inde louna liao la Inde lofaef’iyo liao, Inde mbo— Liende bindo yami, ebifomu loasɔ loanu, kelaka ani ndoenyekela’mi.
english: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

lokele: Inde lɔɔsɔ imɔ ko kɔpɔ ongoma mbisa yola, Inde mbo— E-kɔpɔ-ye yende Ngela Eyai eyetinyomu la bakila bami, ebatosendɔlɔmɔ eoka yanu.
english: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo! Bosamba wa ona oyatowamba’mi bole eya amamwito lami nda lionga.
english: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

lokele: Wana wa Boto atɔkɛ okakɛ kwa atomökö loaso loande, nde aeko wale ende boto ona oyatowamb’Inde!
english: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

lokele: Iyo loakola ndofelakana, iyo angɛnɛ, mbo ndai wau oyakakeleke eloasɔ-lo.
english: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

lokele: La iyo lowesakana imɔ mbo ndai wau atotangomo ewoeta ebamɔi.
english: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga lau mbo— Bɛkɔta ya biese yasi batokakales’iyo la eb’isosha likolo liau batotangomo mbo Bakelaolau.
english: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

lokele: Kongo ko loti ongoma end’ino; nde oyo wanu oyaetami, ambo inde ayaleke kwa itungangɔlo, la botoli oso wanu, ayaleke kwa bosali.
english: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

lokele: ¿Ndai to nd’atolongela, kwa inde oyatoyala se nda bieka kwa inde oyatokuwekel’inde nda lionga? Ati inde oyatoyala se ndola bieka? Kongo ko Imi yende sisi yanu kwa oyatokuwel’ino.
english: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

lokele: Wende to ebasoumwaka lami nda bakɔtɔlɔmu bami;
english: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

lokele: ongoma Imi nd’atof’ino isosha, kwa Sango wami nd’afäkä Imi Bɔkɔta,
english: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

lokele: mbo ino boleke la bomweke nda lionga liami nda yakakaelo yami ya Bɔkɔta la ino bolayalaka nda kangala y’isosha ndokomya tukela liu la imbale ya BaIsalaele.
english: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

lokele: Simona, Simona, toka, Satana asofelak’ino mbo afɛfɛk’ino kwa atofɛfɔmɔkɔ bofonga,
english: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

lokele: kongo ko Imi nd’asosombola Mungu loasɔ loaɛ, mbo liimeli liaɛ litalewa, la akakalanganek’aɛ, wakɔkɔmɛsɛkɛ basaɔ baɛ.
english: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.” 22:32

lokele: Petelo loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, yengani ndɔkɛ amamwito laɛ, angoko nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, ango nda liwa.
english: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

lokele: Yesu mbo— Petelo, Imi nd’asoonga laɛ mbo kɔkɔ angotata lɔkɔ̈kɔ̈lɔ̈kɔ̈ louse-lo, oso ani okaanganyi’mi baanganya basatɔ mbo otiluwe’mi.
english: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Atomäkä’mi ino lɔkɛndɔ angwɛnɛ litanga lia bieto, angwɛnɛ buku, angwɛnɛ tokwaka, waenökö nde yeka angɔmɔi? Iyo mbo— Totiaenöko yeka angɔmɔi.
english: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

lokele: Inde loonga to lau mbo— Nde kwani, oyale la litanga lia bieto, ɔsɛkɛ liao la buku imɔ lisanga; nde oyati la chaka, atambeseke bisinda yande mbo asombeke ɛmɔi.
english: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

lokele: Eoka isoonga lanu mbo biengani mbo yao ebiatomökö nda Lokasa bilakɔkɔmɔkɔ lami, biko mbo— Atangomökö nde ɔmɔi w’eba totefola twa bikela; eoka eyami bikɔchɔmɔkɔ nde.
english: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ Isaiah 53:12 For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”

lokele: Iyo mbo— Ngɛnɛ, tɛnɛ to chaka bimbale-bi! Nde Inde loonga lau mbo— Sɛlɛkɛ eya! Elanga ya Ngetesemane
english: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”

lokele: Akuswäkä Yesu, Inde lɔkɛ nda löngo loa Elaya, kwa akɛk’Inde lise la lise la baeki bande lotut’Inde.
english: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

lokele: Iyäk’Inde nda elanga, Inde loonga lau mbo— Sombolaka mbo otakwa nda lisoshelomu.
english: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”

lokele: Inde lɔkɛ sumbu isisika lau, kwa atokɔkɔlɔ okushomo lisasɛ, amao Inde loswa balui se, Inde losombola mbo—
english: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

lokele: Sango, bosanga ongoma, sokoelaka’mi ekɔpɔ-ye, inga to lisangi liami, kangä eliaɛ likelomoko.
english: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

lokele: Lamao bokitomo oyasekwi nda use lɔɛnɛlɛ end’Inde, inde lɔɔlɛsɛ Yesu bofoka.
english: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

lokele: Ayalak’Inde la bonui wa likama, Inde losombokola la bofiimbi, la bilungu lotɔnɔkɔ se nda nyɛlɛ kwa baongö ba bakila.
english: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

lokele: Emaläk’Inde mbisa ya lisomboli, Inde lɔkɛ ende baeki bande, Inde loosh’iyo baingali ilɔ sha ikɛnɛnɛ;
english: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Oingali nde moni? Emalaka la sombolaka mbo otaɔtɔ nda lisoshela. Liwambomu la liundomu lia Yesu
english: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

lokele: Aäkä Inde atoonga, kwaamao, ekuke ya bato loya amamwito lande oyatangomu Yudasi, ɔmɔi w’eba liu la ambale, inde lotol’iyo oso; inde losishana la Yesu okaumb’Inde ichɔu.
english: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga lande mbo— ¿Yudasi, ko la ichɔu otowamba nde Wana wa Boto?
english: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ ebakɛsɛni lande loaso eloyi oko tina, iyo mbo— Ngɛnɛ, Tosw’iyo la ambɔtɛ?
english: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

lokele: Ɔmɔi wau loswa bɔkɔwa wa kanga eyeti, inde lotena litoi liande lia fangi y’olome.
english: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

lokele: Yesu mbo— Taofe, macha eya! Inde lomata litoi, Inde losäsesa liao.
english: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this” —and he touched his ear and healed him.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga la kanga ebieti la betoli oso ya basilikani ba ndakɔ ya Mungu la biange ebayäkä oyundes’Inde, Inde mbo— ¿Oyeli nde’mi la chaka la totumbe, kwa mbo yende booni?
english: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

lokele: Ayaläkä’mi lanu lise la lise nda ndakɔ ya Mungu, otisisheke’mi besamba yanu; kongo ko mbile-ye ende fofe yanu la eya bofoka wa lilima. Lianganyi lia Petelo
english: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”

lokele: Iyo loundesa Yesu, iyo lɔkɛs’Inde nda ndakɔ ya kanga eyeti; nde Petelo lotuta esika.
english: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

lokele: Anesäk’iyo bösä atiteni ya lɔ̈mbɔ, iyo loyala se la Petelo loyala se amamwito lau.
english: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

lokele: Nde boseka ɔmɔi lɔɛn’inde ani ayali se nda liangangi lia bösä, la boseka losw’inde bonono, limɔ inde mbo— Oyo imɔ ayaliki lande.
english: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

lokele: Nde Petelo loanganya mbo— Botomali, itiluwe Inde.
english: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

lokele: Mbisa ya mbile sinyo, wasi lɔɛnɛ inde, inde mbo— Aɛ imɔ wende ɔmɔi wau. Nde Petelo mbo— Boto, iti wau.
english: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

lokele: Mbisa ya saa ɛmɔi, boto wasi loonga la boliliya mbo— Wewe, la boto-yo ayaliki imɔ lande, la ale imɔ wa Ngalilai.
english: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

lokele: Kongo ko Petelo loonga mbo— Boto, itiluwe elosoonga aɛ. Kwaamao, ani Petelo akoonga, kɔkɔ lota lokɔ̈kɔ̈lɔ̈kɔ̈.
english: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

lokele: Ngɛnɛ lokikwa, Inde lotichaka Petelo, lamao Petelo loenyela lioi eliaongäkä Yesu lande, mbo— Oso ani kɔkɔ ekati lɔkɔ̈kɔ̈lɔ̈kɔ̈ louse-lo, otoanganya’mi baanganya basatɔ.
english: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

lokele: Inde lokuswa lousa, inde lolela kɛlɛlikɛlɛli.
english: He went out, and wept bitterly.

lokele: Limɔ batolome ebaundäkä Yesu lomuchamucha Inde, iyo lokuchak’Inde;
english: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

lokele: limɔ alinjäk’iyo baiso bande, iyo lofelak’Inde mbo— Tɔndɔlɔkɔ; ¿Oyo ndai oyasokuch’Aɛ?
english: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

lokele: Iyo losungakel’Inde la baoi basi wike.
english: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

lokele: Atwäkä bonyanya, limɔ biange ya bato la kanga ebieti la baekesi ba Bikela losɔngɔkɔmɔ la iyo lɔkɛsɛ Yesu nda ikumbɛ shau, limɔ iyo mbo—
english: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

lokele: Eya mbo wende Masiya, kambesaka to iso. Inde loonga to lau mbo— Yekambes’ino, ino angoimela;
english: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,

lokele: yefelak’ino, ino angomutoela’mi.
english: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

lokele: Ko kwani Wana wa Boto eyalaka se nda bosamba w’olome wa bofoka wa Mungu.
english: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

lokele: Batotina loonga mbo— ¿Aɛ wende to Wana wa Mungu? Inde loonga lau mbo— Ino nd’aongi mbo yende ongoma.
english: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo mbo— ¿Twende imɔ la boeno wa tɔtɔmbɔ twasi? Iso angɛnɛ, tosooka ko nda bɔnɔkɔ wande angɛnɛ.
english: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”

lokele: Lamao ikumbɛ sitotina loemala, iyo lɔkɛsɛnɛ lande ende Pilato.
english: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

lokele: Iyo loakola ndowanjel’Inde, iyo mbo— Tosoosha eboto-yo ani atoengolesa bato ba tukela yasu; atofekel’iyo ndofa bɔsɔmbɔ ende Kaisala la atoonga mbo Inde angɛnɛ ale Masiya ako Bɔkɔta.
english: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”

lokele: Pilato lofel’Inde mbo— ¿Aɛ wende to Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda? Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— Aɛ nd’aongi ongoma.
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”

lokele: Pilato loonga la kanga ebieti la bikuke ya bato mbo— Itiɛnɛ litwanelo ango limɔi ende eboto-yo.
english: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

lokele: Kongo ko iyo lofëfë ndoonga mbo— Atofɔɔkɔlɔ bato la liekesi liande la nda Yudea, konda Ngalilai ko eyamaya.
english: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”

lokele: Okäkä Pilato ebaoi-ba, inde lofela kwa mbo boto-yo ayali nde wa Ngalilai.
english: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

lokele: Aluwäk’inde mbo Yesu ale wa yakakaelo ya Helodi, inde lotom’Inde ende Helodi oyayaläkä imɔ nda Yelusaleme nda bacho bana. Yesu la Helodi
english: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

lokele: Ɛnɛkɛ Helodi wɛnɛ Yesu, inde loomala finɛ, eoka ko la yumwa, inde looka yɛmɛ yɔɛnɛ Yesu loasɔ loa lokuku elook’inde; inde lɔlɛmbɛ imɔ ndwɛnɛ esisho eyekakeleke Yesu.
english: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

lokele: Inde lofelaka to Yesu felo wike kongo ko atimutoel’inde lioi ango limɔi.
english: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

lokele: Kanga ebieti la baekesi ba Bikela loemakala ina, iyo lowanjakel’Inde la bolengi.
english: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

lokele: La Helodi la basilikani bande losɛɔkɔl’Inde, iyo lomuchamucha Inde, iyo lowates’Inde bisinda ya bɔfɛkɔ finɛ, limɔ iyo loinol’Inde ende Pilato liasi.
english: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

lokele: La lise-ao Pilato la Helodi losukana basaɔ, eoka oso iyo loiyelanaka. BaYuda la Pilato lofa Yesu se
english: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

lokele: Lamao Pilato losɔngɔmɛsɛ kanga ebieti la betoli oso la bato imɔ
english: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

lokele: inde loonga lau, mbo— Oeshiki eboto-yo oso wami oyawanjel’Inde mbo atoengolesa bato, tɛnɛ ngo, isokɔtɔl’Inde oso wanu, itiɛnɛ litwanelo ango limɔi ende boto-yo nda njasɔ eyawanjelak’ino Inde;
english: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

lokele: imɔ ko la Helodi ongoma eoka asoinol’Inde end’iso. Tɛnɛ ngo, angwɛnɛ loaso ango lɔmɔi loengana liwa lokelomu lande.
english: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

lokele: Eokao, itokuch’Inde, limɔ itofaikol’Inde.
english: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

lokele: Nda mbile ya Elambɔ to, inde loyala la eyaelo yofaikoel’iyo ɔmɔi wa bɔnyɔlɔlɔ.
english: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast. 23:17

lokele: Bato batotina loanjanja la limiki limwito mbo— Sokola eboto-yo; faikoelak’iso Balaba!
english: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—

lokele: Balaba atomökö nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ eoka ya bosho la lioli lia bato.
english: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

lokele: Eokao Pilato loonga la bato liasi eoka alɛmbɛkɛ ndofaikola Yesu.
english: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

lokele: Kongo ko bato loanjanja mbo— Olak’Inde nda lieka, Olaka!
english: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

lokele: Inde lofel’iyo to lifela lia asatɔ, mbo— ¿Eoka iye to; boni obe ebosokel’Inde? Itiɛnɛ Inde la loasɔ ango lɔmɔi loengana la liwa; eokao itokuch’Inde, limɔ itofaikol’Inde.
english: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

lokele: Nde iyo loanjanja la bofiili la bamiki bafi; iyo lofelak’inde mbo aolomoko nda lieka. Bamiki bau la eba kanga ebieti lolongela bofoka bofi.
english: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

lokele: Pilato loluwes’iyo likomyi mbo lokelomoko kwa asosang’iyo.
english: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

lokele: Inde lofaikoel’iyo ona oyafel’iyo ako boto wa bosho la lioli la boto oyatomökö nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, kongo ko inde lofaef’iyo Yesu mbo bakeelek’Inde kwa asosang’iyo. Liwa nda lieka
english: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

lokele: Akɛndɛ̈k’iyo la Yesu, nda mboka iyo loundesa Simona oto wa Kulene ani atosekwa nda bilanga, iyo lotalia lieka nda batotoko bande mbo atoleke liao ombisa ya Yesu.
english: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.

lokele: Ekuke efi ya bato lotuta Inde, la batomali loomaka beküku la iyo loleel’Inde.
english: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

lokele: Kongo ko Yesu lokikwel’iyo, Inde mbo— Baseka ba Yelusaleme olelëke’mi, leelak’ino angɛnɛ la bana banu.
english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

lokele: Tɛnɛngo, becho belayaka ebelaongaka la bato mbo— Bende la limɛngɔ bako eba bikomba la sɔlɔ ebitiote bana, la baɛlɛ ebatimwese bana.
english: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’

lokele: Limɔ batoakola ndoonga la föngo mbo— Wɛlɛkɛmɛkɛ se olikolo liasu, la nda tolöngolöngo mbo— Linjakak’iso.
english: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’ Hosea 10:8

lokele: Eya to mbo bekela njasɔ-bi nda isandu shesi, bini bikakelomoko to nda eshomi?
english: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”

lokele: Bato basi bambale, bato babe finɛ, bakɛsɔmɔkɔ imɔ amamwito lande ndokaolomo.
english: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

lokele: Ayäk’iyo nda elela eyatangomökö mbo Longö, iyo loanyemesa Yesu nda lieka, l’ebato babe lisanga, ɔmɔi nda osamba wa olome la oyɔmɔi nda osamba wa wali.
english: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga mbo— Sango, mɛsɛlɛk’iyo, eoka batiluwe kwa atokel’iyo. Iyo lokaana bisinda yande ko ndota ngongo nda likaɔ.
english: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

lokele: Bato loemesana ko ndotichaka, la betoli oso imɔ lomuchamuchel’Inde, mbo— Auwekesäkä basi, auweseke Inde angɛnɛ to, eya mbo ende Masiya, Boaomu wa Mungu.
english: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

lokele: Basilikani imɔ losungakel’Inde ani bayäkä end’Inde oyatamb’Inde bänä ba ngai amweke,
english: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

lokele: iyo mbo— Boyala Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda, uwesaka to Aɛ angɛnɛ.
english: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

lokele: Lionga liäkä imɔ olikolo lia botö wande elisɔnɔmu mbo— Oyo ende Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda.
english: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

lokele: Ɔmɔi wa ebabe ebakakemäkä nda lieka, inde losungakel’Inde, mbo— ¿Aɛ, oti to Masiya? Uwesaka l’Aɛ angɛnɛ lasu lisanga!
english: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”

lokele: Kongo ko oyɔmɔi lof’inde liɛngɔ mbo— ¿Aɛ otiwange ango Mungu, ani aɛ imɔ okowa la likuchi-ao?
english: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

lokele: Iso nd’afomu se la litina, eoka tosokuchomo litina lia batwanelo basu, nde eboto-yo atikele shasɔ ango simɔi sibe.
english: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

lokele: Ona loonga mbo— Yesu, enyelaka’mi ani akayeke Aɛ nda Bɔkɔta waɛ.
english: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

lokele: La Yesu loonga lande mbo— Wewe, isoonga laɛ mbo louse-lo otoyala lami nda Use (Paladiso).
english: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

lokele: Ayäkä ifitika tina, lilima lokwa nda yese etotina konda lilongolongo,
english: It was now about the sixth hour, 23:44 and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour. 23:44

lokele: la löwa lotufaka’la esinda (yolinjaka Euchelo) ya Ndakɔ ya Mungu losalya yaki imbale.
english: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

lokele: Yesu loamama la limiki lifi, Inde mbo— Sango, isota bolimo wami nda besamba yaɛ. Limɔ aongäk’Inde ongoma, Inde lokusola luli nda liwa.
english: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.

lokele: Ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ to Komanda wa basilikani eloakelomökö, inde loinela Mungu, inde mbo— Eingo, eboto-yo ayali nde wa liengani.
english: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

lokele: Bato batotina imɔ ba ekuke ebasɔngɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ okatichaka ilombo, ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ iyo ebikelomu, iyo loinwa okenge ani batoomaka bekükü.
english: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

lokele: Nde basaɔ bande la batomali ebatutäk’Inde konda Ngalilai, iyo loɛnɛ bitotina-bi ani bemaläkä esika. Liombomu lia Yesu
english: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.

lokele: Aäkä omao boto, lina liande liko Yosefa, ayaläkä wa ikumbɛ, boto olau wa liengani oyatiakuliäkä likeli la kuko ya ikumbɛ; aäkä wa bokenge wa BaYuda, boko Alimatayo, awɛlɛ̈kɛ̈ loyo loa Bɔkɔta wa Mungu baiso.
english: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

lokele: Boto-yo lɔkɛ ende Pilato okaömba bolyo wa Yesu;
english: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

lokele: inde losulola wao se, inde lolingela wao la bisinda, limɔ inde loingesa wao nda losai eloafuwomökö nda batalɛ, olo angotaömbomo kɔni boto.
english: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

lokele: Lise lina liäkä elia litonji lia Elambɔ la Yenga ya Mungu esamboya.
english: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

lokele: Limɔ batomali ebasokwäkä nda Ngalilai amamwito la Yesu, iyo lotuta mbisa ya Yosefa, iyo lɔɛnɛ losai la boömbeli wa bolyo wande omao.
english: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.

lokele: Limɔ iyo loinwa okenge, iyo lotonja yeka ya shokana kwa mwemwe la baningo ba bolyo. Nde la lise lia Yenga, iyo loɛuma kwa atäkä Bikela.
english: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

lokele: Limɔ nda lise lia osooso, la nɔngɔnɔngɔ iyo loya nda losai, iyo loesha imɔ mwemwe la baningo ebitonji nd’iyo;
english: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

lokele: iyo loosha litalɛ lisoundukolomo nda losai.
english: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

lokele: Iyo lɔɔtɔ atiteni ya losai nde batiaoshäkä bolyo wa Ngɛnɛ Yesu.
english: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

lokele: Aäkä iyo batoeumɛlɛ la loasɔ-lo, futuku iyo lɔɛnɛ batolome bambale bemali tina lau la bawati bisinda ya ngɛlingɛli,
english: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

lokele: la batomali lowangaka finɛ; atuliäkä biɔmbɔ se ndoticha nyɛlɛ, batolome loonga lau mbo— ¿Monito otoluka ewa liwawi sisi ya ebawi?
english: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

lokele: At’imɔ eyamaya, asotɛmwa; enyelaka kwa aongäk’Inde lanu ani akoyali nda Ngalilai,
english: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

lokele: mbo— Wana wa Boto ewambomoko nda besamba ya bato babe, eolomoko nda lieka, la mbisa ya bacho basatɔ etɛmwɛkɛ liasi.
english: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

lokele: Limɔ iyo loenyela baoi ebaongäk’Inde,
english: They remembered his words,

lokele: la iyo losokwa nda losai, iyo loinwa okenge okakambesa eba liu la ɔmɔi la basi batotina, enjasɔ-bi bitotina.
english: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

lokele: Batomali baäkä nde Malia wa Mangandala, la Yoana, la Malia nyango wa Yakobo, la batomali basi amamwito lau, iyo lokambesa batomomu bitotina-bi;
english: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

lokele: baoi-ba baaka nda batoi bau kwa beongaonga la batiaimelaka batomali. (
english: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

lokele: Kongo ko Petelo loemala, inde lofata mangu konda losai, inde loinama se, inde lɔɛnɛ bisinda bifufu biyali oko yao angɛnɛ wawa; inde lokuswa okakɛ eyande ani atomwaala njasɔ ebiakelomökö.) Yesu lɔɛnɛlɛ ende bambale ba Emau
english: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

lokele: Nda lise-ao bambale bau bakɛndɛ̈kɛ̈ nda bokenge boko Emau ebole esika la Yelusaleme ko kilomɛta liu la ɛmɔi.
english: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia 24:13 from Jerusalem.

lokele: Iyo loonganaka loasɔ loa bitotina bina ebiakelomökö,
english: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

lokele: la aonganäk’iyo ndofelakana litina, Yesu angɛnɛ looshana lau, Inde lɔkɛsɛnɛ lau.
english: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

lokele: Nde baiso bau lokufesomo mbo bataluw’Inde.
english: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

lokele: Inde loonga to lau mbo— ¿Bani baoi ebatoongakanak’ino ani atoeta ino la mboka? Iyo losikama la yɔmbɔ yuno,
english: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

lokele: la ɔmɔi wau, lina liande liko Keleofa, inde lomutola lande mbo— ¿Ko Aɛ kongo w’eba fɛtɛti nda Yelusaleme oyatiluwe njasɔ ebisokelakomo ina la ebacho-ba?
english: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

lokele: Yesu mbo— ¿Bini to njasɔ? Iyo mbo— Eya Yesu wa Nasaleta oyasɔɛnɛlɛ Bɔtɔndɔli wa bofoka nda yao ebisokelak’Inde la ebisoongak’Inde imɔ nda baiso ba Mungu la eba bato lisanga;
english: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

lokele: la kanga ebieti la biange yasu lɔkɛs’Inde nda liwa la iyo lool’Inde nda lieka;
english: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

lokele: la tokɛsiki nde iyɛli mbo Inde nd’atoendola BaIsalaele, kongo ko yao bisoeta la kwani louse lole lise lia asatɔ mbisa ya njasɔ-bi.
english: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

lokele: Nde to loasɔ lɔmɔi lole mbo batomali basu bamɔi lomwaales’iso eoka aɛ̈kɛ̈ iyo la nɔngɔnɔngɔ nda losai,
english: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

lokele: batiɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ bolyo wande nde iyo loya oyakambes’iso mbo bɛnɛkɛ oko bakitomo ebaongaka lau mbo akoyali la liwawi,
english: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

lokele: limɔ batolome bamɔi basu, iyo lɔkɛ konda losai, iyo lɔɛnɛ imɔ ongoma kwa aongaka batomali, kongo ko batiɛnɛkɛ to Inde angɛnɛ.
english: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde ako Yesu loonga lau mbo— Ino ba elemolemo la botembu woimelaka baoi batotina ebaongäkä betɔndɔli;
english: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

lokele: ¿Lotiaaka ende Masiya mbo okeke etokange-to limɔ ndɔtɔ nda tala yande?
english: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loakola ko la lokasa loa Mɔsɛ la kasa ya bɛtɔndɔli yasi, Inde losanoel’iyo baoi batotina ebatomökö loasɔ loande angɛnɛ.
english: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

lokele: Asishanäk’iyo tina la okenge olo atɔkɛ lau, Inde asiakoetaka nde iyo
english: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

lokele: lolɔmbɔkɔl’Inde, iyo mbo— Tikalaka lasu, likɔlɔse lisoya to tina la löwa losɔkɛ. Limɔ Inde lɔtɔ lau ndakɔ, Inde lotikala lau.
english: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

lokele: Ayaläk’Inde se ndola bieka amamwito lau, Inde lɔɔsɔ lituma, Inde lofa Mungu kelekëlë, Inde louna liao, limɔ Inde lofaef’iyo liao,
english: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

lokele: la baiso bau loliolomo, iyo lolembeel’Inde, limɔ Inde angɔɛnɛlɛ’imɔ nda baiso bau.
english: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.

lokele: Iyo loongana mbo— ¿Betema yasu betiyaimweke atiteni yasu ani Inde atoonganaka lasu nda mboka, l’ani alioelak’iso litina lia baoi ba lokasa loa Mungu?
english: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

lokele: Nda mbile-ao, iyo loemala, iyo loinwa nda Yelusaleme, omao iyo loosha eba liu la ɔmɔi basɔngɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ etunda amamwito la basi, iyo ana loonga l’eba bambale mbo—
english: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

lokele: Ngɛnɛ asɔtɛmwa wewe la asɔɛnɛlɛ ende Simona.
english: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

lokele: Limɔ ebambale lokambes’iyo atotina ebiakelomökö la mboka l’ani asolembeel’iyo Yesu ko la bounyeli lia lituma. Yesu lɔɛnɛlɛ ende baeki bande
english: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

lokele: Aongäk’iyo baoi-ba, Yesu angɛnɛ loemala sisi yau, Inde loonga lau mbo— Lilatemi end’ino!
english: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

lokele: Nde iyo losisimwaka, iyo lowanga finɛ, iyo lotanga mbo basɔɛnɛ bolimo.
english: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Monito osowa tolöi? ¿Monito bototanaka fee nda betema yanu?
english: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

lokele: Tichaka bangasa bami la batindi bami mbo yende Imi angɛnɛ; matakaka’mi la ɛnɛkɛ, mbo bolimo ati la winyo la tokwa ebiyali lami kwa atɔɛnɛ ino.
english: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

lokele: Aongäk’Inde ongoma, Inde lotamb’iyo bangasa bande la batindi bande.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

lokele: Aäk’iyo batitaimeläkä kɔni eoka ya limɛngɔ la asisimwäk’iyo, limɔ Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Wende la yeka yola eyamaya?
english: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

lokele: Lamao iyo lof’Inde botüku wa swi botumbe,
english: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

lokele: la Inde lɔɔsɔ, Inde lola oso wa baiso bau. Yesu losanoela baeki baoi ba Lokasa loa Mungu
english: He took them, and ate in front of them.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Baoi-ba bami ebaongäkä’mi lanu, eyayaeläkä’mi amamwito lanu, bende mbo losoengana mbo bitotina ina bikɔchɔmɔkɔ kɔkɛ, biko eyatomökö loasɔ loami nda Bikela ya Mɔsɛ la nda kasa ya batɔndɔli, la nda Bɛɛlɛ ya BaYuda.
english: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde loliola baenyeli bau mbo baluweke litina lia kasa ya Mungu;
english: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Losotomo nda lokasa ongoma, mbo loengani nde ende Masiya mbo okeke tokange la mbo atɛmwɛkɛ nda liwa nda bocho wa isatɔ,
english: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

lokele: la mbo likalangani la limɛsɛli lia njasɔ ibe binangolomoko nda lina liande ende bato ba biese bitotina. Akakolek’ino nda Yelusaleme,
english: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

lokele: ino wende ebasɔɛnɛ njasɔ-bi la Imi nd’atotomel’ino lisakä elia Sango wami end’ino; ino nd’atotikala nda bokenge-bo konda akawatesomoko ino la bofoka ebotosokwa nda Use.
english: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”

lokele: Yesu lɔkɛsɛnɛ imɔ lau ko tina la Betania, la Inde loilaka besamba yande, Inde loongel’iyo baoi ba lifoti,
english: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

lokele: la aongäk’Inde ongoma, Inde losenyana lanu, Inde loilomo nda Use.
english: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

lokele: Iyo lotulamel’Inde se, iyo loinwa nda Yelusaleme la limɛngɔ fuu,
english: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

lokele: iyo lokayalake nda ndakɔ ya Mungu ani bainakelak’Inde.
english: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
